maternal_changes.body_changes: You'll experience your typical menstruation symptoms: bleeding, cramping, sore breasts, mood swings, etc. [cite: 78]
maternal_changes.tips: There's a need for some lifestyle changes to increase your chances of conceiving and having a healthy baby. [cite: 82] This includes adequate exercise [cite: 83], a balanced diet [cite: 84], and prenatal vitamins. [cite: 85] It is recommended to stop using substances such as caffeine [cite: 86], artificial sweeteners [cite: 87], alcohol [cite: 88], recreational drugs [cite: 89], and nicotine. [cite: 90]
maternal_changes.plan: You should plan to eat a balanced diet and start exercising. [cite: 92, 93]

baby_development.summary: Technically the baby has not started developing yet. [cite: 114]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Symptoms of ovulation include twinging lower abdominal pain, breast tenderness, slippery discharge that resembles egg white, and an increased basal body temperature. [cite: 107, 108, 109, 110, 111] Some women may experience light spotting during ovulation. [cite: 112]

maternal_changes.plan: This week you should plan to eat a balanced diet and start exercising. [cite: 120, 121]

baby_development.summary: The embryo is the size of the head of a pin. [cite: 138] The blastocyst is growing and multiplying rapidly, and part of it will become the placenta, which produces the pregnancy hormone HCG. [cite: 140, 141] Amniotic fluid is collecting around the cells to protect and cushion your baby. [cite: 143] Significant fetal development begins this week, including the brain, spinal cord, heart, and gastrointestinal tract. [cite: 144]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Many women do not notice any changes, but some may experience mild cramping, increased vaginal discharge, or light spotting known as 'implantation bleeding.' [cite: 132, 133]
maternal_changes.tips: Make sure you get adequate rest and nutrition. [cite: 147] Take time to relax, as stress is the worst thing for your body and baby during pregnancy. [cite: 148]
maternal_changes.plan: Nutrition is very important this early in pregnancy; folic acid and other essential nutrients are necessary. [cite: 152] It's also important to eat a balanced diet with adequate protein and calcium. [cite: 153] You should plan to avoid alcohol [cite: 154], illegal drugs [cite: 155], certain medications [cite: 156], and caffeine. [cite: 158]

baby_development.summary: The baby has three layers: the ectoderm, mesoderm, and endoderm, which will form the baby's organs and tissues. [cite: 175, 176] The ectoderm will become the nervous system, skin, and hair. [cite: 177] The mesoderm will become the heart, circulatory system, skeleton, and muscles. [cite: 178] The endoderm will house the lungs and develops into the lining of the gastrointestinal tract. [cite: 179] Arm and leg buds begin developing. [cite: 180] The placenta has also begun to form and is producing important hormones including hCG. [cite: 181]

maternal_changes.body_changes: You may begin to exhibit early pregnancy symptoms such as breast tenderness, headaches, lower backaches, and nausea. [cite: 168] Many early pregnancy symptoms are similar to those you may experience before your period. [cite: 169] If you have missed your period, you could take a pregnancy test. [cite: 171]
maternal_changes.tips: Your prenatal vitamin should contain at least 0.4 mg (400 micrograms) of folic acid. [cite: 185] You should check with your health care provider before taking any over-the-counter or prescription medications. [cite: 188]
maternal_changes.plan: If your period is late, you may want to take a home pregnancy test. [cite: 190] If the result is positive, you can schedule an appointment with a health care provider, although many wait to see you until you are 8 to 12 weeks pregnant. [cite: 191]

baby_development.summary: The baby's heart begins to beat and pump blood. [cite: 201] The neural tube, which will become the brain and spinal cord, is closing. [cite: 202] The baby's major organs are starting to form. [cite: 203]

maternal_changes.body_changes: You may experience fatigue, nausea, and heightened sense of smell. [cite: 204] Hormonal changes may cause mood swings. [cite: 205]
maternal_changes.tips: Stay hydrated and eat small, frequent meals to manage nausea. [cite: 206] Avoid raw or undercooked foods. [cite: 207]
maternal_changes.plan: Schedule your first prenatal appointment if you haven't already. [cite: 208] Start documenting your pregnancy journey. [cite: 209]

baby_development.summary: The baby's facial features, including eyes and ears, are beginning to form. [cite: 211] The arms and legs are developing as small buds. [cite: 212]

maternal_changes.body_changes: You may notice increased urination and tender breasts. [cite: 213] Morning sickness may intensify. [cite: 214]
maternal_changes.tips: Eat foods rich in vitamin B6 to help with nausea. [cite: 215] Rest as much as possible. [cite: 216]
maternal_changes.plan: Consider joining a prenatal class or support group. [cite: 217]

baby_development.summary: The baby's brain is growing rapidly, and the heart has divided into four chambers. [cite: 222] The umbilical cord is fully functional. [cite: 223]

maternal_changes.body_changes: You may feel bloated and experience food aversions. [cite: 224] Hormonal changes may cause acne. [cite: 225]
maternal_changes.tips: Wear comfortable clothing to accommodate bloating. [cite: 226] Avoid strong odors that trigger nausea. [cite: 227]
maternal_changes.plan: Start thinking about your birth plan and preferences. [cite: 228]

baby_development.summary: The baby's fingers and toes are forming, and the tail is disappearing. [cite: 232] The lungs are beginning to develop. [cite: 233]

maternal_changes.body_changes: You may notice an increase in vaginal discharge. [cite: 234] Your uterus is expanding to accommodate the growing baby. [cite: 235]
maternal_changes.tips: Wear breathable fabrics to stay comfortable. [cite: 236] Continue taking prenatal vitamins. [cite: 237]
maternal_changes.plan: Research and choose a healthcare provider if you haven't already. [cite: 238]

baby_development.length: 4.24 centimeters from its head to its rump [cite: 344]
baby_development.summary: The embryonic tail is completely gone by week 9. [cite: 340] The eyelids are fully formed, have fused shut, and will open again during week 28. [cite: 340] The heart has divided into four chambers, and the valves are beginning to develop. [cite: 341] Your baby can also make a fist and may begin sucking his/her thumb. [cite: 342]

maternal_changes.body_changes: You may experience mood swings, heartburn, and feeling more bloated. [cite: 336] You can avoid heartburn by eating smaller meals throughout the day instead of eating three larger meals. [cite: 337] Many women suffer from constipation and excess gas. [cite: 332]
maternal_changes.tips: At this point in your pregnancy, you may begin to feel more fatigued. [cite: 346] If you are having difficulty sleeping, you might want to consider changing your sleeping positions. [cite: 349]
maternal_changes.plan: If you are over the age of 35 or have a family history of a genetic illness such as cystic fibrosis, then you may want to consider seeing a genetic counselor. [cite: 351] Talk with your health care provider about prenatal tests such as chorionic villus sampling (CVS). [cite: 352]

baby_development.length: a little over 2 inches (5.08 centimeters) long [cite: 365]
baby_development.weight: about a quarter of an ounce (7 grams) [cite: 365]
baby_development.summary: This is the end of the embryonic period and the beginning of the fetal period. [cite: 366] The majority of your baby's vital organs (including the kidneys, liver, brain, and lungs) are functioning but will continue to mature. [cite: 367] Fingernails, toenails, and hair will begin to become visible this week. [cite: 369] The baby is actively swallowing amniotic fluid and kicking his/her legs. [cite: 370]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Your uterus has continued to grow, but you are probably still not showing much at this time. [cite: 361] You'll also notice your breasts and your belly getting bigger each week. [cite: 359]
maternal_changes.tips: Many healthcare providers recommend walking and swimming because they are low impact exercises that can be used throughout the entire pregnancy. [cite: 374]
maternal_changes.plan: Your second prenatal visit will occur between weeks 12 and 16. [cite: 376] Your doctor may use a Doppler stethoscope to detect your baby's heartbeat. [cite: 378]

baby_development.length: over 2 ½ inches (6.35 centimeters) long from crown to rump [cite: 392]
baby_development.summary: Your baby's head accounts for almost half of his/her entire length. [cite: 393] Both the fingers and toes have separated by week 11. [cite: 394] The baby's skin is still very transparent, and the bones are beginning to harden. [cite: 394] The external genitalia has almost completely formed. [cite: 395]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Some women notice changes in their hair, fingernails, and toenails, such as increased growth. [cite: 389] Your growing baby bump might cause aches and cramping around your abdomen, known as round ligament pain. [cite: 384, 385]
maternal_changes.tips: As long as there are no identified pregnancy complications, it is generally safe to travel at all times during your pregnancy. [cite: 399] The ideal time to travel is during the second trimester. [cite: 400]
maternal_changes.plan: Most women only gain 3 to 4 pounds (1.3 to 1.8 kilograms) during the first trimester. [cite: 404] The Obstetricians and Gynecologists protocol recommends a weight gain of 25 to 35 pounds (11.3 to 15.9 kilograms) during pregnancy. [cite: 405]

baby_development.summary: The eyes move closer together and the ears move closer to their final position. [cite: 420] The intestines have grown so fast that they actually extend into the umbilical cord, but they will begin to move back into the abdomen. [cite: 421] The kidneys can now secrete urine, and the nervous system is continuing to mature. [cite: 422] Your baby may have developed more complicated reflexes such as sucking. [cite: 423]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Your healthcare provider can now feel your uterus in your lower abdomen. [cite: 412] You may have noticed that your skin is changing, including darkening of the areolas or irregular dark patches on your face and neck called chloasma. [cite: 415, 416, 417] Blood volume increases by about 50 percent during pregnancy, a side effect of which is visible veins on the skin. [cite: 409, 410]
maternal_changes.tips: Many women benefit from Kegel exercises, which help strengthen the vaginal muscles. [cite: 425] Pregnant women who perform these exercises find that it helps with giving birth and tones the muscles for after delivery. [cite: 426]
maternal_changes.plan: Now is a great time to look at your diet. [cite: 429] You can avoid gaining excess weight by avoiding fast food/junk foods, avoiding late-night snacks, and limiting fats and sweets. [cite: 432, 433]

baby_development.summary: Your baby's head is now only about 1/3 of his/her body. [cite: 452] Unique fingerprints are now located on the tips of your baby's fingers. [cite: 453] The kidney and urinary tract are completely functional. [cite: 454] Covering your baby's skin is a fine, soft hair called lanugo. [cite: 455]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Stretch marks may be appearing on your abdomen, breasts, hips, or buttocks. [cite: 443] Your morning sickness may begin to subside, but you may be experiencing more frequent heartburn. [cite: 444] Your breasts might have become larger and may feel lumpy or nodular. [cite: 446] Colostrum begins to form. [cite: 448]
maternal_changes.tips: Almost 90% of pregnant women experience stretch marks. [cite: 457] Gaining weight at a slower rate can decrease the chance of stretch marks appearing. [cite: 458] Applying lotions that contain vitamin E and alpha hydroxy acids may also help. [cite: 459]
maternal_changes.plan: It is common for couples to wonder whether sex during pregnancy is safe. [cite: 465] For many couples, it is safe to engage in sex while pregnant. [cite: 467] However, sex should be avoided if you have a history of premature birth, miscarriage, or other specific complications. [cite: 467, 468, 469]

baby_development.weight: just a little less than 2 ounces (.05 kg) [cite: 485]
baby_development.summary: Your baby's arms are going to begin to lengthen and become more proportioned to the rest of the body. [cite: 487] The liver is beginning to produce bile, while the spleen is beginning to produce red blood cells. [cite: 488] The development of your baby's brain enables the facial muscles to grimace, frown, and squint. [cite: 489] Because you have begun the second trimester, the chance of miscarriage decreases. [cite: 490]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Maternity clothes may be a necessity for some people at this point. [cite: 480] Generally, in subsequent pregnancies your body tends to accommodate your growing baby and uterus faster, causing you to show earlier. [cite: 483] Many women report increased appetite, renewed energy, and higher sex drive. [cite: 477]
maternal_changes.tips: You may have noticed that you have moles for the first time or that your moles have begun to change. [cite: 492, 493] While these changes can be pregnancy-related, it is still wise to have new or changing moles evaluated by a healthcare provider. [cite: 494]
maternal_changes.plan: Mood swings are common during pregnancy. [cite: 496] You may be excited about being pregnant, but you may also feel stressed or overwhelmed. [cite: 497] Make sure to take care of yourself, and learn some healthy ways to cope with stress. [cite: 505]

baby_development.summary: Your baby's skin is very thin, and the blood vessels can actually be seen through the skin. [cite: 519] Your baby's eyes are moving towards the nose from the sides of the head. [cite: 521] The baby's bones are beginning to ossify, meaning that if an x-ray is taken, the skeleton would be visible. [cite: 522] Babies at this age have also been seen sucking their thumbs on ultrasound pictures. [cite: 523]

maternal_changes.body_changes: The average weight gain at this point in your pregnancy is about 5 pounds (2.27 kilograms). [cite: 512] You may be able to feel the top of your uterus four to five inches (10-12 centimeters) under your belly button. [cite: 516] You might experience a stuffy nose, leg cramps, and sensitive gums. [cite: 509]
maternal_changes.tips: It is best to begin sleeping on your side. [cite: 525] Sleeping on your back causes your uterus to place pressure on the aorta and inferior vena cava, which supplies blood to your lower body and the baby. [cite: 526] Sleeping on your stomach also places extra pressure on your uterus and should be avoided. [cite: 528]
maternal_changes.plan: Your healthcare provider will begin measuring your fundus, or fundal height, at your prenatal appointments. [cite: 532] This is the distance between the top of your pubic bone and the top of your uterus. [cite: 533]

baby_development.summary: Your baby is preparing for a growth spurt over the next several weeks. [cite: 554] The ears and eyes are also situated in their final positions. [cite: 556] Your baby's urinary and circulatory systems are beginning to function. [cite: 557] Your baby's heart pumps around 25 quarts of blood per day. [cite: 558]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Your uterus is continuing to grow and weighs approximately 8 ½ ounces (0.25 kg). [cite: 543] Your blood volume increases by 30-50%, resulting in more blood circulation through your body which can cause a 'pregnancy glow.' [cite: 546, 549] Your body is also producing hormones that cause your oil glands to work in over-drive, leaving your face shiny. [cite: 548]
maternal_changes.tips: You can begin to feel your baby's first movements between 16 and 20 weeks. [cite: 561] These first movements are often described as feeling like gas bubbles or a fluttering sensation. [cite: 563] Sleeping on your side becomes more important at this time; many health care providers recommend that you should not sleep on your back once you reach 16 weeks. [cite: 566, 567]
maternal_changes.plan: Your next prenatal appointment may be in the next several weeks. [cite: 570] During this visit, your health care provider may recommend some screens or tests including an ultrasound, Alpha-Feta Protein (AFP) test, or amniocentesis. [cite: 571, 572, 573, 575]

baby_development.length: a little over 5 3/4 inches (14 1/2 cm) long [cite: 594]
baby_development.summary: Your baby's umbilical cord is not only lengthening but also becoming thicker and stronger. [cite: 595] Your baby's sense of hearing is also developing. [cite: 596] Additionally, your baby is beginning to form adipose or fat tissue, which is important for regulating body temperature and metabolism. [cite: 598, 599]

maternal_changes.body_changes: As your abdomen continues to grow, other organs will move around to compensate for the growth of your uterus. [cite: 588] Most women find it easier to feel their uterus when they are standing. [cite: 591] Backaches are inevitable while expecting. [cite: 585] You may also feel more forgetful, which is often called 'pregnancy brain.' [cite: 585]
maternal_changes.tips: You may have noticed that you have periodic pain in your legs. This is called sciatic nerve pain. [cite: 601] It is thought to be caused by your developing baby putting pressure on the nerve. [cite: 603]
maternal_changes.plan: During the course of your pregnancy, you may have noticed that your allergies seem to flare up more than before. [cite: 605] It is best to consult with your healthcare provider before taking a prescription or over-the-counter medication. [cite: 606]

baby_development.summary: A protective covering called myelin is beginning to form around your baby's nerves. [cite: 622] If you are having a little girl, her fallopian tubes and uterus have positioned themselves in the correct place. [cite: 624] If you are having a little boy, his genitals may be noticed on your next ultrasound. [cite: 626]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Most people can recognize that you are pregnant. [cite: 615] Your cardiovascular system is affected, and you may experience low blood pressure. [cite: 617] This is why it is important to go from a lying/sitting position to a standing position slowly to decrease dizziness. [cite: 618, 619] Expect to gain weight regularly until delivery, usually about one pound per week. [cite: 612]
maternal_changes.tips: Many pregnant women find it difficult to get through the day without a nap. [cite: 629] If you are working, try to squeeze in a few minutes when you can take a short nap, even in a conference room or your car. [cite: 632, 634]
maternal_changes.plan: Many of you are looking forward to your third prenatal visit. [cite: 637] You may be offered a regular sonogram or a level II sonogram, which allows your healthcare provider to visualize more details like the chambers of the heart. [cite: 639, 640, 641] You can also have a Maternal Serum Alpha-Fetoprotein Screening (MSAFP). [cite: 643]

baby_development.length: a little under 7 inches (17.8 cm) long [cite: 658]
baby_development.summary: The kidneys are making urine, and hair is beginning to sprout on your baby's scalp. [cite: 661] Additionally, the parts of the brain that are responsible for the senses are specializing. [cite: 662] If you are having a baby girl, she already has 6 million eggs formed in her ovaries. [cite: 663]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Round ligament pain is most common during the second trimester. [cite: 653] This is characterized as a sharp pain in the abdomen or hip area on one or both sides. [cite: 654] Some women experience heartburn, since pregnancy hormones relax the muscles of your lower esophageal sphincter. [cite: 649] Constipation might also occur as Baby presses against your intestines. [cite: 651]
maternal_changes.tips: Dizziness during pregnancy is often caused by hypotension or low blood pressure. [cite: 665] This can be avoided by rising slowly from a sitting, squatting, or kneeling position. [cite: 669, 670]
maternal_changes.plan: Now that you are pregnant, it is important to be careful regarding which herbs you use. [cite: 673] We recommend not taking any herbal remedies without first contacting your healthcare provider or herbalist. [cite: 674] Many herbs may stimulate uterine muscles that could cause a miscarriage. [cite: 675]

baby_development.summary: Your baby is covered in a white substance called vernix caseosa which helps protect the skin. [cite: 690, 691] Your baby is beginning to produce meconium, a dark green or black, sticky substance that will constitute your baby's first messy diaper. [cite: 693]

maternal_changes.body_changes: The top of your uterus is now at the same level as your belly button. [cite: 683] You may have gained around 8 to 10 pounds by this point. [cite: 684] Also common during this time are leg cramps, swelling in the hands and feet, dry eyes, varicose veins, and trouble sleeping. [cite: 681]
maternal_changes.tips: It is vitally important to make sure that you get enough nutrients in your diet, especially iron. [cite: 697] An increase in iron intake is necessary as it assists in the production of hemoglobin and prevents anemia, low birth weight, and premature delivery. [cite: 698] Good sources of iron include lean red meat, pork, dried beans, and spinach. [cite: 700, 701, 702, 703, 704]
maternal_changes.plan: It is time to begin thinking about the delivery of your baby. [cite: 710] You will want to spend some time thinking through your hopes and wishes for this special day. [cite: 712] Creating a birth plan can help you communicate your desires clearly with all the people who will provide support to you. [cite: 714]

baby_development.summary: Up until this point, your baby's length was measured from the crown to the rump (CRL), but now it is measured from crown to heel (CHL). [cite: 730, 731] Your baby's eyelids have finished forming this week. [cite: 733] The digestive tract is continuing to mature as your baby swallows amniotic fluid. [cite: 735] If your baby is a girl, her vagina has fully formed. [cite: 737]

maternal_changes.body_changes: If you place your fingers about a half-inch above your belly button, you may be able to feel your uterus. [cite: 723] If you notice that your lower legs and feet swell towards the end of the day, try to schedule a couple of times a day when you can sit and rest. [cite: 725] Round ligament pain tends to increase as Baby grows, and you may feel shortness of breath. [cite: 719, 721]
maternal_changes.tips: A urinary tract infection (UTI) is more common during pregnancy because of changes in the urinary tract. [cite: 739, 740] You can reduce the likelihood of developing a UTI by drinking 6-8 glasses of water each day, wiping from front to back, and urinating before and after intercourse. [cite: 743, 744, 745, 746]
maternal_changes.plan: As you gain more weight, you may notice that you are beginning to develop varicose veins, which occur in the majority of pregnant women. [cite: 750] They most often appear in the legs but can also be found in the vulva and rectum. [cite: 751]

baby_development.summary: Your baby looks like a newborn but much smaller. [cite: 766] Your baby's skin appears wrinkly because your baby has not yet gained enough weight to fill the skin out. [cite: 767] The eyes have completely formed, but the iris still lacks pigment. [cite: 768] The eyelids and eyebrows are in place, and the pancreas is continuing to mature. [cite: 769]

maternal_changes.body_changes: You can now feel the top of your uterus about ¾ of an inch (2 cm) above your belly button. [cite: 762] Pregnancy often causes thick and shiny hair and fast-growing nails. [cite: 759] You might also get dry, irritated skin on your stomach, since it's constantly stretching. [cite: 760]
maternal_changes.tips: Many women begin worrying about preterm labor. [cite: 771] A Fetal fibronectin (fFN) test can be done to determine the risk. [cite: 773, 774] If this protein is found in vaginal secretions between 22 and 38 weeks, there is an increased risk of preterm labor. [cite: 776]
maternal_changes.plan: If you have not already arranged childbirth education classes, it is time to do so. [cite: 780] Try to complete your class by the end of your 37th week, to ensure you can finish it before labor begins. [cite: 782]

baby_development.length: approximately 11 to 14 inches (28 to 36 cm) long [cite: 798]
baby_development.summary: Lanugo, or the fine hair that covers your baby's body, may darken at this point, allowing it to be seen on an ultrasound. [cite: 800] Your baby is also looking more like a newborn. [cite: 801]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Your uterus now extends about 1½ inches (3.8 cm) above your belly button, and your weight gain should be around 12 to 15 pounds (5.4 to 6.8 kg). [cite: 789] Your uterus is sitting directly on top of your bladder, which can cause you to leak fluid. [cite: 792] If you notice fluid leaking that is odorless, it may be amniotic fluid; call your healthcare provider immediately. [cite: 795, 796]
maternal_changes.tips: Drinking plenty of fluids, especially water, is extremely important during pregnancy. [cite: 803] If you are drinking enough water, your urine should be pale yellow or even clear. [cite: 807] Drinking enough water can help prevent headaches, uterine cramping, and swelling. [cite: 808, 809, 810]
maternal_changes.plan: If you are currently working, you should be finalizing the plans and paperwork for your maternity leave. [cite: 812] It is best to go ahead and begin discussing with your partner whether you plan to return to work and who will care for the baby. [cite: 823]

baby_development.summary: Your baby's brain is growing rapidly at this time. [cite: 839] Taste buds are also forming, and the lungs are becoming more developed and complex. [cite: 839] Special cells are producing surfactant, which is necessary for the air sacs to inflate easily. [cite: 840, 841]

maternal_changes.body_changes: You can now feel the top of your uterus around 2 inches (5 cm) from your belly button. [cite: 831] The skin on your abdomen and breasts is stretching, which can cause these areas to feel itchy. [cite: 832] Your eyes may also feel more sensitive and dry. [cite: 835]
maternal_changes.tips: If you are having a problem with heartburn, you may want to try eating smaller meals throughout the day. [cite: 844] Many women find that eating five or six small meals a day decreases the amount of heartburn they experience. [cite: 845]
maternal_changes.plan: Between 24 and 28 weeks, most healthcare providers will perform a glucose screening test to check for gestational diabetes. [cite: 848] Gestational diabetes is a temporary form of diabetes in which the body does not produce adequate amounts of insulin to regulate sugar levels during pregnancy. [cite: 849]

baby_development.summary: Your baby is slowly gaining some baby fat, which will help your baby appear less wrinkled. [cite: 866, 867] If your baby has hair, the color and texture could be seen at this point. [cite: 867] Your baby's gender can be determined by an ultrasound. [cite: 868]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Your uterus is approximately the size of a soccer ball. [cite: 863] You may be suffering from carpal tunnel syndrome, which happens from swelling and fluid retention and causes a tingly, numb sensation in your hands. [cite: 860, 861]
maternal_changes.tips: Whether or not you know the gender of your baby, you may want to begin thinking about baby names. [cite: 876] Ask yourself what the initials spell out and if there are any nicknames associated with the name. [cite: 878, 879, 880]
maternal_changes.plan: You may be tempted to have a keepsake ultrasound performed, but there are health concerns. [cite: 882, 883] An ultrasound should be requested by a physician for a medical reason and performed by trained professionals. [cite: 885]

baby_development.summary: The nerves in the ears are developing, allowing your baby to respond more consistently to sounds. [cite: 901] Your baby is continuing to swallow amniotic fluid which is fostering lung development. [cite: 903] If you are having a little boy, his testicles have begun their descent into his scrotum. [cite: 904]

maternal_changes.body_changes: The top of your uterus can now be felt about 2½ inches (6.3 cm) above your belly button. [cite: 895] Your weight gain should be between 16 and 22 pounds (7.25 to 10 kg). [cite: 897] Intense itching in your hands and feet could signal a liver disorder called cholestasis of pregnancy and needs medical care. [cite: 891, 893]
maternal_changes.tips: The FDA recommends eating 8 to 12 ounces of fish low in mercury per week. [cite: 906] Four types of fish should not be eaten while pregnant: tilefish from the Gulf of Mexico, shark, king mackerel, and swordfish. [cite: 907, 908]
maternal_changes.plan: During your next prenatal appointment you should be prepared for various blood screenings, an antibody screen for Rh negative, and a glucose tolerance test for diagnosing gestational diabetes. [cite: 910, 911, 912, 913]

baby_development.summary: Around the 27th to 28th week, babies can open and close their eyes. [cite: 932] Your baby has also developed a regular wake and sleep cycle. [cite: 933] You may also begin to feel rhythmic movements, which are likely hiccups. [cite: 934, 935] This is completely normal as your baby's lungs continue to mature. [cite: 935]

maternal_changes.body_changes: By this point in your pregnancy, you can feel your baby move much more. [cite: 924] Many women ask questions concerning how often they should feel their baby move. [cite: 927] Later in pregnancy, you may be asked to determine your baby's kick count. [cite: 928] Some women get hemorrhoids during the second trimester due to increased blood flow. [cite: 920, 921]
maternal_changes.tips: If you have a car, we recommend you get an infant car seat. [cite: 937] Talk with other moms and/or a pediatrician to find out what products they recommend. [cite: 939] Also, make sure that the car seat fits in your car and is installed properly. [cite: 941]
maternal_changes.plan: If you have not made arrangements for childbirth classes, now is the time. [cite: 944] Remember that you want to have them completed by the time you have finished 37 weeks. [cite: 945]

baby_development.summary: Your baby's brain is beginning to develop grooves along its surface. [cite: 963, 964] The amount of brain tissue also begins to increase during the 28th week. [cite: 965] Eyebrows and eyelashes are visible, while the hair on your baby's head grows even longer. [cite: 966] Fat storage under the skin continues to develop. [cite: 967]

maternal_changes.body_changes: The top of your uterus can now be felt well above your belly button, about 3 ½ inches (8.9 cm) or more. [cite: 956] Your weight gain is most likely between 17 and 24 pounds (7.7 to 10.8 kg). [cite: 957] Many women will begin experiencing leg cramps, constipation, insomnia, and hemorrhoids at this point. [cite: 959]
maternal_changes.tips: You need to begin making plans for the trip to the hospital. [cite: 970] Make sure you have your partner's phone number(s) with you at all times. [cite: 972] Additionally, you will want to map out the various routes to your birthing location. [cite: 974]
maternal_changes.plan: You will likely begin visiting your health care provider every 2 weeks until you reach 36 weeks. [cite: 983] After 36 weeks, your appointments will be scheduled on a weekly basis. [cite: 984] You may be given Rhogam if you have the Rh Factor. [cite: 978]

baby_development.summary: Your baby is rapidly growing at this point. [cite: 998] His/her head is also growing due to rapid brain development that began in week 28. [cite: 998, 999] Muscles and lungs are also continuing to mature. [cite: 999]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Your total pregnancy weight gain at this point should be between 19 and 25 pounds (8.6 to 11.3 kg). [cite: 991] The top of your uterus can be felt somewhere between 3½ to 4 inches (8.9 to 10 cm) above your belly button. [cite: 992] Constipation is common during pregnancy. [cite: 994] As your body prepares for breastfeeding, you might notice yellowish colostrum leaking from your breasts. [cite: 988]
maternal_changes.tips: The Dawa community healthcare worker helps the mother have a positive and safe birth experience. [cite: 1005] They offer constant visits and in-person contact. [cite: 1008, 1009]
maternal_changes.plan: To prevent constipation, eat a high fiber diet including fruits, vegetables, and whole-grain bread. [cite: 1011, 1012] Drink 10 to 12 cups of fluids each day [cite: 1013] and exercise routinely. [cite: 1014]

baby_development.summary: Your baby's eyes are becoming more mature, and your baby can now tell the difference between light and dark. [cite: 1039] Babies at 30 weeks can even follow a light source with their eyes. [cite: 1040] After birth, newborns only have the ability to focus on objects a few inches from their faces. [cite: 1041, 1042]

maternal_changes.body_changes: You may begin noticing that you become tired more easily during this last part of pregnancy. [cite: 1026] Additionally, your body is producing a number of hormones that can cause your joints to become looser. [cite: 1032] This may result in your feet actually getting larger, which is normally a permanent change. [cite: 1033, 1034]
maternal_changes.tips: Many women during this stage of pregnancy report an increasing number of backaches. [cite: 1045] This is related to weight gain and the baby's growth. [cite: 1046] Proper posture can alleviate the back pain you are experiencing. [cite: 1048]
maternal_changes.plan: Now is the time to begin thinking about the different kinds of pain relief options that will be available to you when you deliver. [cite: 1051] Options include natural childbirth, local anesthesia (like an epidural or spinal block), narcotics, and patterned breathing. [cite: 1054, 1055, 1057, 1059]

baby_development.length: over 15 ½ inches (39.4 cm) in length [cite: 1080]
baby_development.summary: Your baby is continuing to develop a layer of fat under the skin. [cite: 1081] This gives your baby more of a newborn appearance. [cite: 1082] During the next several weeks, your baby will begin to put on even more weight. [cite: 1082]

maternal_changes.body_changes: You may have noticed a yellowish or creamy substance that has begun to leak from your breasts called colostrum. [cite: 1069, 1070] Many women begin to experience Braxton Hicks contractions, which are 'practice contractions' where the muscles of your uterus tighten for approximately 30 to 60 seconds. [cite: 1075, 1076, 1077, 1078]
maternal_changes.tips: Hemorrhoids are not uncommon during pregnancy. [cite: 1085] They are varicose (swollen) veins of the rectum and are usually painful. [cite: 1085] You can treat them by taking warm baths with baking soda or using witch hazel to reduce swelling. [cite: 1091, 1092, 1093]
maternal_changes.plan: Have you decided if you are going to breastfeed or bottle feed? [cite: 1098] Doing research on your options will help you make the best decision for your baby's health. [cite: 1099] Another decision is whether to store your baby's cord blood. [cite: 1100]

baby_development.length: a little over 16 inches (40.6 cm) long [cite: 1119]
baby_development.weight: between 4 and 4 ½ pounds (1.8 to 2 kg) [cite: 1119]
baby_development.summary: The toenails and fingernails have formed, and the lungs are continuing to mature, although they will not be fully developed for several more weeks. [cite: 1120] Your baby's skeleton has completely formed, but the bones are still very soft and pliable. [cite: 1121]

maternal_changes.body_changes: The top of your uterus can now be measured about 5 inches above your belly button. [cite: 1111] Because the top of your uterus is so high, you may begin to have trouble breathing or feel short of breath. [cite: 1112] This is due to the pressure that your growing uterus is placing on your diaphragm. [cite: 1113] Your blood volume has increased by 40% to 50% during the past 32 weeks. [cite: 1116]
maternal_changes.tips: If you are experiencing Braxton Hicks contractions, there are several ways you can try to alleviate them: change positions, take a warm bath for 30 minutes or less, and drink a couple of glasses of water. [cite: 1124, 1125, 1126, 1127]
maternal_changes.plan: Around this time, your healthcare provider will ask you to begin making visits every two weeks. [cite: 1132] You should also decide if you plan to save your baby's cord blood, which remains in the umbilical cord and placenta following birth. [cite: 1134, 1135]

baby_development.weight: between 4 ½ to 5 pounds (2 to 2.3 kg) [cite: 1158]
baby_development.summary: Your baby's skin is beginning to look less red and wrinkled. [cite: 1160] Fat stores are continuing to be deposited under the skin. [cite: 1161] The bones are all beginning to harden except for the skull, because the skull needs to remain soft and pliable for delivery. [cite: 1162]

maternal_changes.body_changes: The top of your uterus is a little over 5 inches (12.7 cm) from your belly button. [cite: 1146] Your total weight gain should be between 22 and 28 pounds (10 to 12.7 kg). [cite: 1147] You may wonder if you will be able to tell when your water breaks. [cite: 1148] Only 1 in 10 women experience a dramatic gush of amniotic fluid. [cite: 1150] If you think your membranes are leaking, call your health care provider. [cite: 1153]
maternal_changes.tips: Many women may wonder if it is still safe to have sexual intercourse at this point in their pregnancy. [cite: 1164] It is safe as long as your health care provider has not told you differently. [cite: 1165]
maternal_changes.plan: Your next prenatal appointment is a good time to discuss an episiotomy with your doctor. [cite: 1169] An episiotomy is a surgical incision occasionally necessary to enlarge the vaginal opening. [cite: 1170] Preventative measures include good nutrition, Kegels, and perineum massage techniques. [cite: 1177, 1178]

baby_development.length: somewhere around 17 ½ inches (44.5 cm) long [cite: 1195]
baby_development.weight: around 5 to 5 ½ pounds (2.3 to 2.5 kg) [cite: 1195]
baby_development.summary: Fat stores will help your baby regulate her body temperature after delivery. [cite: 1197] The central nervous system is continuing to mature, and the lungs are well-developed. [cite: 1198] Your baby has a good chance of surviving outside of the womb at this time. [cite: 1199]

maternal_changes.body_changes: The top of your uterus can now be felt approximately 5½ inches (14 cm) above your belly button. [cite: 1184] The amount of the amniotic fluid typically peaks between 34 and 36 weeks. [cite: 1187] You may have noticed that your belly button has become an 'outie' or that it is extremely sensitive. [cite: 1191]
maternal_changes.tips: One of the best ways to avoid an episiotomy is by massaging the perineum. [cite: 1206] Most health care providers recommend beginning this at 34 weeks. [cite: 1207]
maternal_changes.plan: Around this time many health care providers begin discussing a Group B Strep test, pain management options, and Cesarean birth (if needed). [cite: 1210, 1211, 1214, 1215]

baby_development.length: between 17 to 18 inches (43.2 to 45.7 cm) long [cite: 1236]
baby_development.summary: The vast majority of your baby's growth is complete by 35 weeks. [cite: 1237] Your baby's kidneys are completely developed, and the liver is beginning to process waste. [cite: 1238] Because your baby has grown so much, you may notice a change in her movements as there is less room to move around. [cite: 1239]

maternal_changes.body_changes: There are about 6 inches (15.2 cm) from your belly button to the top of your uterus. [cite: 1229] You should have gained anywhere from 24 to 29 pounds (10.9 to 13.2 kg). [cite: 1230] Your baby will settle deeper into your pelvis in a process known as lightening, which will relieve pressure on your diaphragm but increase pressure on your bladder. [cite: 1232, 1233, 1234]
maternal_changes.tips: With the birth of your baby only a few weeks away, you need to begin finding a pediatrician. [cite: 1243] Talk with your OB/GYN, midwife, family, and friends to see if they have any recommendations. [cite: 1244]
maternal_changes.plan: Between 35 and 36 weeks your health care provider will most likely want to begin seeing you once a week until you deliver. [cite: 1247] Your doctor may also ask you to begin counting your baby's movements. [cite: 1248] The recommendation is that you time how long it takes you to feel 10 kicks, flutters, swishes, or rolls. [cite: 1249]

baby_development.length: between 17 ½ to 19 inches (44.5 to 48.3 cm) long [cite: 1271]
baby_development.weight: 5 ¾ to 6 ¾ pounds (2.6 to 3.1 kg) [cite: 1271]
baby_development.summary: The fine downy hair (lanugo) that has covered your baby's skin is beginning to disappear, along with the vernix caseosa. [cite: 1272, 1273] Your baby should be in the head-down position. [cite: 1275]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Your baby is continuing to put on weight (about an ounce a day), but you will most likely not notice a change in your own weight. [cite: 1264] You may notice an increase in the amount of Braxton Hicks contractions you experience. [cite: 1266] About two to four weeks before delivery, your baby will begin 'dropping' into your lower pelvis. [cite: 1261]
maternal_changes.tips: If your breasts make you uncomfortable during the night, you may want to begin sleeping in a nursing bra. [cite: 1279] Nursing bras provide much-needed support even before your baby is born. [cite: 1280]
maternal_changes.plan: You should pack your essentials for the hospital. [cite: 1283, 1284] For the baby, you'll need an infant car seat, a going-home outfit, and newborn diapers. [cite: 1290, 1291, 1292] For yourself, bring your health insurance card, breast pads, a comfortable going-home outfit, and sanitary pads. [cite: 1285, 1286, 1287, 1288]

baby_development.summary: Even though your baby is considered full-term after this week, it is still better in most situations for the baby to remain in the womb until ready. [cite: 1311] If your baby is not in the head-down position, you should talk with your health care provider and partner regarding the various options that are available. [cite: 1312]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Your total weight gain should be around 25 to 35 pounds (11.3 to 15.9 kg). [cite: 1303] As your body begins to prepare for labor, your cervix will begin to dilate and efface. [cite: 1305] You will also pass the mucus plug, which blocked the opening of the cervix. [cite: 1306] Labor could be hours, days, or even weeks away. [cite: 1308]
maternal_changes.tips: You are in a waiting game from this point on. [cite: 1316] If there are any last-minute preparations that need to be completed before the arrival of your baby, now is a good time to finish these up. [cite: 1318] You could prepare several meals that can be frozen and eaten once you and the baby are back at home. [cite: 1322]
maternal_changes.plan: You should be finishing up childbirth classes and taking care of any other preparations for your baby. [cite: 1324] Make sure your bags are packed, and you may want to practice driving to the hospital. [cite: 1325]

baby_development.length: between 17 and 20 inches (43.2 to 50.8 cm) long [cite: 1338]
baby_development.weight: 6 ¼ to 7 ½ pounds (2.8 to 3.4 kg) [cite: 1338]
baby_development.summary: The vast majority of the organs are mature and fully functioning. [cite: 1339] The only exceptions are your baby's brain and lungs. These two organs can function outside of the womb at this point, although they will continue to mature during childhood. [cite: 1340]

maternal_changes.body_changes: You may experience some swelling in your feet, which can be a normal part of pregnancy. [cite: 1333, 1334] However, if you experience severe or sudden swelling in your hands, face, feet and/or ankles, you should contact your health care provider as this could be a sign of pregnancy-induced hypertension (PIH). [cite: 1335, 1336]
maternal_changes.tips: Some women may have non-stress tests performed during the last weeks of pregnancy. [cite: 1345] A fetal monitor will be attached to your abdomen and you will push a button every time you feel your baby move, and the monitor records your baby's heartbeat. [cite: 1347, 1348]
maternal_changes.plan: Your healthcare provider should discuss who to call when you think you are in labor and when the call should be made. [cite: 1351, 1352]

baby_development.length: between 18 and 20 1/2 inches (45.7 to 52 cm) long [cite: 1372]
baby_development.weight: around 6 ½ to 8 pounds (2.9 to 3.6 kg) [cite: 1372]
baby_development.summary: Your baby is continuing to develop a layer of fat underneath the skin, which is an important part of your baby's ability to regulate body temperature. [cite: 1373, 1374] Your baby is also beginning to form new skin cells to replace older skin cells. [cite: 1375]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Effacement is the process by which the cervix prepares for giving birth. [cite: 1368] The cervix will soften, shorten, and become thinner. [cite: 1370] Early signs of labor include regular contractions, pelvic pressure, dull back pain, and a feeling of restlessness. [cite: 1362]
maternal_changes.tips: Even though you will deliver your baby soon, continue monitoring your baby's movements. [cite: 1377] You may want to wait to take the tags off of gifts for your baby, in case items are not the right size or color. [cite: 1379, 1380]
maternal_changes.plan: At this point, you should really plan to take it easy. [cite: 1383] Whether this is your first child or fourth, your life will not be the same once this new addition arrives. [cite: 1384] So take some time for yourself, your partner, and your family. [cite: 1385]

baby_development.length: between 19 and 21 inches (48.3 to 53.3 cm) long [cite: 1400]
baby_development.summary: Your baby's bones have become hard, with the exception of the skull. [cite: 1401] The bones in the skull need to remain soft and pliable so they can overlap as they pass through the birth canal. [cite: 1402] Because of this, your baby's head may have a cone appearance for the first several days of life. [cite: 1403]

maternal_changes.body_changes: When your baby's head remains visible through your vaginal opening and does not slip back in, it is known as crowning. [cite: 1392, 1393] As your baby's head crowns, you will experience a burning or stinging sensation, often referred to as the 'ring of fire.' [cite: 1394] As soon as you feel this, stop pushing to reduce your risk of tearing or needing an episiotomy. [cite: 1395, 1396]
maternal_changes.tips: Immediately after delivery, your baby will be given her/his first test, the APGAR. [cite: 1408] It is a quick assessment of overall newborn well-being. [cite: 1412] The scores are recorded at one minute and five minutes of life. [cite: 1413] At five minutes, a score of seven to ten is normal. [cite: 1415]
maternal_changes.plan: During your last prenatal visit be prepared for tests like a Non-stress test and an Amniotic Fluid Index (AFI). [cite: 1422, 1423, 1424] Your healthcare provider will discuss the possibility of going past your due date and potential induction. [cite: 1426, 1427]

maternal_changes.tips: Icintu cacindama ico mwingacita pali ino nshita ni co mulecita mu nshila iyo mwingacita nga ca kuti mwalishibe kale ukuti muli ne fumo. Pati ya blastocyst ya lasanguka (placenta) icisa cikakwata umulopa wa mu kati, uukapanga HCG ( Human .Chorionic gonadotropin) Iyi e homoni ya ifumo iyasangwa ukupitila mu kupima kwa fumo. [cite: 61] Amafuta ya (amniotic fluids) nayo yalelonganika ukushinguluka amaselo kabili yakacingilila umwana wenu mwi fumo yenu yonse.Imilimo yacindama iya kukula kwa mwana uuli mwi fumo yatendeka muli uyu mulungu, ukubikapo no kukula kwa bongobongo,umusana, umutima na mumala (Gastrointestinal tract) [cite: 62]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Banamayo abengi tabamona ukwaluka ukuli konse, lelo banamayi bamo balakwata ukufuuta kwa mutembo no kukulisha ukufumya kwa mu kati ukwa muputule wa ku nse ukushinguluka kwa( ovulation) .Banamayo bamo balakwata ukufuuta kwa mu fumo ukwacepa nelyo ukumona ukwayanguka ukwaishibikwa nga “ukufuma umulopa mu mubili.” [cite: 54] Ita dokota nga ca kuti ulefuma umulopa nga nshi nelyo nga uli no ubukali ubukalamba; ici kuti calanga ukuti ali ne fumo lya ku nse ya icisa uko embryo yabikwa pa nse ya icisa (ilingi line mu fallopian tube) [cite: 55, 56]
maternal_changes.tips: Umubili wenu watendeka ukupita mu kwaluka kwabipisha, kabili kuti mwaumfwa ukuti muli no kucula inshita shimo. [cite: 64] Shininkisheni ukuti tamusakamana ukupuupa ukwalinga no kuisakamana. Ukupanga inshita ya kutuusha no kusekelela muli ukufyala. [cite: 65] Ukusakamikwa e cintu icabipisha ku mubili wenu no mwana ilyo muli ne fumo, bomfyeni inshila sha kucingililamo amasakamiko yenu ayacepa. [cite: 66] *Calinga ukuleka ukubonya ifintu pamo ngefi* ubwalwa, illegal drugs, Imiti shimoshimo, ifyakulya fimofimo, caffeine, ukupepa fwaka. [cite: 73, 74, 75, 76, 77, 78, 79]
maternal_changes.plan: Ukukansha umubili kwalicindama ilyo uli ne fumo. Landa naba shin'gnga bobe ilyo bashilatendeka ukubomba imilimo ya ku mubili. [cite: 68] Mu mibele iingi, nga ca kuti uli kale pa lwa kucincimusha umubili, kuti watwalilila ukuikala mu mikalile yobe. [cite: 69] Ukulya ifya kulya na kabili kwalicindama nga nshi muli uku kuimita. [cite: 70] ifyakulya ifya mweo ne fya kulya fimbi ifyacindama ne fya kulya fya ma vitamin fyakabilwa ukukula kwa mu fumo na follic acid. [cite: 71] Ukulya ifya kulya ifyalinga ne fipimo fyalinga ifya ku mubili na kabili kwalicindama kuli imwe no mwana. [cite: 72]

baby_development.summary: Abana bacili abanono nga nshi pali ino nshita kabili ukupima mupepi na mamilimita 1.98 mu butali. [cite: 93] Kuli ifiputulwa fitatu ku mwa wenu, ectoderm,mesoderm endoderm .ifi ifiputulwa fitatu fikapanga ifilundwa fya mwana. [cite: 94] Iciputulwa ca ectoderm cikaba ica mishipa nervous system( ukubikako na bongobongo) inkanda,imishishi, amalaa, mammary glands, sweat glands na ameno. [cite: 95] Mesoderm iciputulwa cabubili cikapanga umutima, umubili wamuntu na imishipa. Iciputulwa ca butatu cikakwata ifipuupu kabili cikakula mu chifuba ca mu malaa,liver,pancreas na thyroid. [cite: 96] Amaboko na mabuula yaku makasa yatendeka ukukula pali ino inshita nangu cakuti tayapusene bwino bwino. [cite: 97] Placenta nayo yatendeka ukupangika nakabili yatendeka uku panga ama homoni ayacindama ukubikapo na HCG. [cite: 98]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Kuti mwatendeka ukulanga ifishibilo fimo ifya kwimita bwangu pamo nga ukufuuta kwa ku mabele, uku kalipa kwa mutwe, kukalipwa kwa numa. [cite: 87] Calicindama ukwishiba ukuti ifishibilo ifingi ifya kwimita pakutendekelako fyapalana ne fyo mwingapitamo ilyo mili mukuya ku mweshi. [cite: 88] Banamayo bambi te kuti babe ne fishibilo fya ifumo maka maka nga ifumo linono. [cite: 89] Nga ca kuti mwalufya inshita yenu iya ku mweshi, lyena kuti mwapima ifumo. [cite: 90] Ici kuti caba ica kubalilapo ukuti waishiba ati lawimita. [cite: 91]
maternal_changes.tips: Nga ca kuti tamutendeke ukubomfya ifya kucincimusha umubili, moneni kuli dokota wenu pa kuti mumone ifyo mwingapanda amano. [cite: 100] Vitamin yenu iya pa ntanshi ya mwana afwile ukukwata ukufika kuli 0.4 mg (micrograms 400) aya follic acid iya mu cifuba. [cite: 101] Ama vitamini aya pa ntanshi ilingi line yaba na 0.8 mg ukufika kuli 1 mg (amabumba 800 ukufika kuli 1milligram) aya follic acid kabili na kabili yalikwata iron iyingi. [cite: 102] Ifi fintu fyalicindama kuli imwe no mwana wenu.Na kabili mulefwaya ukucenjela pa lwa miti yalekanalekana iyo mwabomfeshe ilyo muli ne fumo. [cite: 103] Mufwile ukufwailisha kuli dokota wenu uwa kumusakamana ilyo tamulabomfya imiti iili yonse nelyo iya kulipilisha. [cite: 104]
maternal_changes.plan: Nga ca kuti inshita yenu yalicelwa nelyo nga ca kuti muli ne nshita iyalinga, kuti mwafwaya ukufwailisha pa ng’anda. [cite: 106] Nga ca kuti icafumamo cisuma, kuti mwaesha ukupanga inshita ya kulanshanya na dokota wa fya bumi, nangu ca kuti abasakamana ubumi abengi balalolela ukumona imwe ukufikila mwaba ne milungu 8 ukufika 12. [cite: 107] Kabili mulefwaya ukutendeka umubomfi wa fya bumi no kupingulapo uko mukakwata umwana wenu. [cite: 109]

baby_development.summary: Umwana wenu acili umunono nga nshi, ukupima amamilimita 3 mu butali. [cite: 125] Umutima wa mwana obe uleuma umusango wa nshita, kabili imipangile iyo ikasanguka amenso na matwi filepangwa. [cite: 128] Iciputulwa ca mwana uuli mwi fumo na co citendeka ukupanga. maternal_changes.body_changes: Ukupilibuka kwa mibele ya homoni mu mulungu walenga isano. Amasakamiko yenu yaka aluka ukufuma ku nsansa ukuya ku kukalipwa pa mulandu wa kukanaumfwa bwino. maternal_changes.tips: Kuti mwaipusha nga ca kuti mufwile ukufina ama kg yanga pe fumo.
