[cite: 770] Kusamba amisamu yachimuntu [cite: 771] Kulesha ma pads [cite: 772] Chintu chikonzya kukwabilila muzindo kuzimba inga kuchita zyintu zyikonzya kumukwabilila kutaunka kuchimbuzi. [cite: 773]
maternal_changes.plan: Sena mwalibambila kaindi na muyonyosya kunkolo nanka kubodela. Inga kuli KABOTU alimwi alubi bwa zyobilo. [cite: 775] Kubala ma mbuku inga kwamigwasilizya mbo mwelede Kunyonsya Mwana kuba anseba ilikabotu. [cite: 776]

baby_development.summary: Mwana inga ula 40.6 cm mukulampa alimwi ulema 1.8 to 2kg. Mwana ulazumanana kukomema. [cite: 787] Maala yakumaula alimwi ayakumaza yalatalika kupangwa alimwi mabambo yalazumanana kusima nokuba kuti tayakonzyi kumaninina kupangwa kwa nvwiiki kunshonto kushede. [cite: 788] Skeleton yamwana inga kayi maninindwe kupangwa pesi mafuwa inga tayaninga maninizya kusima inga mafuwa yachili matetete. [cite: 789]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Atala chizyalilo inga ino kwapimwa kuzwida atala amuchombo nkambo kakuti inga atala achi zyalilo inga mpalafu, inga watalika kukatala kuyoya. [cite: 782] Echi inga nkambo kakuti chizyalilo chiyabu komena. Chisyata amsi yamoyo. Echi inga alimwi mulema ikelo yomwe munvwiiki. [cite: 783] Bulowa bulatalika kuunka atala 40% to 50%. Achi inga chipa MUBILI kuti uchikomzye kugwashilizya mwana alimwi abanyina. [cite: 784] Ubu kukwela kwa BP inga nkubotu nkambo kakuti kulatonzya mbuli bulowa mbomulibambila kuzwa ciindi chakutumbuka. [cite: 785]
maternal_changes.tips: Nvwiiki yakamani twakazumanana kubandika Ali Braxton Hicks contractions na mulaba ama contractions aya inga kuli zyintu zyikonzya kuchita [cite: 791, 792] Kuciincha mwakulalila akunks mukwendenda [cite: 793] Kusamba amenda yapya kwamawola yali ayatatu (3 minutes) [cite: 794] Kunwa menda kapati nkambo kakuti ma contractions aya yalakonzya kupanga menda mwiinda. [cite: 795] Kunwa tea yamukupa [cite: 796]
maternal_changes.plan: Sena mwakapanga kale decision yakuti mwelede kubamba munkombo wamwana? Cord blood inga bulowa busyalila mumukombo alimwi amu placenta echi inga chilasongwa. [cite: 802] Inga chintu chibotu namwayanda kuti bulowa obu busungwe nanka kuti busowengwe. [cite: 804] Kusunga bulowa obu inga chintu chibotu nkambo kakuti bulakonzya kungwasya mwana kumalwazi yaandene andene. [cite: 805]

baby_development.summary: Inga mwana ula 42 cm mukulampa alimwi inga ulemede 2 to 2.3 kg. [cite: 819] Inkanda yamwana ilatalika kulibonya kusalala yatalika kusima. Kuzwilisyako bongo. Kubika ansi yankanda. Nkambo kakuti bongo weelede kuzumanana kuteteta. [cite: 820]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Atala achi zyalilo lino inga kwasika a 12.7 cm mukulampa alimwi atala yamukombo kuneneya kwako lino inga kwasika 10 to 12.7 kg. [cite: 811] Inga mwatalika kukibuzya kwasena menda ayo pwayika. [cite: 812] Aya menda yazwa inga taya nanki pe. Namwabona kuti menda yatalika chilayandika kuzyibya ba basilisi. [cite: 815] Tamwelede kubelesya ma pads (tampons) kamutaninga kubona ba nurse nanka mamungwashililzya kutumbuka (midwife). [cite: 816] Tamwelede kubelesya ma pads nanka kuchita nkwela nkambo inga kwamuletela ma infections ciindi menda noya pwayika. [cite: 817]
maternal_changes.tips: Bamakaintu banji balalibuzya kuti Sena chilayandika kuba ankwela muciindi echi? Inga chilikabotu kuti na basilisi kunyina chobakwambila. [cite: 822] Pesi akuchincha kwamubili inga tatakuzumizya kuchita obo. Inga kuli nzila zimwi zyomukonzya kuba ankwela kutengwa munvwe Kabotu. [cite: 823]
maternal_changes.plan: Munvwiiki itobela inga nchibotu kuti mwabandika abasilisi nkambo kakutendwa. Oku kutendwa nanka episiotomy inga Kukomezya kubukaintu kutengwa mwana achikonzye kwiinda. [cite: 825] Kuba anseba chilikabotu Kegels (exercises of the pelvis) [cite: 828] A slowed second stage of labor where pushing is controlled [cite: 829] Warm compresses during labor [cite: 830] Perineum massage techniques [cite: 831]

baby_development.summary: Inga mwana ula 44.5 cm mulampa alimwii inga ulemede 2.3 to 2.5 kg. Kumamanino ya nvwiiki zyakamana. [cite: 842] Twakabandika kuti mafuta yamwana yalatalika kuba ankanda yamwana. Ichi inga chili important mukukomena kwa mwana. [cite: 843] Nkambo kakuti aya ma fats inga yagwasiliya mwana kuti watalika kuzwisya tempreture ciindi natumbuka [cite: 844] Central nervous system ilazumanana kusima, alimwii ama bambo ayalo yalazumanana kusima, pele bama docotela bamwi inga bayanda kuti mwazumanana kubikilila kunvwiiki ya 38 nanka ya 40. Nkambo kakuti mwana inga wakonzya kubona anze wazyalwa. [cite: 845]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Inga atala achizyalilo inga kwasika ku 14cm atala amukombo. Inga chilayandika kazyibakuti mutambu wonse inga madaa yaliimpene. [cite: 838] Nkambo kaako inga ma measurements inga yalimpene. Pele ciintu chilikabotu inga chakuti chizyalilo inga chiyakukomena. [cite: 839] Inga amount ya amniotic fluid inga ila boneka kwama nvwiiki ya 36 alimwi aku 37. Inga oyu amoniotic fluid ilatalika kachesa kulibambila kuti musana achikonzye kwiinda kabotu [cite: 840]
maternal_changes.tips: First stage: ya kutumbuka liatalika akunvwa kutumbuka kamanina aciindi chinyo (cervix) nochajuka yalo ngu 10 cm. [cite: 847] Stage 2: inga ila zumanana mene 10cm kusilala mwana wazylwa [cite: 849] Stage 3: inga ijatekizya kutubusya kwa placenta. Yalo ilatola ciindi 5 to 30 minutes [cite: 850]
maternal_changes.plan: Muciindi echi inga bama docotela balazumana kubandika zyintu zyitobela abama patient babo; Group b strep test [cite: 853] Scheduled visits [cite: 855] Location of the ER and the labor delivery entrance [cite: 856] Pre-registration packer [cite: 857] Pain management [cite: 858] C-section [cite: 859] Birth control methods [cite: 860]

baby_development.summary: Imwana inga ula zumanana kukomena kusikala 43.2 to 45.7cm mukulampa alimwi inga ulemede 2.5 to 2.7 kg. [cite: 871] Kumaninizya kukomena kwamwana inga kulamanina munvwiiki ya 35. Ma kidneys yamwana yamanina kukomena amana a liver inga yatalika kupanga zyintu zyiyandika. [cite: 872] Nkambo kakuti mwana wakomena kapati, inga mwatalika kubona change mulimwana mbuli mbwanyayala. [cite: 873]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Inga Kuli 15. 2 cm mukulampa kuzwa amuchombo kusika achizyalilo. Echi ciindi Mwelede mwaneneya mbuli 10.9 to 13.2 kg. [cite: 867] Na mujesi mubuzyo kujatilizya mbuli mbobwaneneya. Inga mwaba buzya badocotela. Namwalinvwa kutayoya kabotu inga mwana mutwe inga walanga ansi. [cite: 868] Mwana inga wakala afwafwi achizyalilo (pelvis), okukulvwa kwamutwe wamwana inga kwa lekesya kutalinvwa kabotu makayoya.alimwi chilapa kuti mwatalika kusuba suba. [cite: 869]
maternal_changes.tips: Kuzyalwa kwamwana kwaba afwafwi kushede nvwiiki mashonto. Inga Mwelela kujana docotela wabana (pediatrician). [cite: 875] Inga mwambaula a ba midwife, bamakwashi nanka benzinyoko kubona kuti niza inga bamugwasilizya kujana bulanganya bana [cite: 876]
maternal_changes.plan: Alimwi nga badocotela bayanda kumwambila kutalika kubala zibakela mwana zyauma. [cite: 879] Mwelede kubone zyintu ayi mumizezo ciindi mwana naune zyibakela - inga inga muyanda kubona yoonse mabakela yali 10 muli mumala yobile (2 hours) [cite: 883] - inga mwabelesya kabukku nanka kapepa kakubalila zyibakela [cite: 884] - nakuti tamwanvwa zyibakele inga mwatindila mawola yamwi [cite: 885] - nakuti tamwanvwa zyibakela zyilizyonse inga mwabazibya badocotela. [cite: 886]

baby_development.summary: -Mwana awa nishi wasika 44.5 kuya ku 48.3 cm mubu lanhyu amana kulema mbuli 2.6 na 3.1 kg [cite: 893] Mutwe wa mwana uyezele kulanga ansi muchindi echi na mutwe wa mwana tauna Lange ansi mutayowi, kamunka kuli ba docotela kutegwa basole kumulahya ansi mwana [cite: 894]

maternal_changes.body_changes: -Mulaneneha inga mwanvwa mubili mbuti busena mwinda bwakukomenena mwana bwa cheeya a kuamba kuti mwakatala kulinvwa amubili mu p [cite: 891]
maternal_changes.tips: -Ba nkolo hatalika kuminyonganya akuoona, muyezele kutalika kusama bra yabutumbu ,inga mwayisama nomuli kunjanda na ilamikonda. [cite: 896]
maternal_changes.plan: *hiyandika kuli ba tumbu - chi pepa cha kuchipadela [cite: 899] - kuba atu padi twa nkolo kutengwa katunyonka mukupa natamunyoshi [cite: 900] - ma padi [cite: 901] *hiyandikka hya mwana -hisani hatikasame mwana naunka kunjanda [cite: 903] - ma diaper ya Babi muhwanda [cite: 904]

baby_development.summary: -Nokuba kuti mwana ulibonya mbuti wakomena mu Nwiiki eyi, chilibuyo kabotu kumuleka mwana mwinda kusinka chindi chakutumbuka chasika [cite: 912] -Na mwana talangide ansi muchindi echi, kamuya mukambaule abamilanganya kuchipadela aba lumi benu kuboona nzila ititobele na iliko [cite: 913]

maternal_changes.body_changes: -Na mwakali kulipima chihalilo chenu inga mwakubona kuimpana kuzwa nomwakatalika Muchindi echi inga kunyina kunenehya, kulema kwenu kuyezele kuba mbuli 11.3 kuya ku 15.9 kg [cite: 909] menda Ali mwinda inga atalika ku swena amana akumyonga mwinda mulazumanisha maninginkambo mubili wenu ulibambila kuya kutumbuka awa kutumbuka kuli buyo Nwiiki na mazuba kutengwa buzuba busike [cite: 910]
maternal_changes.tips: -Awa mulindila Bo buzuba bwakuoyo tumbuka, na kul kulibambila kwamamanino kuliko nche chiindi chakumaninizya kabutaninga siika buzuba bwakutumbuka. [cite: 915] -Bamakayintu bamwi balayanda kujika zilyo zonayanda kutengwa Bajoka balya chilikumoyo wabo. [cite: 916]
maternal_changes.plan: -Muyezele kuti kamumanihinde ma class abutumbu, akutalika kulibambila kwa mwana. [cite: 918] - kamutalika kubamba ma beeke enu. [cite: 919]

baby_development.summary: Awa mwana unoli mupati mbuli 43.2 kuya ku 50.8 cm mubulahyu amana kulema mbuli 2.8 na 3.4 kg [cite: 926] Mwana uchi komena nokuba kuti zyonsi ziyandika kumwana zyasima kale, ihahala buyo ku maninina Kukomena mboongo a mapwapwa. [cite: 927]

maternal_changes.body_changes: inga mwabona maulu a zimba.chilibuyo kabotu kuba amaulu azimbele. [cite: 923] kuti na mwabona kuti ku zimba kwazumananna mamaulu, kumenso, mumanza na aku tusindi kamuya kulibadocktela. [cite: 924]
maternal_changes.tips: Mulayandika kunka ku scan aku bona mwana na ulangide buti, akunvwa mooyo wakwe mboudunta. [cite: 929]
maternal_changes.plan: kuchipadela bayenzele kumiambila na kumibuzya mibuzyo itobela mbani bauita mwanvwa mbuti chindi chasika na chindi cha kubayinta [cite: 932] hena kuli mapenzi aliko buli anaemia [cite: 933]

baby_development.summary: mwana unoli mu 45.7 kuya mu 52cm mubulahyu amana kulema kwake kunoli mu 2.9 kuya mu 3.6 kg. [cite: 940] mwana uchi komena kuba ama huta musi achikanda aya ma huta ano mugwasha kulikasazya mubili wakwe [cite: 941]

maternal_changes.body_changes: muchindi echi mubili wenu kunonyina Kuchincha maningi pensi chihalilo chenu chino chinchide maningi nkambo kukulbambila kuya kuhala [cite: 938]
maternal_changes.tips: Nokuba kuti munka kutumbuka, kamuzumanana kulanga mwana mbwayenda mwiinda [cite: 943]
maternal_changes.plan: Kamulya buyo mooyo wenu akukalikila, mwana ulasika na ngwakusanguna na ngwa chibili amulye buyo mooyo a kulibambila kabotu kuli mukwashi, baushi mwana a ndunwe. [cite: 945]

baby_development.summary: Mwana inga ulampide 48.3 to 53.3 mukulampa alimwi inga ulemede 3 to 4.5 kg [cite: 958] Mafuwa yamwana ciindi echi inga yasima, alimwi abongo bwamwana. Mafuwa yakabongo inga yandika kuti yashala kayatetede kutegwa mutwe uzwe kabotu akutumbuka mutwe. [cite: 959] Wamwana inga walibonya mbuli nkoshi kumazuba mashonto ciindi mwana nazyalwa. [cite: 960]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Nomutonka ciindi chakutumbuka inga mutwe watalika kulebonya achi zyalilo ciindi kubusimbi nokutalika kujulika. [cite: 951] Ciindi mutwe wamwana wasika a zyalilwa inga kubukaintu kalatalika kujuka, inga watalika kunvwa kupya kubukaintu. [cite: 952] Achi chitwa kuti keengo kuleka kutonko (ring of fire) [cite: 953]
maternal_changes.tips: Mwamana bo kutumbuka, mwana ulapegwa chakumusunka chakutanguna (APGAR) score. [cite: 962] Echi inga chakuzunka mwana ciindi nazyalwa. Pele tachili chakubonena mbuli mwana mbwatika be wakomena nanka Mano mwana ngoyo ba ayalo. [cite: 963] lyi APGAR chintu chibelesegwa ciindi mwana nazyalwa, inga maoola yabalwa muli 5 minutes. [cite: 964] Mwakupanga kuti Muchileke kunvwa kutonka (urge to push) - lean back and try to go limp [cite: 967] make a concious effort to relax the muscles [cite: 968] - kuba anguzu mukuyoyesha changuzu [cite: 969] - kulekelela kutonga kwalichitila mulimo muciindi echi [cite: 970]
maternal_changes.plan: Muciindi echi chamamanina mwelede kulibambila zintu zyitobela; - none stress test (kutayeyeshya manigi) [cite: 973] amoniotic fluid reflex [cite: 974] sonogram biophysical profile score [cite: 975] Badocotela balamwambila zyintu zyichilila Inga ciindi chayindilila ncho mukonzya kutumbuka [cite: 977] - kwitalishya daa (induction) [cite: 978] - kupandulwa (C Section) [cite: 979]

baby_development.summary: Mwana sanayambebe kupangidwa.

maternal_changes.body_changes: Muzava zizindikiro zanu za thawi yanu yopita ku mwezi: kutuluka magazi, kupweteka m'mimba, mabere opweteka, kusinthasintha kwa maganizo, ndi zina zotero. [cite: 2439]
maternal_changes.tips: Pamafunika kusintha zinthu zina mu moyo wanu kuti muwonjezere mwayi wokhala ndi pakati komanso kukhala ndi mwana wathanzi, monga kuchita masewera olimbitsa thupi, kudya zakudya zopatsa thanzi, ndi kumwa mavitamini a mimba. [cite: 2444, 2445, 2446, 2447] Ndibwino kusiya kugwiritsa ntchito zinthu monga mowa, mankhwala osokoneza bongo, ndi fodya. [cite: 2448, 2450, 2451, 2452]

baby_development.summary: Mwanayo sanayambebe kupangedwa. [cite: 2463]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Zizindikiro za kutulutsa dzira (ovulation) zingaphatikizepo kupweteka pang'ono m'mimba, mabere ofewa, kutuluka madzi ku ukazi osalala, ndi kutentha kwa thupi kwambiri. [cite: 2457, 2458, 2459, 2460, 2461]
maternal_changes.tips: Chinthu chofunikira kwambiri chomwe mungachite pakali pano ndikuyamba kukhala ngati mukudziwa kuti muli ndi pakati. [cite: 2465] Izi ziteteza inu ndi mwana wanu wamtsogolo ku zinthu kapena zochitika zilizonse zomwe zingayambitse mavuto. [cite: 2465]
maternal_changes.plan: Idyani zakudya zokwanera ndi zopatsa thanzi ndipo yambani kuchita masewera olimbitsa thupi. [cite: 2467]

baby_development.summary: Mwana wam'mimba wanu ndi wochepa kwambiri ndipo akuwoneka ngati gulu la maselo. [cite: 2480] Ali ndi kukula kwa mutu wa pini. [cite: 2481] Maselo ena adzakhale chisa (placenta), chomwe chidzapanga HCG (homoni ya mimba). [cite: 2482] Bongo ndi fupa la msana (spinal cord) zidzayamba kukula. [cite: 2470]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Azimai ambiri samazindikira kusintha kulikonse, koma ena amakhala ndi kupweteka pang'ono m'mimba komanso kutuluka madzi ku ukazi ochulukirapo. [cite: 2476] Ena amakhala ndi kutuluka mwazi ochepa, otchedwa 'implantation bleeding.' [cite: 2477] Tumani foni kwa dotolo wanu ngati mukutuluka mwazi ochuluka kapena muli ndi ululu waukulu. [cite: 2478]
maternal_changes.tips: Thupi lanu likuyamba kusintha kwambiri. [cite: 2484] Onetsetsani kuti mukupuma mokwanira ndipo mukudya zakudya zokwanira ndi zopatsa thanzi. [cite: 2484]
maternal_changes.plan: Kudya zakudya zopatsa thanzi, mankhwala a folic acid, ndi mavitamini ena ndi ofunikira pakukula kwa mwana. [cite: 2486, 2487] Ndibwino kupewa mowa, mankhwala osaloledwa, mankhwala ena, zakudya zina, ndi kukoka fodya. [cite: 2488, 2489, 2490, 2491, 2492, 2493]

baby_development.summary: Pali magawo atatu a mwana wanu: ectoderm, mesoderm, ndi endoderm, omwe adzapanga ziwalo ndi ziwalo za mwana. [cite: 2504, 2505] Minyendo ndi manja apangidwa koma simungathe kuzizindikila bwino. [cite: 2503] Chisa chapangidwa chomwe chiyamba kupanga zinthu zofunikira. [cite: 2506]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Mutha kuyamba kukhala ndi zizindikiro zoyambirira za mimba monga mabere opweteka, mutu kupweteka, kupweteka msana, ndi nseru. [cite: 2499] Azimai ena ayamba kuva kunuka kwa zakudya zina. [cite: 2497] Ngati mwachedwa kupita ku mwezi, iyi ndi nthawi yomwe mayeso a mimba apakhomo angayesere mimba. [cite: 2501]
maternal_changes.tips: Funsani adotolo anu zomwe akulimbikitsani. [cite: 2508] Mankhwala a folic acid ndi ofunika kwa inu ndi mwana wanu. [cite: 2509]
maternal_changes.plan: Ngati mwachedwa kupita ku mwezi, mutha kupima mimba kunyumba. [cite: 2511] Ngati zotsatira ndi zabwino, mungathe kukonza nthawi yochita msonkhano ndi adotolo. [cite: 2511]

baby_development.summary: Mwana wanu ndi wochepa kwambiri. [cite: 2518] Mtima wa mwana wanu ukumenya mwasatanisatani, ndipo maso ndi makutu akuyamba kupangidwa, pamodzi ndi mafupa a thupi. [cite: 2519]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Kusinthasintha kwa maganizo chifukwa cha mahomoni kumabweretsa kusintha kwa maganizo pa sabata lachisanu. [cite: 2515] Mungayambenso kukhala ndi matenda a m'mawa (morning sickness). [cite: 2513] Ngati nseru ya m'mawa ndi yoopsa kwambiri, funsani adotolo anu. [cite: 2516]
maternal_changes.tips: Madotolo amalimbikitsa kuti azimai onenepa bwino awonjezere pafupifupi 11.3 mpaka 15.9 kg pa mimba. [cite: 2521]
maternal_changes.plan: Ngati simunakonzerebe nthawi yoyamba yochezera adotolo, ndi nthawi yoti muchite izi. [cite: 2523]

baby_development.summary: Mapwapwa, nsagwada, mphuno ndi m'kamwa zayamba kupangidwa. [cite: 2533]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Mutha kuona kusintha kwa mabere anu, kufewa ndi kuwawa. [cite: 2528] Azimai ena amatha kuona kuti anenepa pang'ono, pamene ena angathe kuonda. [cite: 2527] Azimai ena amatuluka mwazi ochepa. [cite: 2529] Ngati mwazi wachuluka ndi kupweteka, dziwitsani adotolo anu. [cite: 2530]
maternal_changes.tips: Ngati mavitamini anu a mimba amakudwalitsani, mutha kuwamwa ndi chakudya kapena usiku. [cite: 2535] Funsani adotolo anu musanasiye kuwamwa. [cite: 2535]
maternal_changes.plan: Kudziwa mtundu wa magazi wanu ndi wa amuna anu ndikofunikira pa mimba. [cite: 2538] Kuli mitundu inai ya magazi: A, B, AB, ndi O. [cite: 2539, 2540, 2541, 2542, 2543]

baby_development.summary: Pa sabata lachisanu ndi chiwiri, chiwalo chilichonse chofunikira chayamba kupangidwa m'thupi la mwana wanu. [cite: 2546]

maternal_changes.body_changes: N'kutheka kuti anthu ozungulira inu sangadziwe kuti muli ndi pakati. [cite: 2550] Mutha kukhala munawonjezera ma kilogalamu ochepa, koma mungathenso kutaya kulemera ngati mukukumana ndi nseru ya m'mawa. [cite: 2551]
maternal_changes.tips: Nazi njira zothandizira nseru ya m'mawa: idyani zakudya zochepa nthawi zambiri, idyani chimanga chouma musanadzuke, pata mpumulo wokwanira, imwani madzi okhala ndi mandimu, ndipo pewani zakudya nthawi isanadutse komanso musagone pansi mukangodya. [cite: 2557, 2558, 2559, 2560, 2562]
maternal_changes.plan: Ngati simunasankhebe Chipatala, adotolo kapena namwino, ndi nthawi yoti musankhe mmodzi. [cite: 2566]

baby_development.summary: Chiwalo chilichonse chomwe chimapezeka mwa munthu wamkulu tsopano chili mwa mwana wanu. [cite: 2575]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Chiberekero chanu chinali chofanana ndi nkhonya yanu musanakhale ndi pakati, koma tsopano chili chofanana ndi mphesa. [cite: 2572] Zizindikiro za mimba zanu zikuyenera kuti zayamba kale: nseru, mabere opweteka, kutopa, kukodza pafupipafupi, ndi kusinthasintha kwa maganizo. [cite: 2571]
maternal_changes.tips: Pa mimba, azimai ena amakhala ndi khungu lamafuta ndipo amakhala ndi ziphuphu. [cite: 2577] Ngati mukugwiritsa ntchito mankhwala, ndikofunikira kudziwa zomwe mankhwalawa ali nazo. [cite: 2578]
maternal_changes.plan: Mutha kupita ku nthawi yanu yoyamba yochezera adotolo. [cite: 2580] Adotolo anu adzafunsa za mbiri yanu yachipatala, monga matenda aliwonse, tsiku lomaliza kupita ku mwezi, ndi matenda m'banja lanu. [cite: 2581, 2582, 2583, 2584]

baby_development.summary: Mwana wanu ali pafupifupi kukula kwa mphesa ndipo angayambe kuyamwa chala chake. [cite: 2587] Ziwalo zonse za mwana, kuphatikizapo zigongono, mapwanga, mapewa, ndi manja, zikugwira ntchito. [cite: 2594]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Simungathe kuoneka ngati muli ndi pakati kwa anthu ena, koma mukuyamba kuzindikira kusintha kwina. [cite: 2590] Mutha kukhala ndi kusinthasintha kwa maganizo, kutentha kwa chifuwa, ndi kumva kukhala wotupa. [cite: 2591]
maternal_changes.tips: Panthawi ino ya mimba yanu, mutha kuyamba kumva kutopa kwambiri. [cite: 2596] Izi zikhoza kuyambitsidwa ndi kusintha kwa mahomoni, vuto la kugona usiku, kapena nseru ya m'mawa. [cite: 2597]
maternal_changes.plan: Ngati muli ndi zaka zopitilira 35 kapena muli ndi mbiri ya matenda a chibadwa, mungafune kuganizira zochezera adotolo. [cite: 2599]

baby_development.summary: Iyi ndi nthawi yomaliza ya 'embryonic period' ndipo ndi chiyambi cha 'fetal period' pamene ziwalo za mwana wanu zikupitirira kukula. [cite: 2608]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Azimai ena amakhala ndi kuwala kwa mimba ('pregnancy glow') mu gawo loyamba, pamene ena amakhala ndi ziphuphu. [cite: 2604] Mudzazindikira mabere anu ndi mimba yanu ikukula sabata iliyonse. [cite: 2605]
maternal_changes.tips: Pezani masewera olimbitsa thupi oti mukhale wathanzi pa mimba. [cite: 2602] Funsani adotolo anu za masewera olimbitsa thupi oyenera kwa inu. [cite: 2611]
maternal_changes.plan: Nthawi yanu yachiwiri yochezera adotolo idzachitika pakati pa sabata 12 ndi 16. [cite: 2613] Panthawi ino, adotolo anu angachitenso ultrasound, zomwe zingakuloleni kuona mwana wanu koyamba. [cite: 2613]

baby_development.summary: Mutu wa mwana wanu ukutenga pafupifupi theka la kutalika kwake konse. [cite: 2626] Zala za m'manja ndi m'mapazi za mwana wanu zapatukana. [cite: 2626] Khungu la mwana wanu likadali lowonekera, ndipo mafupa akuyamba kuumitsa. [cite: 2627] Ziwalo zake zoberekera zakunja zatsala pang'ono kumaliza kupangidwa. [cite: 2628]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Azimai ena amaona kusintha kwa tsitsi, zala, monga kukula msanga. [cite: 2622] Izi zimaonedwa kuti n'zachilendo. [cite: 2623] Mimba yanu ikukula ndipo ingayambitse kupweteka m'mimba mwanu. [cite: 2617] Kutuluka kwa madzi (leukorrhea) kumasonyeza kuti thupi lanu likuyesetsa kutulutsa tizilombo. [cite: 2618]
maternal_changes.tips: Ngati mulibe mavuto a mimba, mukhoza kuyenda nthawi zonse. [cite: 2630] Nthawi yabwino yoyendera ndi mu chigawo chachiwiri, chifukwa matenda a m'mawa ambiri amakhala atatha. [cite: 2631]
maternal_changes.plan: Ngati mumadwala matenda a m'mawa, mwina mwaonda. [cite: 2633] Osadandaula, azimai ambiri amangowonjezera 1.3 mpaka 1.8 kg mu chigawo choyamba. [cite: 2633]

baby_development.summary: Maso akuyenda pafupi ndi mphuno ndipo makutu akuyenda pafupi ndi malo awo omaliza. [cite: 2643] Matumbo a mwana wanu akuyamba kubwerera mu mimba mwake. [cite: 2644]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Chiberekero chanu chikupitiriza kukula, ndipo adotolo anu akhoza kuchimva tsopano m'mimba mwanu. [cite: 2639] Mungazindikire kuti zovala zanu sizikukwanira bwino. [cite: 2640] Kuchuluka kwa magazi kumawonjezeka ndi 50% pa mimba, ndipo chizindikiro chimodzi ndi mizere yowonekera pakhungu. [cite: 2636, 2637]
maternal_changes.tips: Azimai ambiri amapindula ndi masewera olimbitsa thupi a Kegel, omwe amathandiza kulimbitsa minofu ya ukazi, kuthandiza pa nthawi yobereka, ndi kulimbitsa minofu pambuyo pobereka. [cite: 2646, 2647]
maternal_changes.plan: Ndi nthawi yabwino kuyang'ana zakudya zanu ndikuonetsetsa kuti inu ndi mwana wanu mukupeza zakudya zofunika. [cite: 2649] Pewani zakudya zopanda thanzi, kudya usiku, ndi zakudya zamafuta. [cite: 2652, 2653, 2654]

baby_development.summary: Mwana wanu tsopano ali ndi zala zosiyana. [cite: 2657] Mutu wa mwana wanu unali gawo lalikulu la thupi lake, koma izi zikuyamba kusintha. [cite: 2666] Khungu lake lili ndi tsitsi lofewa, lotchedwa lanugo. [cite: 2667]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Mikwingwirima ya mimba (stretch marks) ikhoza kuyamba kuonekera pa mimba, mabere, m'chiuno, kapena kumaliseche. [cite: 2662] Matenda anu a m'mawa angayambe kuchepa, koma mungakhale ndi kutentha kwa chifuwa pafupipafupi. [cite: 2663] Mutha kumva chizungulire masana. [cite: 2658]
maternal_changes.tips: Pafupifupi 90% ya azimai oyembekezera amakhala ndi mikwingwirima ya mimba. [cite: 2669] Mutha kuchepetsa mwayi wa mikwingwirima powonjezera kulemera pang'onopang'ono. [cite: 2669] Masewera olimbitsa thupi ndi mafuta odzola amathandizanso. [cite: 2670]
maternal_changes.plan: Kwa maanja ambiri, ndibwino kugonana pa mimba. [cite: 2672] Komabe, muyenera kupewa kugonana ngati muli ndi mbiri yakubereka msanga, kuchoka kwa mimba, kapena ngati madzi anu atuluka. [cite: 2672, 2673, 2674, 2675]

baby_development.summary: Mwana wanu akupitiriza kukula ndi kukhwima. [cite: 2683] Chiwindi chake chikuyamba kupanga bile, ndipo mtima wake ukuyamba kupanga magazi. [cite: 2684]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Zovala za mimba zingakhale zofunikira kwa anthu ena panthawiyi. [cite: 2681] Azimai ambiri amati amakhala ndi chilakolako chowonjezereka, mphamvu yatsopano, ndi chilakolako chogonana kwambiri. [cite: 2679]
maternal_changes.tips: Mungazindikire kuti muli ndi zipsera zatsopano. [cite: 2686] Ngakhale kusintha kumeneku kungakhale chifukwa cha mimba, ndi bwino kuti adotolo anu ayese zipserazi. [cite: 2686]
maternal_changes.plan: Mutha kumva kusinthasintha kwa maganizo pa nthawi ino ya mimba yanu. [cite: 2688] Musadandaule, izi zimachitika pa mimba. [cite: 2688]

baby_development.summary: Khungu la mwana wanu ndi lochepa kwambiri, ndipo mitsempha ya magazi ingaoneke. [cite: 2697] Mafupa a mwana wanu akuyamba kuumitsa, zomwe zikutanthauza kuti ngati atatengedwa chithunzi cha x-ray, fupa lingaoneke. [cite: 2698]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Kulemera kwapakati pa sabata ino ndi pafupifupi 2.27 kg. [cite: 2694] Mutha kukhala ndi mphuno yotsekeka, kupweteka kwa miyendo, ndi kumva kwinanso. [cite: 2692]
maternal_changes.tips: Azimai ambiri amakhala ndi mafunso okhudza malo ogonera pa mimba. [cite: 2700] Ndi bwino kuyamba kugona m'mbali. [cite: 2700] Kugona chagada kumachititsa chiberekero chanu kupondereza mitsempha ya magazi. [cite: 2701]
maternal_changes.plan: Adotolo anu adzayamba kupima chiberekero chanu pamene mukupita ku msonkhano wanu. [cite: 2705] Uwu ndi mtunda pakati pa fupa lanu la m'chiuno ndi pamwamba pa chiberekero chanu. [cite: 2706]

baby_development.summary: Mwana wanu akukonzekera kukula msanga m'masabata otsatira. [cite: 2715]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Chiberekero chanu chikupitiriza kukula ndipo chikulemera pafupifupi 0.25 kg. [cite: 2712] Thupi lanu likupanga madzi ochulukirapo a 'amniotic' omwe amathandiza kuteteza mwana wanu. [cite: 2712] Pafupifupi 90% ya azimai oyembekezera amakumana ndi kuda kwa khungu. [cite: 2709]
maternal_changes.tips: Mutha kumva kuyenda koyamba kwa mwana wanu pakati pa sabata 16 ndi 20. [cite: 2717] Ngati iyi ndi mimba yanu yoyamba, zingatenge mpaka sabata 20. [cite: 2717]
maternal_changes.plan: Adotolo anu angakulimbikitseni zoyesera kapena kupimitsa monga Ultrasound ndi Alpha-Feta Protein (AFP). [cite: 2719, 2720, 2721]

baby_development.summary: Chingwe cha mchombo chikukulanso ndipo chikuyamba kukhala cholimba. [cite: 2730] Kumva kwa mwana wanu kukukulanso. [cite: 2730]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Pamene mimba yanu ikupitiriza kukula, ziwalo zina zidzasintha kuti zigwirizane ndi kukula kwa chiberekero. [cite: 2727] Kupweteka kwa msana sikungapeweke pamene muli ndi pakati. [cite: 2725]
maternal_changes.tips: Mungazindikire kuti muli ndi kupweteka kwa nthawi ndi nthawi m'miyendo yanu, komwe kumatchedwa kupweteka kwa 'sciatic nerve.' [cite: 2732] Ndiwo mtsempha waukulu kwambiri m'thupi. [cite: 2733]
maternal_changes.plan: Mukayamba mimba, mungazindikire kuti matupi anu amayabwa kwambiri kuposa kale. [cite: 2735]

baby_development.summary: Choteteza chotchedwa 'myelin' chikuyamba kupangidwa mozungulira mitsempha ya mwana wanu. [cite: 2746]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Anthu ambiri akhoza kuzindikira kuti muli ndi pakati. [cite: 2742] Pali zosintha zambiri zomwe zikuchitika mkati mwa thupi lanu. [cite: 2743] Muyembekezere kuonjezera kulemera mpaka mutabereka (pafupifupi 0.45 kg pa sabata). [cite: 2740]
maternal_changes.tips: Azimai ambiri oyembekezera amaona kuti ndi zovuta kudutsa tsikulo popanda kugona masana. [cite: 2748] Ngati ndinu mayi wokhalira pakhomo, pezani nthawi yopuma. [cite: 2749]
maternal_changes.plan: Ambiri a inu mukuyembekezera nthawi yanu yachitatu yochezera adotolo. [cite: 2751] Mutha kupatsidwa 'sonogram' yoyambira kapena 'level II sonogram.' [cite: 2752]

baby_development.summary: Mwana wanu akupitirira kukula. [cite: 2763] Impso zake zikupanga mkodzo, ndipo tsitsi likuyamba kumera pa mutu wa mwana wanu. [cite: 2764]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Kupweteka kwa m'mimba kumakhalapo pa trimester yachiwiri. [cite: 2759] Ichi ndi kupweteka kwakukulu m'mimba kapena m'chiuno. [cite: 2759] Kudzimbidwa (constipation) kungachitikenso pamene mwana akukankha m'matumbo anu. [cite: 2757]
maternal_changes.tips: Chizungulire pa mimba chimayambitsidwa ndi kuthamanga kwa magazi (hypotension). [cite: 2766] Mutha kupewanso chizungulire poyimirira pang'onopang'ono. [cite: 2767]
maternal_changes.plan: Tsopano popeza muli ndi pakati, ndikofunikira kusamala ndi zitsamba zomwe mumagwiritsa ntchito. [cite: 2769] Tikukulimbikitsani kuti musamwe zitsamba zilizonse musanalankhule ndi adotolo wanu. [cite: 2770]

baby_development.summary: Mwana wanu waphimbidwa ndi chinthu choyera chotchedwa 'vernix caseosa,' chomwe chimathandiza kuteteza khungu la mwana wanu. [cite: 2780]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Pamwamba pa chiberekero chanu tsopano chili pa mlingo womwewo ndi pakati pa mimba yanu. [cite: 2776] Mwina mwawonjezera pafupifupi 3.6 mpaka 4.5 kg. [cite: 2777] Nthawi zambiri panthawiyi mumakhala ndi kupweteka kwa miyendo, kutupa kwa manja ndi mapazi, ndi vuto la kugona. [cite: 2774]
maternal_changes.tips: Ndikofunikira kuonetsetsa kuti mukudya zakudya zokwanira, makamaka chitsulo (iron). [cite: 2782] Chitsulo chimathandiza kupewa 'anemia,' kulemera kochepa pa kubadwa, ndi kubereka msanga. [cite: 2783]
maternal_changes.plan: Ndi nthawi yoti muyambe kuganizira za kubereka kwa mwana wanu. [cite: 2785] Kupanga dongosolo lobereka kungakuthandizeni kulankhula zofuna zanu bwino. [cite: 2786]

baby_development.summary: Mwana wanu tsopano akuyezedwa kuchokera ku mutu mpaka ku chidendene. [cite: 2796] Zikope za mwana wanu zamaliza kupangidwa sabata ino, ndipo akuyenda kwambiri. [cite: 2798]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Ngati mukuyika zala zanu pafupifupi inchi imodzi pamwamba pa mimba yanu, mungathe kumva chiberekero chanu. [cite: 2793] Chiberekero chomwe chikukula chingathenso kuyika mphamvu pa mapapu anu, zomwe zimayambitsa kupuma movutikira. [cite: 2791]
maternal_changes.tips: Matenda a mkodzo (UTI) ndi ambiri pa mimba. [cite: 2800] Pamene chiberekero chikukula, kulemera kwake kungatsekeze kutuluka kwa mkodzo, zomwe zimayambitsa matenda. [cite: 2801] Mutha kuchepetsa mwayi wa UTI pomwa magalasi 6-8 a madzi tsiku lililonse. [cite: 2802]
maternal_changes.plan: Mungazindikire kuti mukuyamba kukhala ndi mitsempha yotupa (varicose veins), yomwe imachitika kwa azimayi ambiri. [cite: 2806]

baby_development.summary: Mwana wanu akuwoneka ngati mwana wakhanda koma wocheperako. [cite: 2815] Khungu la mwana wanu limawoneka lopindika, koma izi ndi chifukwa chakuti sanapeze kulemera kokwanira. [cite: 2816]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Mutha kumva pamwamba pa chiberekero chanu pafupifupi 2 cm pamwamba pa mchombo wanu. [cite: 2812] Ngakhale mukulemera, mwina mukuwoneka wokongola! [cite: 2810] Mimba nthawi zambiri imachititsa tsitsi kukhala lolimba komanso lonyezimira. [cite: 2810]
maternal_changes.tips: Azimai ambiri amayamba kuda nkhawa za kubereka msanga, makamaka ngati ayamba kumva kupweteka kwa m'mimba ndi msana. [cite: 2818] Izi zingakhale zachilendo kapena zingasonyeze kubereka msanga. [cite: 2819]
maternal_changes.plan: Ngati simunakonzerebe makalasi a maphunziro obereka, ndi nthawi yoti muchite izi. [cite: 2821] Makalasiwa amapereka zambiri zolondola zomwe muyenera kuyembekezera pa nthawi yobereka. [cite: 2822]

baby_development.summary: Mwana wanu akupitiriza kuonjezera kulemera. [cite: 2832] Tsitsi lofewa (lanugo) lomwe likuphimba thupi lake likhoza kuda, kulola kuti lioneke pa ultrasound. [cite: 2832]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Chiberekero chanu tsopano chili pafupifupi 3.8 cm pamwamba pa mchombo wanu, ndipo kulemera kwanu kuyenera kukhala pakati pa 5.4 mpaka 6.8 kg. [cite: 2829] Mimba yanu ikukula ndipo imatha kupangitsa mchombo wanu kutuluka, koma uzabwerera mwakale mutabereka. [cite: 2826]
maternal_changes.tips: Kumwa zakumwa zambiri, makamaka madzi, ndikofunikira kwambiri pa mimba. [cite: 2834] Ngati mukumwa madzi okwanira, mkodzo wanu uyenera kukhala wachikasu pang'ono kapena woyera. [cite: 2834]
maternal_changes.plan: Ngati mukugwira ntchito, muyenera kumaliza makonzedwe a tchuthi chanu cha amayi. [cite: 2837] Onetsetsani kuti mwalankhula ndi bwana wanu. [cite: 2838]

baby_development.summary: Ubongo wa mwana wanu ukukula mofulumira panthawiyi. [cite: 2847] Mapapu akuyamba kupangidwa bwino kuti agwire ntchito. [cite: 2848]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Mutha kumva pamwamba pa chiberekero chanu pafupifupi 5 cm kuchokera pa mchombo wanu. [cite: 2844] Khungu pa mimba ndi mabere anu likutambasuka, zomwe zingachititse kunyezimira. [cite: 2845]
maternal_changes.tips: Ngati muli ndi vuto la kutentha m'chifuwa, mungayesere kudya zakudya zochepa tsiku lonse. [cite: 2850] Kudya kasanu kapena kasanu ndi kamodzi patsiku kumachepetsa kutentha kwa chifuwa. [cite: 2851]
maternal_changes.plan: Pakati pa sabata 24 ndi 28, madokotala ambiri amachita 'glucose screening test' [cite: 2853] kuti aone shuga m'magazi (gestational diabetes). [cite: 2854]

baby_development.summary: Mwana wanu akuyamba kuwonjezera mafuta. [cite: 2863] Ngati mwana wanu ali ndi tsitsi, mtundu wake ungawoneke panthawiyi. [cite: 2864] Jenda la mwana wanu lingadziwike ndi ultrasound, amniocentesis, CVS, kapena NIPT. [cite: 2865]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Chiberekero chanu chili pafupifupi kukula kwa mpira wa miyendo. [cite: 2861] Mungakhale mukuvutika ndi 'carpal tunnel syndrome,' yomwe imachitika chifukwa cha kutupa. [cite: 2858]
maternal_changes.tips: Mungayambe kuganizira za maina a mwana. [cite: 2867] Inu ndi mwamuna wanu mukhoza kukhala munakambirana kale. [cite: 2868]
maternal_changes.plan: Mungayesedwe kupanga ultrasound ya chikumbutso, koma pali nkhawa za thanzi zomwe muyenera kuziganizira. [cite: 2870, 2871]

baby_development.summary: Chitukuko chomwe chikuchitika ndi chofunikira kwambiri pamene mwana wanu akukonzekera kubadwa. [cite: 2882]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Pamwamba pa chiberekero chanu pamveka pafupifupi 6.3 cm pamwamba pa mchombo wanu. [cite: 2877] Pa mimba yanu yonse, mudzaonjezera pafupifupi 1.25 cm pa sabata. [cite: 2878] Kulemera kwanu kuyenera kukhala pakati pa 7.25 mpaka 10 kg. [cite: 2879]
maternal_changes.tips: FDA imalimbikitsa kudya nsomba zochepa za mercury pa sabata. [cite: 2884] Pali mitundu inayi ya nsomba yomwe siyenera kudyedwa, monga mackerel. [cite: 2885]
maternal_changes.plan: Pa nthawi yanu yotsatira, muyenera kukhala okonzekera kupimitsidwa magazi, shuga, ndi kukambirana za mdulidwe. [cite: 2887, 2888, 2889, 2890]

baby_development.summary: M'masabata 27 mpaka 28, ana amatha kutsegula ndi kutseka maso awo. [cite: 2902] Mwana wanu wapanga kale nthawi yake yakuuka ndi kugona. [cite: 2902]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Panthawiyi, mutha kumva mwana wanu akuyenda kwambiri. [cite: 2899] Azimai ena amakhala ndi 'hemorrhoids' (kupweteka panjira yopita ku chimbudzi) chifukwa cha kuchuluka kwa magazi. [cite: 2896, 2897]
maternal_changes.tips: Ngati muli ndi galimoto, tikukulimbikitsani kupeza mpando wa galimoto wa mwana. [cite: 2904] Ndi nthawi yoti muyambe kufunafuna umodzi. [cite: 2905]
maternal_changes.plan: Ngati simunakonzerebe makalasi a maphunziro obereka, ino ndi nthawi yake. [cite: 2907] Muyenera kumaliza pamene muli pa sabata 37. [cite: 2907]

baby_development.summary: Ubongo wa mwana wanu ukuyamba kukhala chiwalo chogwira ntchito kwambiri. [cite: 2916] Tsitsi la mwana wanu likukulirakulira. [cite: 2916]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Sabata iliyonse chiberekero chanu chikupitiriza kukula. [cite: 2913] Kulemera kwanu kuyenera kukhala pakati pa 7.7 mpaka 10.8 kg. [cite: 2913] Pamene mukufika kumapeto, mudzayamba kumva kutopa kwambiri. [cite: 2911]
maternal_changes.tips: Muyenera kuyamba kupanga makonzedwe a ulendo wopita ku chipatala. [cite: 2918] Izi zitha kukhala zothandiza ngati mwana wanu abwera msanga. [cite: 2919]
maternal_changes.plan: Pa nthawi yanu yotsatira, muyenera kukhala okonzeka kulandira mankhwala (Rhogam) ngati magazi anu ali ndi negative Rh Factor, komanso kukambirana za kayendedwe ka mwana. [cite: 2921, 2922, 2923]

baby_development.summary: Mwana wanu akukula mofulumira. [cite: 2934] Mutu wake ukukula chifukwa cha kukula kwa ubongo komwe kunayamba sabata 28. [cite: 2935] Minofu ndi mapapo akupitiriza kukhwima. [cite: 2935]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Kulemera kwanu kuyenera kukhala pakati pa 8.6 mpaka 11.3 kg. [cite: 2931] Kudzimbidwa (constipation) kumabwera pa mimba. [cite: 2932] Mungazindikire mkaka wachikasu (colostrum) ukutuluka m'mabere anu. [cite: 2928]
maternal_changes.tips: A Dawa community healthcare worker amathandiza amayi kukhala ndi mimba yabwino komanso yotetezeka. [cite: 2937]
maternal_changes.plan: Nawa malangizo ochepa oti muthandizire kupewa kudzimbidwa: idyani zakudya zambiri zamasamba ndi zipatso, imwani madzi ambiri, chitani masewera olimbitsa thupi, ndipo pewani kumwa mankhwala a chitsulo. [cite: 2939, 2940, 2941, 2942, 2943]

baby_development.summary: Mwana wanu tsopano akhoza kusiyanitsa pakati pa kuwala ndi mdima. [cite: 2954]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Mungayambe kuzindikira kuti mumatopa mosavuta. [cite: 2949] Mafupa anu angayambe kukhala otayirira. [cite: 2949] Izi zingachititse kuti mapazi anu akule. [cite: 2949] Mikwingwirima ya mimba ikuyamba kuonekera kwambiri. [cite: 2947]
maternal_changes.tips: Azimayi ambiri pa nthawi ino amanena za kuchuluka kwa kupweteka kwa msana, komwe kumagwirizana ndi kulemera ndi kukula kwa mwana. [cite: 2956, 2957]
maternal_changes.plan: Ndi nthawi yoti muyambe kuganizira za mitundu yosiyanasiyana ya njira zochepetsera ululu yomwe idzakhalepo mukabereka. [cite: 2959]

baby_development.summary: Mwana wanu akupitiriza kupanga mafuta pansi pa khungu. [cite: 2969] Izi zimapatsa mwana wanu mawonekedwe a mwana wakhanda. [cite: 2969]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Mutha kuzindikira kuti madzi achikasu (colostrum) ayamba kutuluka m'mabere anu. [cite: 2965] Azimai ambiri amayamba kumva 'Braxton Hicks contractions' m'masabata omalizira a mimba. [cite: 2966] Zizindikiro zina za mimba za chigawo choyamba zingabwerenso. [cite: 2963]
maternal_changes.tips: 'Hemorrhoids' si zachilendo pa mimba. [cite: 2971] Ndi mitsempha yotupa panjira yopita ku chimbudzi ndipo nthawi zambiri imakhala yopweteka. [cite: 2971]
maternal_changes.plan: Kodi mwasankha ngati muyamwitsa kapena kugwiritsa ntchito botolo? [cite: 2973] Kufufuza pazosankha zanu kudzathandiza kupanga chisankho chabwino. [cite: 2974]

baby_development.summary: Zala za m'mapazi ndi m'manja zapangidwa, ndipo mapapo akupitiriza kukhwima. [cite: 2985] Mafupa a mwana wanu onse apangidwa. [cite: 2985]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Pamwamba pa chiberekero chanu tsopano chikhoza kukhala utali pafupifupi 12.7 cm pamwamba pa mchombo wanu. [cite: 2981] Chifukwa chakuti chiberekero chanu chili chokwera, mungayambe kuvutika kupuma. [cite: 2982] Thupi lanu lingapangenso 'Braxton Hicks contractions.' [cite: 2978]
maternal_changes.tips: Ngati mukumva 'Braxton Hicks contractions,' pali njira zingapo zomwe mungayesere kuti muchepetse: sinthani malo okhala, sambani m'madzi ofunda, kapena imwani makapu angapo a madzi. [cite: 2987, 2988, 2989, 2990]
maternal_changes.plan: Dokotala wanu adzakupemphani kuti muyambe kupita masabata awiri aliwonse. [cite: 2994]

baby_development.summary: Khungu la mwana wanu likuyamba kuwoneka lopanda makwinya. [cite: 3003] Mafupa akuyamba kuumitsa kupatula fupa la mutu, lomwe liyenera kukhala lofewa pa nthawi yobereka. [cite: 3003]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Pamwamba pa chiberekero chanu chili pafupifupi 12.7 cm kuchokera pa mchombo wanu. [cite: 2999] Kulemera kwanu kuyenera kukhala pakati pa 10 mpaka 12.7 kg. [cite: 3000] Mwana wanu akukula ndipo akupitiriza kupondereza ziwalo zanu, zomwe zimayambitsa kupuma movutikira. [cite: 2997]
maternal_changes.tips: Ndi kotetezeka kugonana malinga ngati adotolo anu sanakuuzeni china. [cite: 3005]
maternal_changes.plan: Nthawi yanu yotsatira ndi nthawi yabwino kukambirana za 'episiotomy' (kuchekedwa kokulitsa pakamwa pa ukazi) ndi adotolo anu. [cite: 3007, 3008]

baby_development.summary: Mafuta omwe ali pansi pa khungu adzathandiza mwana wanu kuwongolera kutentha kwa thupi pambuyo pobadwa. [cite: 3018]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Pamwamba pa chiberekero chanu tsopano chikhoza kumveka pafupifupi 14 cm pamwamba pa mchombo wanu. [cite: 3013] Kuchuluka kwa madzi a 'amniotic' kumafika pachimake pakati pa masabata 34 ndi 36. [cite: 3014]
maternal_changes.tips: Gawo loyamba la kubereka limayamba pa nthawi ya kubereka kotsimikizika ndipo limatha mpaka khomo la chiberekero litatseguka mpaka 10 cm. [cite: 3020] Gawo lachiwiri limapitilira mpaka kubereka kwa mwana. [cite: 3021] Gawo lachitatu limaphatikizapo kubereka kwa placenta. [cite: 3022]
maternal_changes.plan: Panthawiyi madokotala ambiri amayamba kukambirana ndi odwala awo za kupimitsa 'Group B Strep,' njira zowongolera ululu, ndi kubereka mwa 'Cesarean section.' [cite: 3026, 3027, 3030, 3031]

baby_development.summary: Chitukuko chambiri cha mwana wanu chimatha pa sabata 35. [cite: 3044] Impso zake zimapangidwa bwino, ndipo chiwindi chikuyamba kukonza zinyalala. [cite: 3044]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Pali pafupifupi 15.2 cm kuchokera pa mchombo wanu mpaka pamwamba pa chiberekero. [cite: 3039] Muyenera kukhala mutalemera pakati pa 10.9 mpaka 13.2 kg. [cite: 3040] Kulemera kwanu kungayambe kukhazikika pa sabata 35, ndipo kusowa tulo kuyamba kumveka. [cite: 3037]
maternal_changes.tips: Muyenera kuyamba kupeza dokotala wa ana (pediatrician). [cite: 3046] Lankhulani ndi dokotala wanu, namwino, banja, ndi abwenzi. [cite: 3047]
maternal_changes.plan: Pakati pa masabata 35 ndi 36, dokotala wanu mwina akufuna kuyamba kukuwonani sabata iliyonse mpaka mutabereka. [cite: 3049] Angakulimbikitseni kuyamba kuwerengera kukankha kwa mwana wanu. [cite: 3050]

baby_development.summary: Tsitsi lofewa ('lanugo') lomwe laphimba khungu la mwana wanu likuyamba kutha, [cite: 3061] pamodzi ndi 'vernix caseosa,' chinthu chokoma chomwe chateteza khungu lake. [cite: 3062]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Mwana wanu akupitiriza kuonjezera kulemera (pafupifupi 28g patsiku), koma mwina simudzazindikira kusintha kwa kulemera kwanu. [cite: 3057] Mungazindikire kuchuluka kwa 'Braxton Hicks contractions.' [cite: 3058] Pafupifupi masabata awiri mpaka anayi musanabereke, mwana wanu adzayamba kutsika m'chiuno chanu ('lightening'). [cite: 3054]
maternal_changes.tips: Ngati mabere anu amakuchititsani kukhala osamasuka usiku, mungayambe kugona mu bra yoyamwitsa. [cite: 3065]
maternal_changes.plan: Mukakhala ndi nthawi yokumana ndi adotolo, muyenera kukhala okonzeka ndi khadi yanu ya inshuwaransi, zovala zopita nazo kunyumba, ndi zovala za mwana monga mpando wa galimoto ndi matewera. [cite: 3068, 3069, 3070, 3071, 3072, 3073, 3074]

baby_development.summary: Ngakhale mwana wanu amaganiziridwa kuti ndi 'full-term' pambuyo pa sabata ino, nthawi zambiri zimakhala bwino kuti mwanayo akhalebe m'chiberekero mpaka akakonzeka. [cite: 3084]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Kulemera kwanu kuyenera kukhala pafupifupi 11.3 mpaka 15.9 kg. [cite: 3081] Kuchuluka kwa madzi a 'amniotic' kumayamba kuchepa pa sabata 37. [cite: 3081] Mungathenso kutulutsa 'mucus plug.' [cite: 3076] Mungazindikire kutuluka kwa magazi pang'ono mukatha kugonana. [cite: 3078]
maternal_changes.tips: Ngati pali kukonzekera komaliza komwe kuyenera kumalizidwa mwana wanu asanabwere, ino ndi nthawi yabwino kumaliza. [cite: 3086, 3087]
maternal_changes.plan: Muyenera kumaliza maphunziro a kubereka ndikukonzekera chilichonse cha mwana wanu. [cite: 3089] Onetsetsani kuti thumba lanu ladzaza, ndipo mungafune kuyesa kuyendetsa galimoto kupita ku chipatala. [cite: 3090]

baby_development.summary: Ubongo ndi mapapo a mwana wanu akhoza kugwira ntchito kunja kwa chiberekero, ngakhale adzapitiriza kukhwima pa ubwana wawo. [cite: 3100]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Mungakumane ndi kutupa kwa mapazi anu, komwe kungakhale gawo la mimba. [cite: 3096] Komabe, ngati kutupa kuli kwakukulu kapena kwadzidzidzi m'manja, kumaso, kapena m'miyendo, muyenera kuimbira adotolo anu foni. [cite: 3097]
maternal_changes.tips: Ngati mwana wanu akuganiziridwa kuti ali m'malo olakwika (breech), mungafunike 'sonogram' ina kuti mutsimikizire. [cite: 3102] Izi zingakupatseni mwayi womalizira wowona mwana wanu asanabadwe. [cite: 3103]
maternal_changes.plan: Adotolo anu ayenera kukambirana nanu za amene mungaimbire foni mukaganiza kuti muli pa nthawi yobereka. [cite: 3105, 3106]

baby_development.summary: Mwana wanu akupitiriza kupanga mafuta pansi pa khungu. [cite: 3118] Ichi ndi gawo lofunikira kuti mwana azitha kuwongolera kutentha kwa thupi. [cite: 3118]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Mwina simunawonjezere kulemera kulikonse pa sabata kapena ziwiri zapitazi. [cite: 3114] Pamene mukufika kumapeto kwa mimba, khomo la chiberekero chanu lidzatsekuka. [cite: 3115] Zizindikiro zoyambirira za kubereka zimaphatikizapo 'contractions' zanthawi zonse, kupanikizika m'chiuno, ndi kupweteka kwa msana. [cite: 3112]
maternal_changes.tips: Pitirizani kuyang'anira mayendedwe a mwana wanu. [cite: 3120] Adotolo ambiri angakulimbikitseni kupitiriza kuwerengera mayendedwe a mwana. [cite: 3120]
maternal_changes.plan: Panthawiyi, muyenera kukonzekera kutenga zinthu mosavuta. [cite: 3122] Tengani nthawi nokha, ndi mwamuna wanu, komanso ndi banja lanu. [cite: 3123]

baby_development.summary: Mafupa a mwana wanu akhala olimba, kupatula fupa la mutu. [cite: 3133] Fupa la mutu liyenera kukhala lofewa kuti lizitha kudutsa mu njira yoberekera. [cite: 3134]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Pamene mukukankha, mutu wa mwana wanu udzayamba kuonekera. [cite: 3129] Pamene mutu wake ukhalabe wowonekera, zimadziwika kuti 'crowning.' [cite: 3130] Mudzapitiriza kumva zizindikiro monga kusowa tulo, kutupa, ndi kutunda pafupipafupi mpaka mwana atabwera. [cite: 3126]
maternal_changes.tips: Nthawi yomweyo pambuyo pobereka, mwana wanu adzapatsidwa mayeso ake oyamba, APGAR, omwe ndi kuunika kwachangu kwa thanzi la mwana wakhanda. [cite: 3136, 3137]
maternal_changes.plan: Pa nthawi yanu yomalizira yokumana ndi dokotala, konzekerani mayeso monga Non-stress test ndi Amniotic Fluid Index. [cite: 3139, 3141, 3142] Adokotala adzakambirana nanu za kuthekera kopitilira tsiku lanu lobereka, kuyambitsa kubereka (induction), kapena kubereka mwa Cesarean. [cite: 3144, 3146, 3147, 3148]

baby_development.summary: Mbututu asikakala kale kubupeha.

maternal_changes.body_changes: Musali ukabona lisupo za kuya kwa kweli zeo ka; kutamoka malo, kunyapa wamba, tutombo kwa mazwele, sizuhela mane cwalo ni zemu.
maternal_changes.tips: Kubutokwa kuli mutu yaitwezi a chinche lika zemu kamaino ahae kuli abe ni mbututu yanani buiketo[cite: 1142]. Zemu zeswanelwa kueziwa ki ze ka; kuikenya mwa lipapali zematafaza mubili, licho ze butokwa mwa mubili, ni licho ze butokwa ku mbututu[cite: 1144, 1145, 1146]. Muima uswanela kuambuka bucwala, milyani yekola, ni milyani yetabisa mibili[cite: 1148, 1150, 1151].
maternal_changes.plan: Kucha hande [cite: 1153] ni kueza lipapali ze matafaza mubili[cite: 1154].

baby_development.summary: Kanako ye, mbututu hasikakala kale kubupeha[cite: 1173]. Lii la musali lipila mwahali a lihola ze lishumi ka zepeli kufita fa lizazi liliñwi[cite: 1162]. Hañata, musali uzusanga lii lililiñwi ka kweli[cite: 1163].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Lisupo za kuya kwa kweli likona kuba; kunyapa kwaatasi a mba, bunolo bwa mazwele, kulotisa sitipwitipwi sesiswana sina lii lakuhu kwa busali, ni kuekeza kwa kufutuma kwa mubili[cite: 1167, 1168, 1169, 1170]. Basali babamu babanga ni mali kwa busali[cite: 1171].
maternal_changes.tips: Muima uswanela kuipabalela sina yazibile kale kuli uitwezi[cite: 1175].
maternal_changes.plan: Kucha kaswanelo [cite: 1177] ni kuikenya mwa lipapali ze matafaza mibili[cite: 1178].

baby_development.summary: Mbututu ye mwamba isali yo muinyani mane ubonahalanga feela sina tukoto[cite: 1190]. Toho yahae ipima butelele bobufita fa 0.48mm[cite: 1190]. Mukubu wakala kubateñi, mi wakalanga kuzusanga mulyani wa human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) o bonahala falipimiso za mulwalo[cite: 1191, 1192]. Lilama zebutokwa zeka boko, moko mwa mongola , pilu mane amoho cwalo ni za mwamba kamukana zaekeza kuhula[cite: 1194].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Buñata bwa basali hakuna lichincheho zeo balemuhanga[cite: 1186]. Kono basali babamu babanga nikunyapa mwamba mane ni kulotisa mezi kwa busali[cite: 1186]. Babamu ba lotanga mali kwa busali mwabuinyani[cite: 1187]. Haibanji mikwa ye iba yefitelezi, muima abuze baalafi[cite: 1187].
maternal_changes.tips: Mubili ukena mwa lichincheho[cite: 1196]. Muima uelezwa kuba ni pumulo yeñata ni kucha licho ze matafaza mubili[cite: 1197]. Muima uelezwa kuambuka kwa minahano yemiñata[cite: 1197].
maternal_changes.plan: Lipapali ze matafaza mubili libutokwa ahulu ku muima[cite: 1199]. Lico ze matafaza mubili nizona libutokwa[cite: 1200]. Muima ambuke bucwala, kwai, ni milyani yekola[cite: 1202, 1204, 1205].

baby_development.summary: Mbututu mwamba isali yeinyani[cite: 1217]. Kabutele, ieza libiba za 1.98mm[cite: 1217]. Unani likalulo zetalu; ectoderm (izwelanga pili kuba boko, litalo, milili), mesoderm (izwelanga pili sina pilu, misinga ya mali, masapo), ni endoderm (izwelanga pili sina maswafu, za mwamba, sibiti)[cite: 1218, 1219, 1220]. Mali akala kuzamaya mwa mubili wa mbututu[cite: 1222].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Babamu basali bakona kubonahaza lisupo za mulwalo zeswana sina kunolofala kwa mazwele, kuopa toho, kuopa mukokoto mane cwalo ni kunyembunya[cite: 1212]. Babamu mane basali bona hababangi ni lisupo ze kwanda a kusaya kwa kweli[cite: 1214]. Haiba nji musali kweli imutulile, kikwabutokwa aitatube mulwalo[cite: 1215].
maternal_changes.tips: Haiba nji ausikakala kueza lipapali, uelezwa kuli azibise baalafi[cite: 1224]. Licho zahae liswanela kuba ni milyani ya folic acid[cite: 1225]. Kikwabutokwa kuli sina kamuima ube ni tokomelo kulikana ka milyani yeo unwa[cite: 1226].
maternal_changes.plan: Haiba nji kuya kwa kweli kuliyehile, kikwa butokwa kuli uitatubise mulwalo mwa mushamo[cite: 1229]. Haibanji kufumaneha kuli mulwalo uteni, kikwabutokwa kuli ukopane ni mualafi[cite: 1230].

baby_development.summary: Kanako ye, mbututu isali yomuinyani mi ueza libima ze 3mm[cite: 1242]. Tikanyo yahae itusiswanga kuyofita fa lisunda ze mashumi amabeli[cite: 1244]. Mbututu ye mwamba ibonahalanga feela inge simbotwe[cite: 1245]. Lilama zetobanga meeto ni mazebe zakala kuiponahayahaza hamoho cwalo ni masapo[cite: 1246].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Sizuhela sesitiswa ki mulwalo sikona kutisa minahano yemiñata[cite: 1238]. Lisupo likona kuba mukatalo ni bunolo bwa mazwele[cite: 1239]. Haiba nji muima uipumana inge ataza kuswalelela, uelezwa kuli azibise baalafi[cite: 1240].
maternal_changes.tips: Baalafi ba lakaza muima kuba ni kekezo ya bukiti bobufita fa 11.3kg kufita fa 15.9kgs[cite: 1248].
maternal_changes.plan: Haibanji amusikakopana kale ni baalafi, muelezwa kuli mupange zazi mukopane ni bona[cite: 1250].

baby_development.summary: Kanako ye, mbututu u libima ze kwana 19.05mm[cite: 1262]. Zwelopili ya maswafu, mitahali mane ni ngo lisweli zanga sibaka[cite: 1263]. Mazoho, minwana amoho cwalo ni mahutu zaiponahaza[cite: 1263]. Likalulo za boko nizona zaikalula[cite: 1263].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Baima babamu balemunga kuli baekelize kwa kununa nihaike kuli babamu bakona kulemuha kuli ba fokozi[cite: 1257]. Lichincheho zekona kuiponahaza kazemu ki kununa, bunsu bwa ñolu ya mazwele kapa kululuha kwa yona ñolu[cite: 1258]. Babamu bona bakona kuba ni sungulelwa[cite: 1259].
maternal_changes.tips: Baima babañata babulaelanga kuli milwani yebafilwe kwa sipatela ibautwisanga butuku mwamba[cite: 1265]. Haibanji matata akeza, kikwa butokwa kuli muikambote ni mualafi[cite: 1267].
maternal_changes.plan: Kikwabutokwa kuziba mufuta wa mali ahao amoho cwalo nia muuna ahao[cite: 1269]. Mifuta ya mali kiyemine; A, B, AB, O[cite: 1270, 1271, 1272, 1273].

baby_development.summary: Mbututu kanako ye ukulubelwa kuba fa libima za 2.54cm mwa butelele[cite: 1284]. Lilama zamubili kaufeela litukufalezwi kubupeha[cite: 1284]. Milili, liñobyo ni lulimi nizona zakala ku bupeha[cite: 1285].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Kushama swalele nikona ki sisupo sesiñwi sa mulwalo mwa lisunda zapili[cite: 1279]. Kushama kwa kutiswa ki mulwalo osweli kusina sinya[cite: 1280]. Mwanako ye, muima ubanga yanuna kapa kufokola[cite: 1282].
maternal_changes.tips: Zemuswanela kueza kuli mutuse kukusufaza kunyembunya; kucha licho mwabuinyani hañata [cite: 1288], kucha bubeke kakusasana [cite: 1289], kupumula katata ni kulobala[cite: 1291].
maternal_changes.plan: Haibanji amusikabe mukopana ni baalafi, ki hande kuli mubonane nibona[cite: 1296].

baby_development.summary: Mbututu isali yo muinyani ka libima zeeza 2.54cm[cite: 1307]. Kanako ye, zeo kaufela zeli ku yomuhulu liteni niku mbututu[cite: 1308]. Lilama za buuna kapa busali halisika bonahala kale[cite: 1309].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Usikaitwala kale zwalo yahao neilikana feela inge ñindi yahao, kono fa keiekeza maswe[cite: 1304]. Mazwele niona a nolofala, se kibuitukiso bwa kuanyisa[cite: 1305]. Chincheho yemu kikuekeza kwa mali mwa mubili[cite: 1305].
maternal_changes.tips: Baima babamu babanga ni tutombo kwa sifateho mane cwalo ni kususuma kokufitelezi[cite: 1311].
maternal_changes.plan: Hauya kwa sipimo, baalafi bakakubuza kaza; buiketo bwahao, lupepo lwahao, zazi la mafelezo leo nemuinzi kwa kweli, ni milyani yemunwa[cite: 1314, 1315, 1316, 1318].

baby_development.summary: Mbututu unani libima zefita fa 4.24cm[cite: 1335]. Seabonahala inge mutu kakuli muhata kaufela keuyunda[cite: 1330]. Pilu ya mbututu niyona cwale yakala kuikaba mwa limpanko zayona ze ne[cite: 1332].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Wakona kuba ni sizuhela, sungulelwa nikuikutwa kutameha mba[cite: 1328]. Ukona kuisileleza kwa sungulelwa kakuchanga lico zeinyani[cite: 1329]. Basali babañata bafumananga butata bwa kupalelwa kuya kwa mutabani[cite: 1325].
maternal_changes.tips: Mulwalo aufita fa, muima ukona kuba yaikutwa kufenyeha maswe[cite: 1337]. Sesikona kutiswa ki lichincheho za milyani mwa mubili amoho cwalo ni kusalobala ka swanelo[cite: 1337].
maternal_changes.plan: Haibanji munani lilimo ze fitelela 35, mubone mualafi kuamana kazamatuku a zamaya mwa masika[cite: 1340].

baby_development.summary: Mbututu yamina isali yeinyani ka libima zeeza 5.08cm mwa butelele[cite: 1350]. A kona mafeelelezo a buinyani bwa mbututu (embryonic stage), sesitama kiyemo sesimu seo lilama likala feela kuhula (fetal stage)[cite: 1351, 1352]. Manala akwa mazoho nikwa mahutu amoho cwalo ni milili likalanga kubonahalanga mwa sunda ona ye[cite: 1355].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Zwalo yamina iekelize kuhula[cite: 1346]. Baima babamu bakona kuikumusa ni kubulela za mulwalo wabona[cite: 1347]. Mwa myamyata ima? Basali babamu banana milwalo yemyamyata mwa likweli zapili[cite: 1344].
maternal_changes.tips: Kapa nji neu beleka usikaitwala kale kapa neusabeleki, kubutokwa kuli ubuzi kelezo kwabaalafi[cite: 1358]. Baelezanga baima kuzamaya kappa mane kunyeluka[cite: 1359].
maternal_changes.plan: Bupoti bwa bubeli bwakwa sipatela bukaezwa mwahala ali sunde ze 12 ni 16[cite: 1361]. Mwa bupoti bo, mualafi wakona kueza ultrasound kuli ubone mwana ahao[cite: 1362].

baby_development.summary: Mbututu kanako ye, unani buima bobufita fa 6.35 mwa butelele mi uakalezwa kuli unani bukiti bobufita fa 14.17 grams[cite: 1375]. Toho ya mbututu inani seemba sesituna mwa butelele[cite: 1376]. Minwana yakwa mazoho niya kwa mahutu mwasunda mo ibile iabani kale[cite: 1376].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Mbututu wamina anze ahula mwa zwalo, mubili wamabomahe wabonahanga lichincheho[cite: 1371]. Babamu lichincheho ibanga mwa mili, manalana akwa mazoho mane ni manala akwa mahutu[cite: 1372].
maternal_changes.tips: Hakubile hakuna matata abonahalile kwa mulwalo, muima wakona ku mwa musipili nako ifi kamba ifi[cite: 1379].
maternal_changes.plan: Haibanji mwa lisunda zapili nebitehile ki kukula kwa kakusasani, muakalezwa kuli mufiokozi[cite: 1383]. Nemufokozi, musike mwa bilaela[cite: 1383].

baby_development.summary: Mbututu yamina ikaekeza kubonahala inge mutu[cite: 1395]. Meeto ni mazebe lika suta katata kutaha mwa sibaka seoaswanela kuba teñi[cite: 1395]. Lipiyo za mbututu cwale zakona kukala kumina miluto[cite: 1396].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Zwalo yamina cwale seihulile mi baalafi cwale mane bakona kuibabatela mwatasa amba[cite: 1390]. Litalo lamina likona kuba keli usumfala kappa mane nikuba ni bibali kwa sifateho ni mulala[cite: 1391].
maternal_changes.tips: Buñata bwa basali bafunanga tuso kwalipapali zeamana ni kutisa lilama ze mwa manoka (Kegel exercises)[cite: 1398].
maternal_changes.plan: Yecwale kiyona nako yende yakubata licho zemaatafaza mubili[cite: 1401]. Mukona ku tokomela mubili wamina kakutokolomoha ze mucha[cite: 1403].
