maternal_changes.tips: Wanai nguva yekuzorora yakakwana uye nekudya chikafu chizere. [cite: 56] Shandisai nzira dzekuderedza kusuruwara nekuti hakuna kunakira amai nemwana. [cite: 56]
maternal_changes.plan: Kurovedza muviri kwakanaka panguva yekuzvitakura. [cite: 58] Chikafu chinovaka muviri, folic acid, nema vitamins zvakakosha pakukura kwemwana. [cite: 59] Dzivirirai kutora doro, zvinodhaka, fodya, caffeine, uye imwe mishonga. [cite: 63, 64, 65, 66, 67]

baby_development.summary: Mwana achiri mudiki. [cite: 75] Nhengo dzomuviri dzinogadzirwa muzvikamu zvakasiyana. [cite: 75] Chimwe chikamu chinogadzira uropi, ganda, vhudzi, nemazino; chimwe chogadzira moyo, mabhonzo, nhengo dzesikarudzi; uye chimwe chogadzira mapapu, chiropa, nerwatata. [cite: 76, 77] Makumbo nemaoko avekutanga kuumbika. [cite: 77] Mbereko (placenta) inotanga kugadzira mahormones anosanganisira hCG. [cite: 78]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Unogona kutanga kunzwa kurwadza kwemazamo, musoro, musana, nekuda kurutsa. [cite: 72] Zvakakosha kuziva kuti shanduko zhinji idzi dzakafanana nezvaunonzwa kana uri kumwedzi. [cite: 72] Vamwe vanonzwa shanduko pakuravira nemunhuwi, kufufutirwa, uye kusaenda kuchimbudzi. [cite: 70]
maternal_changes.tips: Kana usati watanga kurovedza muviri, tsvaka rubetsero kubva kuna chiremba. [cite: 80] Mavitamins ne folic acid akakoshera amai nemwana. [cite: 80] Cherechedza mishonga yaunotora, kunyanya yepfari, BP, nemamwe maARVs, nekuti inogona kukanganisa kuumbwa kwemwana. [cite: 81]
maternal_changes.plan: Kana usina kuenda kumwedzi, ongoroora kuti hauna pamuviri here ne pregnancy test. [cite: 84] Kana zvichiratidza kuti une pamuviri, shanyira chiremba kana nyamukuta. [cite: 85] Yave nguva yekutsvaga chiremba kana clinic yekuzoongororwa nhumbu. [cite: 86]

baby_development.summary: Urefu hwemwana hunoyerwa kubva kumusoro kusvika kutsoka (CRL). [cite: 95] Mwoyo wake wakutanga kurova, uye nhengo dzinosanganisira maziso, nzeve nemabhonzo dzinenge dzatanga kugadzirwa. [cite: 95]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Mahormones anokonzera ma'mood swings.' [cite: 91] Unogona kuramba uchinzwa kupera simba nekurwadza kwemazamo. [cite: 91, 92] Kana kurwara kwemangwanani kwakanyanya zvekuti unogara uchirutsa, enda unoona chiremba. [cite: 93]
maternal_changes.tips: Vanachiremba vanokurudzira kuwedzera uremu hwe 11.3-15.9 kg panguva yekuzvitakura. [cite: 97] Vane muviri mudiki vanotarisirwa kuwedzera ne 15.4 kg, uye avo vakasimba ne 9 kg. [cite: 98]
maternal_changes.plan: Inguva yekutanga kuenda kunonyoresa nekuongororwa kukiriniki. [cite: 88] Kana usati waenda, gadzirira kuita saizvozvo. [cite: 100]

baby_development.summary: Mapapu, shaya, mhino, maoko, tsoka nepfungwa zvinenge zvatanga kugadzirwa. [cite: 111] Ongororo ne ultrasound scan inogona kuratidza kuti moyo wave kushanda. [cite: 111]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Vamwe vakadzi vanowedzera kusimba, vamwe vachidzikira. [cite: 106] Mazamu anotanga kurwadza, kuzvimba nekusviba kweminyatso. [cite: 106] Unotanga kunzwa chirungurira. [cite: 106] Vamwe vakadzi vanotanga kubuda ropa; kana ropa rikawanda kana kurwadziwa kukanyanya, unofanira kunoona chiremba. [cite: 107]
maternal_changes.tips: Kana mavitamins achikunzwisa mudumbu, uye marwadzo akanyanya, enda unoona chiremba. [cite: 113]
maternal_changes.plan: Kuziva mhando yeropa rako nere murume wako kwakakosha. [cite: 115]

baby_development.summary: Nhengo dzese dzakakosha dzinenge dzatanga kugadzirwa mumuviri memwana. [cite: 122] Vhudzi, tsiye ne rurimi zvakutanga kugadzirwa. [cite: 128] Magokora nezviguwe zvetsoka zvave kuoneka. [cite: 128]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Muviri unosangana neshanduko dzakasiyana, kusanganisira kusimba, asi vamwe vanogona kudzikira nekuda kwekurwara kwemangwanani. [cite: 125] Izvi zvinoitika kwechinguva. [cite: 126] Unotanga kuenda kuchimbuzi kakawanda. [cite: 123]
maternal_changes.tips: Mazano ekuderedza kurwara kwamangwanani anosanganisira kudya chikafu chishoma nguva zhinji, kuwana kurara kwakakwana, uye kushandisa maremoni netsangamidzi. [cite: 130, 131, 132, 133] Usadya chikafu chine mhiripiri kana mafuta akanyanya. [cite: 135] Tora vitamin B6 (500mg) zuva nezuva. [cite: 136]
maternal_changes.plan: Kana usati wawana chiremba kana nyamukuta, inguva yekumutsvaka. [cite: 140] Kana kurwara kwamangwanani kwakanyanya, enda unoona chiremba. [cite: 141]

baby_development.summary: Nhengo dzake zhinji dzavepo uye dzichiri kuumbwa zvizere. [cite: 150] Mabhonzo, minwe, uye chiso zvirikuumbika. [cite: 150] Rudzi rwemwana runogona kuonekwa, asi nhengo dzesikarudzi dzichiri kugadzirwa. [cite: 151]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Pave neshanduko zhinji mumuviri, kusanganisira kukura kwechibereko nekurwadza kwemazamu, kugadzirira kuzoyamwisa. [cite: 148] Zvimwe zviratidzo zvinosanganisira kupera simba, mood swings, kufufutirwa, uye kuwanda mate mumukanwa. [cite: 146]
maternal_changes.tips: Vamwe vakadzi vanotanga kushanduka ganda nekubuda mapundu kumeso. [cite: 153] Kana pane mishonga yauri kushandisa, ona chiremba. [cite: 153]
maternal_changes.plan: Pakati pemavhiki 8-12, inguva yekuenda kunonyoresa kukiriniki. [cite: 155] Chiremba achakubvunza nezveutano hwenyu, kusanganisira zuva rekupedzisira kuenda kumwedzi, zvirwere, uye mishonga yamuri kutora. [cite: 155, 156, 157, 161] Unotarisira kuongororwa muviri, kuitwa Pap smear, uye ultrasound scan. [cite: 164]

baby_development.summary: Mwana wako anenge akura kunge zambiringa. [cite: 179] Muswe wake unobva pavhiki rechinomwe. [cite: 180, 181] Maziso anenge zvino avapo asi akavhara, achazovhura pavhiki yemakumi maviri nemasere. [cite: 181] Majoints anenge ave kushanda, uye moyo unenge wava nemakamuri mana. [cite: 181, 182] Mwana anogona kugadzira chibhakera uye kutanga kusveta chigunwe. [cite: 182]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Unogona kutanga kuona kuchinja kwemood, chirungurira, nekubudisa mweya muzhinji. [cite: 175] Unogona kuzvidzivirira kubva kuchirungurira nekudya zvishoma zvishoma uye kusiya tsika yekurara uchangopedza kudya. [cite: 176, 177]
maternal_changes.tips: Panguva iyi unotanga kunzwa kuneta zvakanyanya, zvichikonzerwa nekuchinja kwemahormones nekutadza kurara zvakanaka. [cite: 184] Kana usiri kurara zvakanaka, zama kuchinja mativi ekurara nawo. [cite: 185]
maternal_changes.plan: Kana une makore anopfuura 35 kana nhoroondo yezvirwere zve'genetic', enda unoona genetic counsellor. [cite: 187] Taura nachiremba wako nezvemaprenatal tests anosanganisira chorionic villus sampling (CVS), inogona kuitwa pakati pemavhiki 9 ne12. [cite: 188, 189]

baby_development.summary: Mwana wako anenge akura selime. [cite: 199] Apa ndipo panopera 'embryonic period' pachitanga 'fetal period,' apo nhengo dzemuviri dzinoramba dzichikura. [cite: 200] Nhengo zhinji dzakakosha dzakaita seitsvo, chiropa, pfungwa, nemapapu zvinenge zvava kushanda. [cite: 201] Nzara dzezvigunwe nevhudzi zvinenge zvavapo, uye zvigunwe zvisisina kubatana. [cite: 202] Mwana anenge ava kumedza amniotic fluid nekukava-kava. [cite: 203]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Mimba yako inenge ichiramba ichikura asi zvisati zvanyanya kuoneka. [cite: 196] Uchaona kuti mazamo nedumbu rako zvichiwedzera kukura pavhiki nevhiki. [cite: 194] Vamwe vakadzi vanoita kakubwinya ('pregnancy glow'), vamwe vachiita mapundu kumeso. [cite: 193]
maternal_changes.tips: Kunyange une mimba, une zvakawanda zvaunogona kuita kuti ugare uri mutano. [cite: 205] Vana chiremba vakawanda vanokurudzira kufamba-famba nekudhidha. [cite: 206]
maternal_changes.plan: Visiti yechipiri inoitwa pakati pevhiki 12 ne16. [cite: 208] Pavisiti iyi, chiremba wako anogona kuita ultrasound scan kuti uone mwana wako kekutanga. [cite: 208] Vanogona kushandisa Doppler stethoscope kunzwa kurova kwemoyo wemwana. [cite: 209, 210]

baby_development.summary: Musoro wemwana unenge wakura kusvika chidimbu chepakati pakureba kwemwana, uye zvigunwe zvinenge zvapatsanuka. [cite: 223] Ganda remwana rinenge risati raita ruvara uye mabonzo anenge otanga kuomarara. [cite: 224] Nhengo dzesikarudzi dzinenge dzapera kugadzirwa, zvichiita kuti mumavhiki mashoma anotevera muzive kuti mwana mukomana here kana musikana. [cite: 225]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Shanduko pamuviri inogona kunge isati yakuoneka, asi vamwe vakadzi vanoona kuwedzera kukura kwebvudzi nenzwara. [cite: 218] Nekukura kwemimba, marwadzo padumbu anogona kutanga kunzwika. [cite: 215] Uchaonawo zvinoerera kubva munzira yemwana (leukorrhea). [cite: 216]
maternal_changes.tips: Kushanya hakuna tsaona kumimba kana pasina zvinetswa. [cite: 229] Kurudziro iri pakushanya kana mimba yave mutrimester yepiri, sezvo morning sickness inenge yapfuura. [cite: 230]
maternal_changes.plan: Vakadzi vazhinji vanowedzera nemapounds matatu kana mana (1.3 kusvika 1.8 kg) mu first trimester. [cite: 233] Gwara revakoti rinokurudzira kuwedzera kwehuremu nemapound 25 kusvika 35 (11.3 kusvika 15.9 kg). [cite: 234, 235]

baby_development.summary: Mwana anotanga kuva nemuonekero wemunhu sezvo nzeve nemaziso zvinoenda panzvimbo. [cite: 246] Matumbu anokura zvekupinda murukuvhute asi anozodzokera mudumbu. [cite: 247] Itsvo dzakukwanisa kugadzira weti, uye uropi huri kuramba huchikwenenzverwa. [cite: 248]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Chibereko chinokura zvekuti mukoti anokwanisa kuchinzwa chiri muzasi medumbu. [cite: 242] Hembe dzinogona dzakusachikwana. [cite: 242] Muchaona shanduko muganda, sekusviba kweganda remuromo wemazamu uye mavara pameso nepahuro (chloasma). [cite: 243, 244] Tsinga dzeropa dzinoonekera paganda. [cite: 240]
maternal_changes.tips: Munokurudzirwa kuita maexercise anonzi maKegel, ayo anosimbisa nyama dzinogadzira nzira yemwana, zvichiita kuti kubatsirwa kuve nyore. [cite: 250]
maternal_changes.plan: Ongororai chikafu chamunodya kuti muve nechokwadi chine utano hwakakwana. [cite: 253] Munhu ane mimba haakurudzirwe kuwedzera huremu zvakapfurikidza. [cite: 254] Dzivirirai kudya mafast foods, junk foods, uye zvine mafuta akawandisa. [cite: 255, 257]

baby_development.summary: Musoro wemwana uchiri wakakurira dzimwe nhengo dzemuviri. [cite: 270] Zvigunwe zvemwana zvine zvidhindwa (fingerprints). [cite: 259] Itsvo nenzira yeweti zvakushanda zvakanaka. [cite: 270] Ganda remwana rinenge rakaputirwa nevhudzi rinonzi 'lanugo.' [cite: 271]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Mavanga ekuzvitakura (stretch marks) anogona kuoneka padumbu, mazamu, muchiuno, kana magadziko. [cite: 265] Kurwara kwemakuseni kunoderera, asi nyongo inogona kuwedzera. [cite: 265] Mazamu anowedzera kukura uye anonzwika mapundu mukati nekuda kwekunyma dzinogadzira mukaka. [cite: 266] Mukaka wekutanga (colostrum) unotanga kugadzirwa. [cite: 267]
maternal_changes.tips: Vakadzi vazhinji vanoita mavanga ekuzvitakura. [cite: 273] Kuwedzera huremu zvishoma nezvishoma kunobatsira kuti asakurumidze kubuda. [cite: 274] Kuzora mafuta ane vitamin E kunobatsirawo. [cite: 275] Musashandise zvizorwa kana mishonga musina kupangwa mazano neVakoti. [cite: 277] Rambai muchitora Folic Acid neFerrous Iron Sulphate. [cite: 279]
maternal_changes.plan: Bonde rakanaka kuita panguva iyi sezvo mwana akachengetedzeka mudumbu. [cite: 281, 282, 283] Asi rinokurudzirwa kuregedzwa kana makambobva nhumbu, maputika shupa, kana mune zvirwere zvepabonde. [cite: 283, 287, 288, 292]

baby_development.summary: Maoko emwana akurebenuka achienderana nemuviri wake. [cite: 303] Chiropa chakutanga kugadzira nduru, uye spleen inotanga kugadzira red blood cells. [cite: 304] Uropi hwagadzirika zvekuti mwana anokwanisa kufambisa kumeso kana kusvisvina chigunwe. [cite: 305] Mukana wekurasikirwa nemimba unoderera panguva iyi. [cite: 306]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Munogona kunge makusakwana zvipfeko zvemazuva ose. [cite: 298] Kukura kwemuviri kunoenderana nekuti imimba yekutanga here; kana makambozvitakura, mimba inokurumidza kuonekera. [cite: 299, 300] Vakazvitakura vazhinji vanoti kuda kwavo kwechikafu kunowedzera, pamwe nesimba nekuda bonde. [cite: 295]
maternal_changes.tips: Mhopo dzinokwanisa kutanga kana kuwedzera kukura panguva iyi. [cite: 308] Munokurudzirwa kuti mutariswe naChiremba kana zvikaitika. [cite: 308]
maternal_changes.plan: Munokwanisa kutanga kuita mamoods, asi musashushikana nekuti zvinotarisirwa. [cite: 316] Zvichengetedzei uye tsvagai nzira dzine hutano dzekuzvidzivirira kubva mukushushikana. [cite: 323]

baby_development.summary: Ganda remwana richiri dete uye tsinga dzeropa dzinokwanisa kuonekwa. [cite: 335] Nzeve dzakutanga kuumbika, uye maziso akubva kumativi emusoro achiuya padhuze. [cite: 336] Mabonzo akutanga kuomarara, uye mwana anenge akuchiyamwa chigunwe. [cite: 337, 338]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Munotarisirwa kunge mawedzera huremu nemakilogram 2.27. [cite: 330] Munogona kunzwa chibereko chenyu chakura kusvika 10-12 cm pazasi peguvhu. [cite: 332] Zvimwe zviitiko zvinosanganisira kuvhara kwemhino, kurwadza kwemakumbo, nematadza anorwadza. [cite: 327]
maternal_changes.tips: Zvinokurudzirwa kuti murare nerutivi, kunyanya rweruboshwe. [cite: 340] Kurara nemusana kunoita kuti chibereko chitsimbiridze tsinga dzeropa, uye kurara nedumbu hakukurudzirwe. [cite: 343, 344] Shandisai zvitsamiro kuti zvibatsire. [cite: 345]
maternal_changes.plan: Chiremba wenyu achatanga kuyera 'fundal height,' kureba kwechikamu chiri pakati pebonzo remuchiuno nepamusoro pechibereko, kuti aone kukura kwemimba. [cite: 348, 349, 350]

baby_development.summary: Mwana akuda kupinda munguva yekukura nekukasika. [cite: 364] Musoro wake watwasanuka, uye nzeve nemaziso zvave panzvimbo. [cite: 364] Nhengo dzakawanda, kusanganisira itsvo nenzira yeweti, dzave kushanda. [cite: 365] Moyo wemwana unofambisa malitre 23.70 eropa pazuva. [cite: 365]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Chibereko chiri kuramba chichikura uye chave kurema 0.25 kg. [cite: 358] Huhwandu hweropa mumuviri hunowedzera ne 30-50%, zvichiita kuti meso apenye. [cite: 360] Muviri unogadzirawo mahormones anoita kuti ganda ribude mafuta akawanda. [cite: 361]
maternal_changes.tips: Munotanga kunzwa mwana achifamba pakati pevhiki 16 ne22. [cite: 367] Munokurudzirwa kurara nedivi panguva iyi, uye musarara nemusana. [cite: 368, 369]
maternal_changes.plan: Muchasangana naChiremba, uye munogona kunzi muitwe matest anosanganisira Ultrasound, Alpha-Feta Protein (AFP), Triple test, neAmniocentesis. [cite: 372, 373, 374, 375, 376]

baby_development.summary: Rukuvhute rwemwana riri kureba nekukora. [cite: 392] Mwana akutanga kunzwa sezvo nzeve dzagadzirwa uye dzave panzvimbo. [cite: 393] Mwana anotangawo kuunganidza mafuta mumuviri anobatsira kuchengetedza tembiricha. [cite: 394]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Dumbu riri kuramba richikura uye dzimwe nhengo dzemukati dzinotsaurwa kugadzira nzvimbo. [cite: 387] Muchange muchirwadziwa nemusana uye munogona kuita hanganwa. [cite: 385]
maternal_changes.tips: Munogona kunzwa marwadzo mumakumbo anonzi 'sciatic nerve pain.' [cite: 396] Marwadzo aya anounzwa nekutsimbiridzwa kwetsinga iyi nechibereko chiri kukura. [cite: 398] Kuita maexercise kunobatsira. [cite: 398]
maternal_changes.plan: Maallergy enyu anogona kuwedzera. [cite: 400] Kurukurai naChiremba musati matora mushonga upi neupi. [cite: 401]

baby_development.summary: Tsinga dzemagetsi dzemuviri wemwana dziri kuputirwa ne'myelin.' [cite: 413] Kana mwana ari musikana, chibereko nematube ave panzvimbo. [cite: 414] Kana ari mukomana, nhengo dzesikarudzi dzinogona kuoneka paultrasound. [cite: 415]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Maumbirwo emuviri akuramba achishanduka zvinoita kuti vazhinji vaone kuti makazvitakura. [cite: 407] Panewo shanduko isingaoneki, sekudzikira kweblood pressure. [cite: 408] Simukai zvishoma nezvishoma kuti musaite dzungu. [cite: 409, 410] Tarisirai kuwedzera huremu kusvika pamunobatsirwa. [cite: 406]
maternal_changes.tips: Vakadzi vazhinji vakazvitakura havakwanisi kupedza zuva vasina kurara. [cite: 417] Edzai kuronga nguva yekuzorora pakati pezuva. [cite: 418]
maternal_changes.plan: Muri kutarisira kuenda kunoonekwa naChiremba kechitatu. [cite: 424] Muchaitwa sonogram kana level II sonogram, inotarisa makuriro emwana zvakadzama. [cite: 425] Muchaitwawo ongororo inonzi Maternal Serum Alpha-Fetoprotein Screening (MSAFP). [cite: 426]

baby_development.summary: Itsvo dzinenge dzava kugadzira weti uye vhudzi rinenge rava kumera mumusoro wemwana. [cite: 440] Nzvimbo dzepfungwa dzinoita nezvekunzwa nekuona dzinenge dzarongeka. [cite: 441] Kana mwana ari musikana, anenge atova nemazai anosvika mamirioni matanhatu. [cite: 441]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Kurwadza kweround ligament kunowanikwa pasecond trimester, kunonzwikwa sedumbu kana patsandanyama. [cite: 434] Vamwe vakadzi vanoita chirungurira nekuti mahormones anokanganisa zvivharo zvemudumbu. [cite: 430] Constipation inogona kuitikawo. [cite: 432]
maternal_changes.tips: Dzungu panguva yekuzvitakura rinokonzerwa ne'hypotension' (low blood pressure). [cite: 443] Rinopedzwa nekurara nedivi uye kusimuka zvishoma nezvishoma. [cite: 444, 445]
maternal_changes.plan: Nekuti wava nepamuviri, zvakanaka kungwarira pakushandisa mishonga yechivanhu. [cite: 447] Tinokurudzira kuti usatore mishonga iyi usati wataurirana nachiremba wako. [cite: 448]

baby_development.summary: Mwana wako anenge akaputirwa nezvinhu zvichena zvinonzi 'vernix caseosa,' zvinobatsira kuchengetedza ganda rake. [cite: 460] Zvinobatsirawo kufamba kwemwana munzira yaanobuda nayo. [cite: 461] Mwana anenge ava kutanga kugadzira tsvina yake yekutanga (meconium). [cite: 462]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Kumusoro kwemimba yako kwava nechepaguvhudende. [cite: 455] Panguva iyi, unogona kunge wawedzera kurema ne 4.5kg. [cite: 455] Tarisira kuwedzera ne 0.23 to 0.45kg pavhiki. [cite: 456] Chiveve, kuzvimba maoko nemakumbo, nekuoma kwemaziso zvinowanzoitika. [cite: 453]
maternal_changes.tips: Rangarira kuti zvakakosha kuwana iron yakakwana, iyo inobatsira kugadzira 'haemoglobin' uye kudzivirira 'anemia.' [cite: 466] Unofanira kutora 27-30mg pazuva. [cite: 466] Iron inowanikwa munyama tsvuku, nyama yenguruve, bhinzi, uye spinach. [cite: 467, 468, 469, 470]
maternal_changes.plan: Iyi inguva yekutanga kufunga nezvekuzvarwa kwemwana wako. [cite: 476] Zama kunyora pfungwa dzako neurongwa hwako mubhuku kuti zvikubatsire kuzivisa zvaunoda kune vachamira newe. [cite: 478]

baby_development.summary: Hurefu hwemwana hwava kutorwa kubva kumusoro kusvika pachitsitsinho (CHL). [cite: 491] Ma'eyelids' emwana anopera kugadzirwa panguva iyi, uye anenge achitamba achimedza 'amniotic fluid.' [cite: 493] Matumbu emwana anoramba achikura. [cite: 494] Kana mwana ari musikana, nhengo yake inenge yagadzirwa asi inoramba ichinatsiridzwa. [cite: 495]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Mukabata pamusoro peguvhu, mogona kunzwa chibereko chenyu. [cite: 487] Mukaona makumbo netsoka zvichizvimba, edzai kuwana nguva yekugara nekuzorora. [cite: 488] Zvakakosha kutariswa BP yenyu mazuva ose nekuda kwe'pre-eclampsia.' [cite: 485] Mukanzwa kutemwa nemusoro kana kuzvimba muviri, endai kuchipatara nekukasika. [cite: 485]
maternal_changes.tips: UTI (chirwere chenzira yeweti) chinowanda muvanhu vakazvitakura. [cite: 497] Munogona kuchidzivirira nekunwa magirazi 6-8 emvura mazuva ose uye kuzvipukuta kubva kumberi kuenda kumashure. [cite: 499]
maternal_changes.plan: Pamunenge muchiwedzera kusimba, munogona kuona muchizvimba tsinga dzeropa ('varicose veins'), zvinowanzoitika mumakumbo nepanhengo yechidzimai. [cite: 503]

baby_development.summary: Mwana wenyu akuratidzika sekamucheche kunyangwe achiri mudiki. [cite: 515] Ganda rake rinenge richakaregedzera nekuti haasati asimba zvakanyanya. [cite: 516] Maziso anenge agadzirwa, asi 'iris' inenge isati yavepo. [cite: 516, 517] Rwatata rwurkuramba rwuchikura. [cite: 517]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Munogona kunzwa chibereko chenyu 2cm pamusoro peguvhu renyu. [cite: 513] Pamuviri panokonzera kuti bvudzi rikore nekupenya uye nzara dzikasike kukura. [cite: 510] Ganda repadumbu rinogona kuoma nekurwadza. [cite: 511]
maternal_changes.tips: Madzimai mazhinji vanotanga kufunganya kuti vanogona kukasira kutanga kugomera. [cite: 519] Ongororo inonzi 'Fetal fibronectin (fFN)' inogona kuitwa. [cite: 520] Kana 'fibronectin' ikaonekwa mumvura dzemunzira yemwana pama vhiki ari pakati pe 22 ne 38, zvinogona kuratidza njodzi yekukasira kugomera. [cite: 522]
maternal_changes.plan: Tsvagai vanopa dzidziso dzezvekuzvibatsira. [cite: 525] Edzai kupedza zvidzidzo izvi vhiki re 37 risati rapera. [cite: 526]

baby_development.summary: Mwana arikuwedzera kusimba. [cite: 538] Bvudzi riri paganda ('lanugo') richatanga kusvibira, zvoita kuti rioneke pa'ultrasound scan.' [cite: 538] Mwana wenyu akutaridzika sekamucheche. [cite: 538]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Chibereko chenyu chakura kusvika 3.8cm kubva paguvhu, uye mawedzera kurema ne 5.4kg - 6.8kg. [cite: 533] Chibereko chakagara pamusoro pedundira, zvinogona kukonzera kuti weti ibude yega. [cite: 534] Mvura yekuputika shupa haina hwema; kana mukafungidzira kuti haisi weti, fonerai vanoona nezveutano. [cite: 535, 536]
maternal_changes.tips: Kunwa mvura yakawanda kwakakosha. [cite: 540] Kana muchinwa mvura yakakwana, weti yenyu inenge yakacheneruka. [cite: 542] Izvi zvinobatsira kudzivirira kutemwa nemusoro, kurwadza kwechibereko, nehosha yenzira yeweti. [cite: 543, 544]
maternal_changes.plan: Kana muchishanda, munofanira kunge makupedzisa kugadzirisa mapepa ezororo. [cite: 546] Munofanira kuudzwa nezvekodzero dzenyu panguva yekuzvitakura. [cite: 547] Zvakakosha kukurukura nemurume wenyu kuti ndiani achachengeta mwana kana madzokera kubasa. [cite: 549]

baby_development.summary: Pfungwa dzemwana dziri kukura chaizvo. [cite: 560] Ma'taste buds' ave kugadzirwawo, uye mapapu arikuumba zvakakomba. [cite: 560] Mushonga unonzi 'surfactant' unobatsira mapapu kupinza mweya uri kugadzirwawo. [cite: 561]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Munogona kunzwa chibereko chenyu 5cm pamusoro peguvhu. [cite: 555] Ganda repadumbu nepamazamu rinotatamuka, zvichikonzera kutswinya. [cite: 555] Shandisai mafuta ekuzora. [cite: 556] Maziso enyu anogonawo kuoma kana kurwadza. [cite: 557]
maternal_changes.tips: Kana muchiita dambudziko rechirungurira, munofanira kudya kashoma kashoma. [cite: 563] Kuregedza kudyira dyira kana kudya mave kuda kurara kunobatsirawo. [cite: 563]
maternal_changes.plan: Pakati pevhiki 24 ne 28, vanoona nezveutano vanoongorora shuga yenyu muropa. [cite: 565] Ongororo iyi inoona kana mune chirwere cheshuga chepamuviri, icho chinokonzerwa nekutadza kushanda kwe'insulin.' [cite: 566]

baby_development.summary: Mwana ari kusimba, izvo zvinoita kuti ganda rake risanuke. [cite: 578] Kana mwana aine bvudzi, ruvara rwacho runenge rwava kuoneka. [cite: 579] Kuona kuti mwana mukomana here kana musikana kunogona kuitwa ne'ultrasound' kana 'NIPT' (noninvasive prenatal testing). [cite: 580, 581]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Chibereko chenyu chakura kunge bhora renhabvu, uye pamusoro pacho pasvika pakati peguvhu nebhonzo rinobatanidza mbabvu. [cite: 576] Munogona kunzwa chiveve mumaoko, chinonzi 'carpal tunnel syndrome,' chichikonzerwa nekuzvimba nekuwanda kwemvura mumuviri. [cite: 574]
maternal_changes.tips: Munofanira kutanga kufunga nezvezita rekupa mwana. [cite: 585] Zvibvunzei kuti mungade mazita ake atange nemavara api, uye kana paine mazita emadunhurirwa angabve pazita iri. [cite: 588, 589]
maternal_changes.plan: Munogona kunzwa kuda kuchengeta mifananidzo ye'ultrasound,' asi zvinogona kuva nenjodzi kuutano. [cite: 592] Munofanira kupihwa mvumo nachiremba kuti mutorwe 'ultrasound scan.' [cite: 592]

baby_development.summary: Tsinga dzemagetsi dzemunzeve dzave kugadzirwa, dzichibatsira kuti mwana atange kunzwa. [cite: 604] Mwana achiri kumedza 'amniotic fluid,' izvo zvinobatsira kugadzira mapapu. [cite: 604] Kana mwana ari mukomana, mabhora ake akutanga kudzika kwaanogara. [cite: 604]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Chibereko chenyu chave kusvika 6.3cm kubva paguvhu. [cite: 599] Panguva yasara, pamuviri penyu panenge pachikura 1.25cm pavhiki. [cite: 599] Munogona kunge mawedzera kurema ne 7.25-10kg. [cite: 600] Kana kutswinya kwakanyanya, munofanira kuona chiremba nekuti zvinogona kunge zviri 'cholestasis of pregnancy.' [cite: 597]
maternal_changes.tips: Munokurudzirwa kudya derere, rine macalories mashoma nema vitamins mazhinji. [cite: 606] Rinobatsira kuti musaite tsvina yakaomarara. [cite: 607] Beans dzine maproteins akawanda uye 'folic acid,' 'iron,' nezvimwe zvakakosha. [cite: 608]
maternal_changes.plan: Pamuchanoonekwa, gadzirirai kuongororwa ropa, masoja emuviri ('Rh factor'), ne 'glucose tolerance test' kutarisa chirwere cheshuga. [cite: 611, 612, 613, 614]

baby_development.summary: Mwana akugona kuvhara nekuvhura maziso ake. [cite: 631] Ave nenguva yekurara nekumuka, iyo ingasiyana neyenyu. [cite: 631] Munogona kunzwa munhikwi wemwana, izvo zvinoitika uye zvisingafanire kutyiwa. [cite: 632]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Panguva ino, makunzwa mwana achitamba zvikuru. [cite: 627] Pamavhiki anotevera, munogona kuzonzi muverenge kuti arikutamba kangani. [cite: 627] Pamusoro pekurwadziwa musana nemakumbo, vamwe vakadzi vanoita 'haemorrhoids.' [cite: 624]
maternal_changes.tips: Kana muine mota, munokurudzirwa kutenga chigaro chemwana chemumota. [cite: 634] Mucherechedze kuti chinoenderana nemota yenyu uye chakanatsogadzikwa. [cite: 635]
maternal_changes.plan: Kana manga musati matanga zvidzidzo zvekubatsirwa nekurera mucheche, munokurudzirwa kuti mutange. [cite: 637] Munofanira kunge mapedza zvidzidzo izvi vhiki re 37 risati rapera. [cite: 637]

baby_development.summary: Pfungwa dzemwana dzave kuita mihomba mihomba. [cite: 652] Kukura kwepfungwa kunowedzera. [cite: 653] Ma 'eyebrows' nema 'eyelashes' zvave kuoneka, uye bvudzi riri kuramba richikura. [cite: 653] Mwana ari kuramba achisimbasimba sezvo ari kuita mafuta pasi peganda. [cite: 653]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Panoperera chibereko pave kusvika 8.9cm kana kupfuura pamusoro peguvhu. [cite: 647] Munogona kunge mawedzera kusimba ne 7.7-10.8kg. [cite: 647] Madzimai mazhinji anotanga kurwadziwa makumbo, kuita tsvina yakaomarara, kushaya hope, nema 'haemorrhoids.' [cite: 648] Mwana anogona kurarama kana akazvarwa kubva pavhiki rino nerubatsiro rwe ICU. [cite: 643] Kubuda ropa pashure pemavhiki 28 kunogona kukonzerwa ne 'placenta previa,' iyo inoisa njodzi kuna amai nemwana. [cite: 643]
maternal_changes.tips: Zvakanaka kutanga kugadzirira rwendo rwekuenda kunobatsirwa kuchipatara. [cite: 655] Ngwarirai kuti mugare nenhamba dzerunhare dzemurume wenyu, uye gadziriraiwo nzira dzekuenda kuchipatara. [cite: 656, 657]
maternal_changes.plan: Pamuchaenda kunoongororwa, gadzirirai kupihwa 'Rhogam' kana muine 'Rh factor.' [cite: 661] Pachavewo nehurukuro pamusoro pekucherechedza kutamba kwemwana, zvidzidzo zvekubatsirwa, uye kusarudza pakati pekuyamwisa kana kushandisa bhodhoro. [cite: 662, 663]

baby_development.summary: Mwana wako ava kukura nekukasika. [cite: 677] Musoro wake uri kuramba uchikura nekuda kwekukura kwepfungwa. [cite: 677, 678] Mhasuro nemapapu zviri kuramba zvichikura. [cite: 678]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Kurema kwako kunenge kwawedzera ne 8.6-11.3kg. [cite: 672] Kumusoro kwechibereko chako kunenge kuri 8.9-10cm kubva paguvhu. [cite: 672] Constipation inogona kukonzera marwadzo mudumbu. [cite: 673] 'Colostrum,' mukaka wekutanga, unogona kutanga kubuda mumazamu. [cite: 669]
maternal_changes.tips: 'Dawa community healthcare worker' anobatsira mai kuti vazvare zvakanaka. [cite: 683] Vanokushanyira kakawanda uye vanouya kuzokuona pachavo. [cite: 685, 687]
maternal_changes.plan: Kuti udzivirire 'constipation,' idya zvikafu zvine 'fibre,' imwa mvura yakawanda, uye ita ma'exercises.' [cite: 690, 691, 692] Dzikisa kana kumira kutora 'iron supplement.' [cite: 694]

baby_development.summary: Maziso emwana anenge akura, uye anenge ava kuziva musiyano wechiedza nerima. [cite: 709] Vana vepavhiki 30 vanogona kutevera chiedza nemaziso avo. [cite: 710] Vachangozvarwa vanogona kungotarisa zvinhu zviri mainches mashoma kubva kumeso kwavo. [cite: 711]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Unogona kutanga kunzwa kukurumidza kuneta. [cite: 701] Kana uri kutadza kurara, unogona kunoona chiremba wako. [cite: 702] Muviri wako unenge uchigadzira mahormones anoita kuti majoints apere simba, izvo zvinogona kuita kuti tsoka dzikure. [cite: 703, 704]
maternal_changes.tips: Iyi inguva yekufunga nezvenzira dzekupodza marwadzo dzaungawana panguva yekuzvara. [cite: 714] Ita tsvakurudzo yako wega kuti uite sarudzo ine uchenjeri. [cite: 715] Nzira dziripo dzinosanganisira 'natural childbirth,' 'local anesthesia' (epidural), 'narcotics,' uye 'patterned breathing.' [cite: 718, 719, 20, 722]
maternal_changes.plan: Vakadzi vakawanda vanochema nekurwadziwa nemusana panguva iyi. [cite: 714] Funga nezvenzira dzekupodza marwadzo paunozvara. [cite: 714]

baby_development.summary: Mwana ari kuramba achiwedzera uremu nekukura. [cite: 735] Mafuta ari pasi peganda rake arikuwedzera, izvo zvinomupa chitarisiko chemwana achangoberekwa. [cite: 736] Pakuzvarwa, vana vazhinji vanenge vave kurema 3-3.4kg. [cite: 736]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Munogona kuona mukaka wekutanga ('colostrum') uchibuda mumazamu. [cite: 729] Munogona kushandisa 'nurse pads' kuti usatotesa hembe. [cite: 730] 'Braxton Hicks contractions' (kumonya kwechibereko) dzinoitika kwechinguva chipfupi, uye dzinoita kuti chibereko chigadzirire kuzvara. [cite: 731, 732] Zvimwe zviratidzo zvekutanga kwenhumbu zvinogona kudzoka. [cite: 727]
maternal_changes.tips: 'Haemorrhoids' dzinowanzoitika pachikamu chechitatu chekuzvitakura. [cite: 740] Munogona kuzvirapa nekushandisa 'baking soda,' kugeza mumvura inodziya, kana kushandisa 'lemon juice.' [cite: 742, 743, 745] Zvinonyanyobatsira kudzivirira 'constipation.' [cite: 748]
maternal_changes.plan: Inguva yakanaka yekuongorora kana muchazoda kuyamwisa kana kushandisa bhodhoro. [cite: 750] Munogonawo kukurukura nachiremba nezvekuchengeta 'cord blood' yemwana. [cite: 750]

baby_development.summary: Zvigunwe zvemumaoko nemutsoka zvaumbwa. [cite: 760] Mapapu achiri kukura. [cite: 760] Mabhonzo emuviri avepo, kunyange asati anyatsosimba. [cite: 760]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Chibereko chenyu chinenge chakura 12cm kudarika pamusoro peguvhu. [cite: 756] Kukura uku kunogona kukonzera chirungurira nekukufemerai. [cite: 756] Muviri uri kuwedzera huremu hunosvika 0.5kg vhiki rega rega. [cite: 757]
maternal_changes.tips: Zvimwe zvingabatsire kuderedza 'Braxton Hicks contractions' zvinosanganisira kushandura chimiro, kugeza nemvura inodziya, uye kunwa mvura kana mukaka. [cite: 763, 764, 765, 766, 767]
maternal_changes.plan: Kana pasina zvikonzero, manga muchiona chiremba mwedzi wega wega, asi izvi zvinogona kushanduka kuita mavhiki maviri ega ega. [cite: 770, 771] Mukufamba kwenguva, munogona kutanga kuenda vhiki rega rega. [cite: 772]

baby_development.summary: Mabhonzo emuviri ari kuita achisimba. [cite: 787]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Muviri wenyu unenge wawedzera ne 10-12kg. [cite: 782] Kana shupa ikaputika, munoona tumvura tunoerera nemumakumbo. [cite: 783, 784] Kana mvura iyi ichinhuwa kana kuva neruvara, zvinogona kuratidza 'infection,' saka kurumidzai kuzivisa chiremba. [cite: 785]
maternal_changes.tips: Hapana chingakutadzisei kuenda pabonde kana muine mimba, kunze kwekunge paine chikonzero chamunenge maudzwa nachiremba. [cite: 789]
maternal_changes.plan: Munogona kukurukura nachiremba nezve 'episiotomy' (kuchekwa panzira inobuda nemwana). [cite: 775] Mazuva ano, 'episiotomy' haichanyanyo kushandiswa. [cite: 791] Zvingabatsire kuti musaitwe 'episiotomy' zvinosanganisira kudya kwakakwana, 'Kigels,' uye kupuruzira imba yechibereko. [cite: 792, 793, 794, 797]

baby_development.summary: Mafuta emuviri wemwana arikuwedzera, izvo zvinozobatsira kuchengetedza kudziya kwemuviri wake achinge azvarwa. [cite: 805] Pfungwa dzake dzichiri kuumbwa. [cite: 806] Mwana akazvarwa panguva ino (gavamwedzi) anokwanisa kurarama. [cite: 806]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Chibereko chenyu chinenge chakura 14cm kudarika pamusoro peguvhu. [cite: 802] Munogona kuona guvhu rave kunyanya kubudikira; munogona kushandisa kabhandeji kana tepi kurivhara. [cite: 803]
maternal_changes.tips: Danho rekutanga regomero rinotanga kusvika muromo wechibereko wavhurika kusvika pa 10cm. [cite: 808] Danho rechipiri nderekuzvarwa kwemwana, uye danho rechitatu nderekubuditsa chevakuru. [cite: 811]
maternal_changes.plan: Panguva ino, chiremba wenyu anokurukura nemi nezve 'Group B strep infection,' mazuva ekuonekwa, uye mishonga yamungade pakugomera. [cite: 813, 814, 815, 817]

baby_development.summary: Kukura kwake kwave kutotsaruka. [cite: 830] Itsvo dzanyatsokura, uye chiropa chave kutanga kushanda. [cite: 830] Kutamba kwake hakufaniri kushanduka, kunyange nzvimbo yave shoma. [cite: 831]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Muviri hauchanyanyo kuwedzera huremu; unenge wawedzera ne 10.9-13.2kg. [cite: 825] Kushaya hope kunogona kutanga. [cite: 826] Kufemereka pamusoro kunodzikira kana mwana adzika mutsandanyama ('pelvis'), asi izvi zvinowedzera kuenda kuchimbuzi. [cite: 826, 827]
maternal_changes.tips: Zvakanaka kugadzirira chiremba wevana ('paediatrician') achazomuona. [cite: 833] Munogona kufanobvunza nezve maimyunisesheni uye zvekuita kana paine dambudziko nemwana. [cite: 835]
maternal_changes.plan: Chiremba wenyu anogona kutanga kukuonai vhiki rega rega. [cite: 837] Vachiongorora kutamba kwemwana, uye munogona kuzviitawo mega, muchiverenga nguva yaanotora kutamba kagumi. [cite: 837, 838] Munofanira kunzwa kutamba kwake kagumi mumaawa maviri. [cite: 840]

baby_development.summary: Vhudzi ('lanugo') riri paganda remwana ravekupera. [cite: 850] Mwana anofanira kunge aine musoro wakatarisa kuzasi ('cephalic position'). [cite: 851] Kana asati, chiremba anogona kushandisa nzira dzekuti abude zvakanaka. [cite: 852]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Pamwe marukutika nekukura kwedumbu. [cite: 847] Munogona kunzwa kuti kumonya ('Braxton Hicks contraction') kuri kuwedzera. [cite: 848] Mwana ari kudzika mutsandanyama, zvoita kuti mufeme zvakanaka. [cite: 845]
maternal_changes.tips: Shandisai 'nursing bra' kana mazamu achirwadza makarara. [cite: 854]
maternal_changes.plan: Gadzirirai zvamungade kuzoshandisa kuchipatara. [cite: 844] Zvingadiwe naAmai zvinosanganisira 'medical insurance card,' 'breast pads,' uye 'sanitary pads.' [cite: 856, 857, 858, 860] Zvingadiwe neMwana zvinosanganisira chigaro chemota, zvipfeko, nemanapukeni. [cite: 861, 862, 864, 865]

baby_development.summary: Nyangwe mwana akura kusvika pakukwanisa kuzvarwa, zvakanaka kuti arambe ari munhumbu kusvika nguva yanyatsokwana. [cite: 876]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Muviri hauchanyanyo kuwedzera huremu, unenge wawedzera ne 11.3-15.9kg. [cite: 872] Mvura yemunhumbu ('amniotic fluid') yave kudzikira. [cite: 872] Munogona kuita 'discharge' yechidzihwa, chinovhara pamuromo wechibereko; izvi zvinoratidza kuti muromo wechibereko wave kuvhurika. [cite: 873, 874]
maternal_changes.tips: Pedzisai kugadzirira kuuya kwemwana. [cite: 877] Zvakanaka kugadzirira kana paine achazokubatsirai nebasa mumba uye kubika. [cite: 879]
maternal_changes.plan: Pedzisai zvidzidzo zvekuzvara uye gadzirirai imba yamuchazova nemwana. [cite: 878]

baby_development.summary: Muviri wemwana wanyatsokura, kwangosara uropi nemapapu, ayo anoramba achikura kunyange azvarwa. [cite: 885]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Tsoka dzenyu dzinogona kuzvimba. [cite: 883] Asi kana maoko, chiso, nemakumbo zvikazvimba zvisinganzwisisike, kurumidzai kuudza chiremba, nekuti zvingave 'preeclampsia.' [cite: 883]
maternal_changes.tips: Kana mwana asina kugara zvakanaka ('breech position'), chiremba anogona kuti muitwe imwe 'scan.' [cite: 887] Munogona kuitwa 'non-stress test' kuti muongorore utano hwemwana. [cite: 888, 889]
maternal_changes.plan: Chiremba wenyu anogona kukurukura nemi nezvemunhu wekufonera kana matanga kugomera, uye zvekuita kana mwana akurumidza kubuda. [cite: 891, 892]

baby_development.summary: Mafuta epasi peganda remwana ari kuramba achikura, izvo zvakakosha kuti akwanise kuchengetedza tembiricha yakanaka. [cite: 904] Mwana anenge atanga kugadzira 'skin cells' matsva. [cite: 905]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Unogona kusaona shanduko yakawanda. [cite: 898] Kana wosvika pakupera kwepamuviri, muromo wechibereko unoita 'effacement,' kureva kuti unopfava, wopfupika, nekuonda, uchigadzirira kuzvarwa kwemwana. [cite: 899, 900, 901] Zviratidzo zvelabour zvinosanganisira 'regular contractions,' 'pelvic pressure,' uye marwadzo emusana. [cite: 896]
maternal_changes.tips: Ramba uchiterera kutamba-tamba kwemwana. [cite: 907] Unogona kumira kumbovhura zvipo zvemwana, nekuti zvinogona zvisingakwane kana kuva zverudzi rusiri iro. [cite: 908]
maternal_changes.plan: Panguva iyi, unofanira kuronga kuti zvikuitire nyore. [cite: 911] Iva nenguva yako, neyemurume wako, neyemhuri yako. [cite: 912]

baby_development.summary: Mabhonzo emwana aomarara, kunze kweedehenya. [cite: 945] Mabhonzo edehenya anofanira kuramba akapfava kuti agomanikidzika munzira yemwana. [cite: 945] Nekuda kweizvi, musoro wake unogona kuita kunge 'cone' pamazuva ekutanga. [cite: 946] Mwana achiri nenhova mbiri ('fontanelles') dzinobatsira pakuzvara. [cite: 947]

maternal_changes.body_changes: Paunogomera, musoro wemwana unotanga kubuda. [cite: 939] 'Crowning' ndiko kubuda kwemusoro wemwana usingachadzokere shure. [cite: 939] Paunoita 'crowning,' unonzwa kakutsva; paunongonzwa izvi, mira kugomera kuti usazviisa panjodzi yekuita ronda. [cite: 940, 941] 'Postpartum haemorrhage' (kubuda ropa rakawanda) ndechimwe chezvinogona kuitika, uye chinokonzerwa nekudambuka kwetsinga dzeropa kana matambudziko ne 'placenta.' [cite: 917, 920, 923]
maternal_changes.tips: Uchangobva kuzvara, mwana wako anoongororwa ne 'APGAR test,' iyo inoratidza chimiro chake. [cite: 950, 952] Zvibodzwa zvacho zvinotorwa pamineti rekutanga nerechishanu. [cite: 952] Mazano ekurwisa kuda kugomera anosanganisira kuzorora wakazembera nemusana uye kuisa simba pakufema. [cite: 954, 955, 957]
maternal_changes.plan: Paprenatal visit yako yekupedzisira, gadzirira matests anoti 'Non-stress test' ne 'Amniotic fluid index.' [cite: 960, 961, 962] Chiremba achataura newe pamusoro pekupfuudza mazuva epamuviri, 'induction,' uye 'caesarean birth.' [cite: 964, 965, 966, 967]

baby_development.summary: Emavikini amabili okuqala, awukazithwali okweqiniso[cite: 3]. Umntwana kakaqalisi ukukhula ngalesi sikhathi[cite: 8].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Uzakuba lezibonakaliso ojayele ukuba lazo ngamalanga usesikhathini, ezigoqela ukuphuma igazi, ubuhlungu besisu lamabele, lokuntshintsha komzimba[cite: 6].
maternal_changes.tips: Kuzamele untshitshe indlela obuphila ngayo ukuze ube lomntwana olempilakahle, okugoqela ukuzivocavoca umzimba, ukudla ukudla okwakha umzimba, lokunatha amavitamins le Folic acid[cite: 10, 12, 13, 14, 15]. Uyaxwayiswa ukuthi wehlukane letshwala, izidakamizwa, igwayi, le caffeine[cite: 16, 17, 18, 19, 20].
maternal_changes.plan: Hlela ukudla ukudla okwakha umzimba kanye lokuqala ukuzivocavoca umzimba[cite: 23, 24].

baby_development.summary: Umntwana kakaqalisi ukukhula ngalesi isikhathi[cite: 44]. Iovulation yenzakala ngeviki yesibili[cite: 27]. Iqanda lihlala amahola ayi 12 kusiya ku 24 ngemva kwe ovulation[cite: 30]. Iqanda lijwayele ukulungiswa lilodwa, kodwa kuyenzeka libe mabili okubangela amaphahla[cite: 31].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Izibonakaliso zeOvulation zigoqela ubuhlungu ngaphansi kwesisu, ubuhlungu bamabele, ukuphumisa amanzi amhlophe ngaphansi, lokutshisa umzimba[cite: 35, 38, 39, 40, 41]. Abanye balakho ukuphumisa igazi elilutshwana[cite: 42].
maternal_changes.tips: Okuqakathekileyo ongakwenza yikuziphatha okomuntu ozithweleyo[cite: 46]. Lokhu kuzokuvikela wena lomntwana ezintweni ezingaphambanisa ukukhulelwa[cite: 46].
maternal_changes.plan: Hlela ukudla ukudla okwakha umzimba kanye lokuqala ukuzivocavoca umzimba[cite: 48, 49].

baby_development.summary: Umntwana usengalingana lekhanda lenalithi encane[cite: 63]. Inhlanyelo kababa lekamama, ngakunye kulamachromosome ayi 23, kuyahlangana kwenze umntwana olamachromosome ayi 46[cite: 56]. Kulapho okwaziwa khona ukuthi umntwana uzakuba ngumfana loba yinkazana, umbala wakhe, lowamehlo lenwele[cite: 57]. Imbeleko iyaqala ukubunjwa, yiyo ephumisa i-hCG ebanjwa ngama pregnancy test[cite: 65]. Ingqondo, ispinal cord, inhliziyo lamathumbu lazo seziqala ukuba khona[cite: 66].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Abesifazana abanengi abakunanzeleli untshintsho, kodwa abanye balakho ukuzwa ubuhlungu lokuphumisa amanzi ngaphansi[cite: 60]. Abanye bayaphumisa igazi elilutshwana[cite: 61]. Xhumana loGqiha nxa uphuma igazi elinengi ngoba kungabe kutshengisa ukuthi umntwana uhlanyeleke phandle kwesibeletho[cite: 61].
maternal_changes.tips: Umzimba wakho suqala ukuntshintsha kakhulu[cite: 68]. Ukhumbule ukuphumuza umzimba ngokwaneleyo lokudla okunempilo[cite: 68]. Ukucabanga kakhulu akulunganga kuwe lakumntwana[cite: 69].
maternal_changes.plan: Ukuvocavoca umzimba kuqakathekile, kodwa xoxisana loGqiha wakho kuqala[cite: 71]. Ukudla okwakha umzimba okuleprotein lecalcium kuqakathekile[cite: 73]. Wehlukane lotshwala, izidakamizwa, imithi ethize, lokubhema igwayi[cite: 74, 75, 76, 77, 80].

baby_development.summary: Umntwana ubunjwa yizibhebhedu ezintathu: iEctoderm, iMesoderm, leEndoderm[cite: 93]. IEctoderm izabumba ingqondo, isijwabu, inwele, lenzipho[cite: 94]. IMesoderm izakwenza inhliziyo, imithambo yegazi, lamathambo[cite: 95]. IEndoderm yona izakwenza amaphaphu, amathumbu, lesibindi[cite: 95]. Izandla lenyawo seziqalile ukubumbeka[cite: 96]. Imbeleko siqalile ukwenza amahormone agoqela i-hCG[cite: 96].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Sungaqala ukuba lezibonakaliso zokuzithwala ezigoqela ubuhlungu bamabele, ukutshaywa likhanda, ubuhlungu beqolo, lokuzizwa ufuna ukuhlanza[cite: 87]. Izibonakaliso lezi zilakho ukufana lezokuya esikhathini[cite: 88]. Abanye baqala ukuzwa iminuko lokunambitha ukudla kakhulu[cite: 84].
maternal_changes.tips: Amavitamins kumele abe le 0.4mg ye folic acid[cite: 99]. Unanzelele imithi engaphambanisa ukukhula komntwana, ikakhulu leyo yeHIV, iHypertension, lezifayifa (epilepsy)[cite: 101]. OMama abathatha imithi le bayaxwayiswa ukuthi babonane loGqiha masinyane[cite: 102].
maternal_changes.plan: Nxa ukuya esikhathini kwakho kuphuzile, thatha ipregnancy test[cite: 104]. Nxa ingatshengisa ukuthi uzithwele, bonana lowezempilakahle[cite: 105]. Kuqakathekile ukuqala ukudinga owezempilakahle lendawo ozabelethela kuyo[cite: 108].

baby_development.summary: Umntwana ngalesi isikhathi usafana lomntwana wexoxo[cite: 123]. Ubude bakhe bukhangelwa ukusuka ekhanda kusiya kuzihlalo (crown to rear length) kuze kufike amaviki angamatshumi amabili[cite: 121, 122]. Inhliziyo yakhe sitshaya kuhle, lezitho ezinjengamehlo lendlebe sezibunjwa[cite: 123]. Amathambo lawo seqalile ukubunjwa[cite: 123].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Imizwa izabe intshintsha kakhulu, ukuthaba lokuzonda kusenzeka kungela sizatho[cite: 117]. Ezinye izibonakaliso zigoqela ukudinwa lobuhlungu bamabele[cite: 118]. Abesifazana abafika ku 50% balakho ukuzizwa bengezwa kuhle ekuseni ('morning sickness')[cite: 115]. Nxa ukugula lokhu kukuhlupha kakhulu, xoxisana loGqiha wakho ngoba kungabe sekuyi Hyperemesis gravidarum[cite: 119].
maternal_changes.tips: OGqiha baxwayisa ukwengeza umzimba ngama kilogram ayi 11.3 kusiya ku 15.9[cite: 125]. Abesifazane abalemizimba emincane bangengeza ngama 15.4 kg, labo abalemizimba emikhulu ngama 9 kg[cite: 126].
maternal_changes.plan: Ngeviki yesihlanu, hlela ukuyabhalisa isisu sakho okokuqala[cite: 112]. Nxa ungakakwenzi lokhu, qhubeka wenze njalo[cite: 128].

baby_development.summary: Izitho esezibunjwa zigoqela amaphaphu, umhlathi, amakhala, lomlomo[cite: 143]. Izandla lenyawo sezikhula zenze iminwe lamazwane[cite: 143]. Ingqondo iyaqhubeka ikhula[cite: 143]. IUltrasound eyenziwa ngaphansi isilakho ukuzwa ukutshaya kwenhliziyo yomntwana[cite: 144].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Abanye bayengeza umzimba ngalesi sikhathi, abanye bazizwa suyehlile[cite: 136]. Ungaqala ukunanzelela ukuntshintsha kwamabele, okugoqela ubuhlungu lokuvuvuka[cite: 137]. Ungaqala ukuzwa isilungulela[cite: 137]. Abanye babona igazi elincane elilandelwa yibuhlungu besisu kancane, kodwa nxa lokhu kungengeza, mazise uGqiha wakho[cite: 138, 139].
maternal_changes.tips: Nxa amavitamins ekwenza uzwe isisu, ungawathatha lokudla loba ebusuku ungakalali[cite: 146]. Ungawayekeli ungakhulumanga lowezempilakahle wakho[cite: 147].
maternal_changes.plan: Kuqakathekile ukwazi iqembu legazi (blood group) lakho lelomkakho[cite: 149]. Kukhona amaqembu amane: A, B, AB, lo O[cite: 150]. Kuqakathekile futhi ukwazi iRh factor yakho, ngoba ukuzithwala kulakho ukungaqhubi kuhle nxa uMama eRh-negative elomntwana oRh-positive[cite: 153].

baby_development.summary: Zonke izitho eziqakathekileyo seziqalile ukubunjwa[cite: 161]. Inwele lengono zamabele seziqalile ukubumbeka, lentshiya zamehlo lolimi[cite: 162]. Indololwane lamazwane sekukhanya[cite: 162].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Akukhangelekile ukuthi abanye sebebonile ukuthi uzithwele[cite: 158]. Ungabe usungeze loba wehlile umzimba kancane ngenxa yokugula ekuseni[cite: 159]. Ukwengeza ukuyalahla amanzi kujwayelekile, kubangelwa ngamahormone lezinso ezisebenza ngamandla[cite: 156].
maternal_changes.tips: Nanzi izixwayiso zokwenza ukugula kwekuseni kube ngcono: dlana ukudla okulutshwana kanengi, dlana icereal eyomileyo ungakavuki, thola ukuphumula, nukisa amalemon loba iginger, njalo ungapheki loba ukudla ukudla okubabayo[cite: 164, 165, 168, 169, 172]. Natha iVitamin B6 (50mg) ngelanga[cite: 173].
maternal_changes.plan: Kumele ube usukhethe owezempilakahle ozakuncedisa uze uyebeletha[cite: 176]. Nxa ukugula kwekuseni kungengeza, xoxisana loGqiha wakho[cite: 177].

baby_development.summary: Konke okukhona emzimbeni womuntu omdala sekukhona emntwaneni[cite: 190]. Indlebe, amathambo, imisipha, iminwe, lamazwane kuyaqhubeka kubumbeka[cite: 190, 191]. Ubuso buyabumbeka, amakhala sekhona, lentshiya[cite: 191]. Umsila usunyamalala[cite: 192].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Isibeletho sakho sesilingana lesithelo segrapefruit[cite: 187]. Amabele angabe esebuhlungu umzimba ulungela ukumunyisa[cite: 188]. Okunye okujwayelekileyo yikuzizwa usiba lamathe amanengi emlonyeni[cite: 184]. Abanye bazwa betshaywa ngamakhanda[cite: 185].
maternal_changes.tips: Ngesikhathi sokuzithwala abanye baba lamaqhubu ngoba ijwabu liba lamafutha[cite: 194]. Nxa usebenzisa imithi yokuqeda lokhu, yazi ukuthi ilani[cite: 194]. Buza owezempilakahle ngemithi ongayisebenzisa[cite: 195].
maternal_changes.plan: Isisu sibhaliswa phakathi kweviki 8 kusiya ku 12[cite: 197]. UGqiha uzabuza imibuzo egoqela imikhuhlane olayo, imithi oyinathayo, leyemulini yangakini[cite: 198, 199, 204]. Khangelela ukuhlolwa umzimba, i-pap smear, le-ultrasound[cite: 206].

baby_development.summary: Umntwana ulingana legrebisi[cite: 209]. Umsila usunyamalele, usekhangeleka njengomuntu[cite: 218]. Okuvala amehlo sekukhona kodwa kusavalekile, kuzavuleka ngeviki yama 28[cite: 219]. Amajoints asesebenza, umntwana useyenelisa ukudlala[cite: 220]. Useyenelisa ukumunya isithupha sakhe[cite: 222].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Ungabe ungakhanyi ukuthi usuzithwele, kodwa usungabe usizwa utshintsho emzimbeni[cite: 215]. Ungabe usuzitshaya (mood swings), usizwa isilungulela lokuqumbelana[cite: 216]. Ukudla kancane kancane kunganceda ukuvikela isilungulela[cite: 217].
maternal_changes.tips: Esigabeni lesi uzizwa udinwa masinya[cite: 226]. Lokhu kubangelwa ngama-chemicals omzimba, ukulala nzima, lokugula ekuseni[cite: 226]. Zama ukudinga indlela engcono yokulala[cite: 227].
maternal_changes.plan: Nxa uleminyaka edlula 35 loba emulini kukhona imikhuhlane efana le-cystic fibrosis, kuyakhuthazwa ukuthi uyebona oGqiha ababona ngemikhuhlane ethelelwana ngama-genes[cite: 229]. Xoxisana loGqiha wakho ngokuhlolwa okunye okugoqela i-chorionic villus sampling[cite: 230].

baby_development.summary: Izitho zomzimba ezinengi ziyabe sezikhona, ziyaqhubeka zikhula[cite: 233]. Izitho eziqakathekileyo (izinso, isibindi, ingqondo, lamaphaphu) ziyabe sokusebenza[cite: 241]. Inkumba zeminwe lamazwane zikhanya kuliviki[cite: 242]. Umntwana uyabe esenelisa ukuginya lokudlalisa inyawo zakhe[cite: 243].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Isibeletho siyabe sikhula kodwa kungabe kungakakhanyi kakhulu[cite: 236]. Amabele lesisu kuyabe sokukhula ngeviki leviki[cite: 234].
maternal_changes.tips: Loba uzithwele, uyenelisa ukuzivocavoca ukuthi uhlale ulempilakahle[cite: 245]. Xoxa loGqiha wakho[cite: 245]. Abanengi oGqiha bakhuthaza ukuhambahamba lokubhukutsha[cite: 246].
maternal_changes.plan: Ukuvakatshela uGqiha okwesibili kwenziwa phakathi kweviki 12 le 16[cite: 248]. Lapho yikho uGqiha azayenza khona iscan somntwana, wenelise ukubona umntwana okokuqala[cite: 249]. UGqiha uzalalela inhliziyo yomntwana esebenzisa i-Doppler stethoscope[cite: 250].

baby_development.summary: Ingxenye yobude bomntwana ithathwa likhanda lodwa[cite: 261]. Iminwe lamazwane sokubonakala kunye ngakunye[cite: 261]. Ijwabu lisase butshelezi, amathambo seqala ukoma[cite: 261]. Asikanelisi ukubona ukuthi umntwana ngumfana kumbe yinkazana, kodwa sizakwazi ngamaviki ambalwa[cite: 262].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Lanxa umntwana ekhula ngokuphangisa, umzimba wakho ungathatha isikhatshana ukuguquka[cite: 256]. Kodwa inwele lenzipho zingabonakala sokukhula ngesiphangiphangi[cite: 257]. Ingane ekhulayo ingabangela ubuhlungu esiswini[cite: 254].
maternal_changes.tips: Ungazihambela lapho ofisa ukuyakhona, ngaphandle kwalabo abalezinkinga mayelana lokuzithwala kwabo[cite: 266]. Nanzelela ukuthi ukuvuka ukhipha ekuseni sokuphelile, ngakho ukuhambahamba sokusiba lula[cite: 267].
maternal_changes.plan: Nxa ubukhipha ngamaviki okuqala, umzimba wakho ungabe suwehlile[cite: 269]. Abanengi bengezela amakilogram angaba yi 1.3 kusiya ku 1.8 kuphela[cite: 270]. Kukhangelelwe ukuthi ekupheleni kwesikhathi sokuzithwala, ubewengezele amakilogram angaba yi 11.3 kusiya ku 15.9[cite: 271].

baby_development.summary: Amehlo asesondela lapho okumele abekhona[cite: 285]. Amathumbu akhula aze aphume kancinyane esiya enkabeni, kodwa azabuyela esiswini[cite: 286]. Izinso seziqalile ukulungisa umthambiso[cite: 287]. Umntwana usefunda ukumunya[cite: 287].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Isibeletho siyaqhubeka sikhula, abezempilakahle sebesanelisa ukusizwa[cite: 278]. Impahla zakho zingabe zingasakwani kahle[cite: 279]. Ijwabu liyaqala ukutshintsha, ungabona amatshathatshatha amnyama ebusweni lasentanyeni[cite: 282]. Imithambo yegazi iyaqala ukubonakala[cite: 276].
maternal_changes.tips: Ungaqala ukwenza imidlalo yokuqinisa inyama zesibeletho okuthiwa ngama Kegel exercises[cite: 289]. Lokhu kungasiza ukuthi ukubeletha kube lula[cite: 290].
maternal_changes.plan: Qaphelisisa ukudla okudlayo; kumele kube ngokwakhayo kuwe lakumntwana[cite: 292, 293]. Ukuze umzimba ungakhuli kakhulu, zama ukungadli ukudla okungakhiyo, ungadobhadobhi ebusuku, njalo wehlise ukudla okulamafutha leziwiji[cite: 294, 295, 296].

baby_development.summary: Ikhanda lomntwana selingabe liyi 1/3 yomzimba[cite: 306]. Izidindo zeminwe sezibumbekile[cite: 306]. Izinso lendlela yomthambiso sokusebenza[cite: 307]. Ijwabu selilokuzinwedlana okubutshelezi[cite: 307].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Uqala ukubona imidwebodwebo yejwabu esiswini, emabeleni, lasezihlalweni[cite: 302]. Ukuvuka ukhipha ekuseni akusavamanga, kodwa ungazizwa usiba lesilungulela[cite: 303]. Amabele ungawezwa esemakhulu eselokuyizigaqa[cite: 303]. Ungabona imithambo yegazi isibonakala ejwatshini lamabele[cite: 304].
maternal_changes.tips: Abesifazane abazithweleyo bavame ukuzibona sebelemidwebodwebo yejwabu[cite: 309]. Ukugcoba amakha ejwabu ale vitamin E kungaphathisa[cite: 309]. Ungathengi amakha ungabonisananga labezempilakahle[cite: 310]. Qhubeka unatha amaphilisi e-Folic acid le-Ferrous Sulphate[cite: 300].
maternal_changes.plan: Nxa ibanga lokuqala lokuzithwala lifika emaphethelweni, owesifazane angabona efisa ukuya emacansini[cite: 314]. Ungethuki, umntwana uvikelekile[cite: 316]. Kodwa ukuya emacansini akukhuthazwa nxa isisu sake sachitheka, ingcipho isichithekile, kumbe elomkhuhlane wasemcansini[cite: 317, 319, 320, 324].

baby_development.summary: Ingalo seziqala ukutshombuluka[cite: 333]. Isibindi sesiqala ukwenza inyongo; umbendeni lawo suqalile ukwakha iziqu zegazi[cite: 334]. Ubuchopho bomntwana sobukhula, usesanelisa ukuhambisa izinyama zobuso[cite: 334]. Angabe seqalile ukumunya umunwe[cite: 335]. Akuvamanga ukuthi isisu sichitheke ngalesisikhathi[cite: 335].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Sokuqala ukuba yindingeko ukuthenga impahla zowesifazane ozithweleyo[cite: 331]. Abesifazane abanengi ngalesisikhathi bazibona sebelangazelela ukudla, belamandla amatsha, njalo befisa ukuya emacansini[cite: 328].
maternal_changes.tips: Ungaqala ukunanzelela amatshatha amnyama ejwatshini lakho[cite: 337]. Kuvamile lokhu, kodwa nxa eguquka ngokuphangisa, kuqakathekile ukubona abezempilakahle ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi awulamvukuzane yejwabu[cite: 337].
maternal_changes.plan: Ngalesisikhathi, abesifazane abanengi baqala ukuba lemizwa eguquguqukayo[cite: 340]. Ungazibuza imibuzo eminengi, njengokuthi uzakuba ngumzali ofaneleyo na[cite: 341]. Inhliziyo ayihlaliseke, ufunde indlela zokuphumuza ingqondo[cite: 342].

baby_development.summary: Ijwabu lomntwana libutshelezi, imithambo yegazi isabonakala[cite: 350]. Indlebe seziqala ukubonakala kahle, lamehlo sesiya endaweni yawo[cite: 351]. Amathambo seqala ukoma, kusitsho ukuthi angabonakala kwi-X-ray[cite: 351]. Emfanekisweni ye-Ultrasound, abantwana bangabonakala bemunya umunwe[cite: 352].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Umzimba ungabe usungezeke ngesisindo esingaba yi 2.27 kilograms[cite: 346]. Unganelisa ukuzwa ingaphezulu yesibeletho okwama-centimeter angu 10-12 phezulu kwenkaba[cite: 348]. Ibanga lesibili lingeze lokuvimbana kwamakhala, inkantsho enyaweni, kunye lobuhlungwana bezinsi[cite: 344].
maternal_changes.tips: Kuyakhuthazwa ukulala ngomhlubulo wesandleni senxele[cite: 354]. Ukulala ngomhlana akukhuthazwa ngoba kuvimbela ukugijima kahle kwegazi, kuphinde kwenze ukuphefumula kube nzima[cite: 356]. Ukufaka imiqamelo phakathi kwenyawo kungasiza[cite: 357].
maternal_changes.plan: Abempilakahle sebeqala ukukhangela ukukhula kwesisu ngokukhangela ubude kusukela ethanjeni lokhalo kusiya phezulu kwesibeletho[cite: 359]. Lokhu kusiza ukubona ukuthi umntwana ukhula kahle na, lokuthi ulele ekhangele luhlu luphi[cite: 360].

baby_development.summary: Umntwana selungisela ukukhula ngesiphangiphangi[cite: 369]. Amehlo lendlebe sokusendaweni zazo[cite: 370]. Izitho ezitshiyeneyo sezisebenza[cite: 370]. Inhliziyo yomntwana ipompa amalitha egazi ayi 23.70 ngelanga[cite: 370].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Isibeletho siqhubeka sikhula, sesingaba ngama-kilogram ayi 0.25[cite: 365]. Ukwengezeleka kwegazi emzimbeni kubangela ukuthi ubuso bakho bukhazimule[cite: 366]. Ijwabu ngokwalo lenza amafutha amanengi, kubangela njalo ukukhazimula kobuso[cite: 367].
maternal_changes.tips: Ungaqa ukuzwa umntwana ehambahamba esiswini ngale viki[cite: 373]. Nxa kuyisisu sokuqala, ungaqala ukuzwa lokhu kumaviki angamatshumi amabili[cite: 373]. Zama ngazo zonke indlela ukungalali ngomhlana[cite: 375].
maternal_changes.plan: Emavikini aseduze, udokotela angakuhlola isisu sakho esebenzisa i-Ultrasound, Alpha-Feto Protein (AFP), Triple test, noma i-Amniocentesis[cite: 377, 379, 380, 381, 382]. Angafisa ukuxoxisana lawe ngobuhlungu esiswini, ukuhelelwa isikhathi singakafiki, lokukhetha udokotela wabantwana[cite: 383, 384, 385].

baby_development.summary: Inkaba yomntwana iqhubeka ikhula isiba qatha[cite: 394]. Umntwana sesanelisa ukuzwa ngendlebe zakhe[cite: 394]. Useqalile njalo ukugcina amafutha ngaphansi kwejwabu ancedisa ukumgcina ekhudumala[cite: 395].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Nxa isisu sikhula, ezinye izitho zomzimba zizafuqwa ukuze isisu sikhule[cite: 391]. Amathumbu seqala ukufuqelwa eceleni[cite: 393]. Iqolo liqala ukuba buhlungu[cite: 388]. Ungazibona ukhohlwa izinto kalula, lokhu kuvamile[cite: 389].
maternal_changes.tips: Ungabe sunanzelele ukuthi inyawo zibabuhlungu. Lokhu kubangelwa yikubandezelwa komthambo wamagetsi okuthiwa yi-sciatic oya enyaweni[cite: 397]. Ukuzelula kungasiza ukuthi lobu buhlungu budedele[cite: 399].
maternal_changes.plan: Ungabe sunanzelele ukuthi izinto ezikubangelayo ukuthi uqubuke zengezelekile[cite: 401, 402]. Xoxisana lodokotela wakho ngemithi ongayisebenzisa[cite: 403]. Zama ukungathengi imithi ezitolo ungakhulumanga lodokotela[cite: 404].

baby_development.summary: Imithambo yamagetsi yomntwana iyaqhubeka ibumbeka[cite: 414]. Nxa umntwana eyinkazana, izitho zakhe zangaphakathi sezibumbekile[cite: 415]. Nxa engumfana, unganelisa ukubona isitho sakhe ku-Ultrasound[cite: 416].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Umzimba wakho sutshintshile, abanengi sebebona ukuthi uzithwele[cite: 409]. Igazi alisahambi ngamandla, ngakho kuqakathekile ukuthi usukume kancane ukuze uzivikele ekubeni lesiyezi[cite: 411, 412]. Uzakwengeza umzimba cishe nge 0.5 kilograms ngeviki[cite: 407].
maternal_changes.tips: Abanengi abazithweleyo bakuthola kunzima ukuqeda ilanga bengazange balale[cite: 418]. Nxa usebenza, dinga ithuba emsebenzini lokuthi uphumule[cite: 421].
maternal_changes.plan: Sukhangelele ukuya eklinika okwesithathu[cite: 423]. Uzakwenziwa i-sonogram, engabe ingeyebanga lokuqala kumbe lesibili[cite: 423]. Eyebanga lesibili ikhangela okuthize, njengokuthi inhliziyo yomntwana ibumbeke kahle na[cite: 424]. Ungenziwa umhloliso we-MSAFP kumbe i-AFP[cite: 425].

baby_development.summary: Izinso seziyenza umthambiso, lenwele zekhanda seziqala ukukhula[cite: 441]. Ingqondo isiyakha imizwa[cite: 441]. Nxa kungumntwana oyinkazana, amaqanda akhe sehle enziwa khonapho[cite: 442].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Ubuhlungu be-round ligament bujwayelekile ku-trimester yesibili, buba buhlabahlaba esiswini[cite: 435]. Abanye baba lesilungulela ngenxa yama-hormones[cite: 431]. Ukumanelwa kungabakhona ngenxa yokuthi umntwana ucindezela amathumbu[cite: 433].
maternal_changes.tips: Isiyezi sandise ukubangelwa yikwehla kwe-blood pressure[cite: 444]. Ungakuvikela ngokulala ngecele lesandleni senxele kulokulala ukhangele phezulu[cite: 445]. Esinye isiyezi sibangelwa yikusukuma ngokuphangisa[cite: 446].
maternal_changes.plan: Njengoba usuzithwele, kumele uqaphele imithi yesintu oyinathayo[cite: 449]. Uyaxwayiswa ukuthi unganathi imithi yesintu ungakakhulumisani loGqiha wakho[cite: 450]. Eyinye ingacina ichitha isisu[cite: 450].

baby_development.summary: Umzimba wakhe ugoqelwe ngokumhlophe okuthiwa yi-vernix caseosa, okuvikela ijwabu lomntwana[cite: 462]. Kuyancedisa njalo ekubeletheni[cite: 463]. Umntwana seyenelisa ukwenza amaphumelo (meconium) aluhlaza kumbe amnyama[cite: 463].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Isibeletho sesikhule, ubuphezulu baso bumaqondana lenkaba kamama[cite: 457]. Umzimba wakho ungabe usungezele isisindo ngama-kilogram amane loba amahlanu[cite: 457]. Okwandise ukwenzakala yikubanjwa yinkantsho enyaweni, ukuvuvuka, lokuthwala nzima ekulaleni[cite: 455].
maternal_changes.tips: Kuqakathekile ukuthi udle ukudla okule-iron eyaneleyo ukuvikela i-anemia[cite: 466, 467]. Dlana i-iron engaba yi 27mg kusiya ku 30mg ngelanga[cite: 468]. Itholakala enyameni ebomvu, indumba, lemibhida[cite: 471, 473, 474].
maternal_changes.plan: Khathesi yiso isikhathi sokuhlela ukuthi uzabeletha njani[cite: 480]. Ungabhala phansi egwalweni okukhangelele ukuthi kwenzakale ukuze kube lula kulabo abazakuncedisa[cite: 481, 482].

baby_development.summary: Ubude bomntwana sobulinganiswa kuqala ekhanda kusiya esithende (crown heel length)[cite: 497]. Izinkophe zomntwana seziphelile ukwakhiwa[cite: 498]. Indlela ehambisa ukudla iyakhula njalo umntwana uyabe ethola ukudla kuyo ingcipho[cite: 499]. Nxa umntwana eyinkazana, isitho sakhe sangasese sesakheke ngokupheleleyo[cite: 500].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Ungafaka iminwe yakho amasentimitha amabili phezulu kwenkaba, ungezwa isibeletho sakho[cite: 491]. Kuyabe sokuvela lula ukuthi uzithwele[cite: 491]. Ungananzelela ukuthi inyawo zakho ziyavuvuka ekupheleni kwelanga; dinga izikhathi zokuphumula[cite: 492]. Qaphela i-Pre-eclampsia, ebonakala nge-high blood pressure[cite: 488]. Nxa utshaywa likhanda loba uvuvuka umzimba, bona udokotela masinyane[cite: 489].
maternal_changes.tips: Umhabulo wendlela yomthambiso (UTI) ungaba lawo nxa uzithwele[cite: 502]. Ungawuvikela ngokunatha amanzi amanengi (amankomitsho 6-8), ukuhlikihla usukela phambili usiya emuva, lokuthambisa ngaphambi langemva kokuhlangana emacansini[cite: 505, 506, 507].
maternal_changes.plan: Nxa umzimba usengezeka, ungabona ususiba lemithambo evuvukileyo (varicose veins)[cite: 511]. Imithambo le ijwayele ukubakhona enyaweni kodwa ingatholakala lezithweni zangasese[cite: 512].

baby_development.summary: Umntwana sefana losanda kubelethwa kodwa emncane[cite: 522]. Ijwabu lingabe lingani litshwabhene ngenxa yokuthi akakakhuli okwaneleyo[cite: 523]. Indebe zakhe sezicaca, lamehlo asephelile ukwakhiwa[cite: 523]. Inkophe lentshiya sokusendaweni efaneleyo, le-pancreas iqhubeka ikhula[cite: 524].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Usungasizwa isibeletho singamasentimitha amabili phezulu kwenkaba[cite: 519]. Kujwayelekile ukuthi ubelenwele ezinhle lenzipho ezikhula masinyane[cite: 516]. Ijwabu lesiswini lingoma ngenxa yokukhula[cite: 517].
maternal_changes.tips: Omama abanengi bakhathazeka ngokubeletha ngaphambi kwesikhathi (preterm labour)[cite: 526]. Kukhona ukuhlolisiswa okuthiwa yi-Fetal Fibronectin test[cite: 528]. Nxa i-Fetal fibronectin ingatholakala emanzini aphuma ngasese phakathi kweviki 22 le 38, kutshengisa ingozi yokubeletha ngaphambi kwesikhathi[cite: 529].
maternal_changes.plan: Sokuyisikhathi sokuhlanganyela labafundisa ngokubeletha[cite: 532]. Zama ukuthi ubusuqedile izifundo zakho ngeviki yama 37[cite: 534]. Izifundo lezi zingatholakala ezibhedlela lasezindaweni ezihlanganela omama abakhulelweyo[cite: 535].

baby_development.summary: Inwele ezisemzimbeni wakhe (lanugo) ziba mnyama, ngakho ziyabe sezikhanya ku-Ultrasound Scan[cite: 549]. Umntwana sefana kakhulu losanda kubelethwa[cite: 550].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Isibeletho sakho sesingamasentimitha amane (4) phezulu kwenkaba, njalo umzimba wakho ungengezelela ngama-kg angaba yi 5-7[cite: 541]. Isibeletho sihlezi phezulu kwesinye sakho, okungabangela ukuthi umthambiso uvuze[cite: 543]. Ingcipho yona ayilanuko; nxa ubona amanzi engelanuko, fonela udokotela[cite: 545, 546].
maternal_changes.tips: Natha amanzi amanengi, lokhu kuqakatheke kakhulu[cite: 552]. Nxa unatha amanzi ayeneleyo, umthambiso wakho kumele uphose ufane lamanzi[cite: 554]. Lokhu kungavikela ukutshaywa likhanda, ubuhlungu besibeletho, le-UTI[cite: 555, 556, 557, 558].
maternal_changes.plan: Nxa usebenza, kumele ube usulungisa amaphepha okuthatha ikhefu emsebenzini[cite: 560]. Abafazi abanengi bayazibuza ukuthi kumele beme ukusebenza nini[cite: 561]. Akula mpendulo eyodwa eqondileyo[cite: 562]. Kumele ubuye ucabange ngokuthi ngubani ozasala egcine usane lwakho[cite: 564].

baby_development.summary: Ubuchopho bomntwana bukhula kakhulu[cite: 577]. Izitho zokunambitha (taste buds) seziqala ukukhula[cite: 577]. Amaphaphu selungisa amanzi aqakathekileyo ekuphefumuleni okuthiwa yi-Surfactant[cite: 578]. Abantwana abazalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi baphefumula nzima ngenxa yokuthi i-Surfactant ayikabi yenele[cite: 578].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Isibeletho ususizwa singamasentimitha amahlanu phezulu kwenkaba[cite: 572]. Ijwabu emabeleni lasesiswini selinanabuka, okungabangela ukuthi ulunyelwe[cite: 572]. Sebenzisa amafutha (lotions)[cite: 573]. Amehlo lawo ungazwa ewoma[cite: 573].
maternal_changes.tips: Nxa uhlutshwa yisilungulela, zama ukudla okulutshwana ngesikhathi sinye[cite: 580]. Ungazinceda njalo ngokungadli ebusuku kakhulu[cite: 581].
maternal_changes.plan: Emavikini awu 24 kusiya ku 28, odokotela bazahlola itshukela yakho[cite: 583]. Omama abanye bengaba letshukela nxa bezithwele (gestational diabetes)[cite: 584]. Izibonakaliso zigoqela ukoma okwedlulisileyo lokuhamba kakhulu esambuzini[cite: 586, 587].

baby_development.summary: Umntwana usesiba lamafutha amanengi, lokhu kuyenza angakhanyi etshwabhene[cite: 599]. Umbala wenwele zakhe sukhanya ngesikhathi lesi, kodwa ungaguquka nxa esebelethiwe[cite: 600]. Ukuthi umntwana uyinkazana kumbe ngumfana sokungabonwa nge-Ultrasound, Amniocentesis, CVS, loba i-NIPT[cite: 601].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Isibeletho sesingangebhola, siyazwakala phakathi laphakathi kwesifuba lenkaba[cite: 596]. Nxa izandla leminwe kubuhlungu, usungaba lomkhuhlane we-Carpal tunnel syndrome, obangelwa yikuvuvuka[cite: 593].
maternal_changes.tips: Ngesikhathi lesi, kumele uqale ukucabanga amabizo omntwana[cite: 610]. Zibuze imibuzo efana lokuthi: Amabala asekuqaleni kwebizo abumba liphi ibala? [cite: 611]
maternal_changes.plan: Ungalingeka ukuthi uyenziwe i-Ultrasound scan nje eyokugcina, kodwa ukwenza ama-Scan amanengi kungaba yingozi[cite: 615]. Kumele uyenziwe i-Scan nxa udokotela etshilo[cite: 616].

baby_development.summary: Indlebe zakhe sezikhula, ngakho usesizwa umsindo[cite: 629]. Uyala eginya ingcipho, lokhu kwenza amaphaphu akhe akhule[cite: 630]. Nxa engumfana, izitho zakhe zangasese sezikhulile[cite: 630].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Isibeletho sizwakala 6 cm phezulu kwenkaba[cite: 624]. Emalangeni aseleyo, sizakhula nge 1.25 cm ngeviki[cite: 624]. Kumele ubusungezele ama-kg ayi 7-10[cite: 625]. Nxa ulunyelwa kakhulu, ungabe ulomkhuhlane we-Cholestasis of pregnancy[cite: 622].
maternal_changes.tips: Usungaqala ukudla idelele, elilezakhamzimba ezinengi njenge-Vitamin A, B6, C, Zinc, le-Calcium[cite: 632, 633]. Indumba zilawo amaprotheni amanengi njalo lazo ziyancedisa ukuvikela ukumanilwa[cite: 634].
maternal_changes.plan: Nxa uvakatshela udokotela, khangelela ukuhlolwa kwegazi, i-Rh factor, lokukhangelwa itshukela[cite: 637, 638, 639]. Nizakhuluma ngokusokwa, ukudla ngemva kokubeletha, le-Braxton Hicks contractions[cite: 640, 641, 643].

baby_development.summary: Umntwana senelisa ukuvula lokuvala amehlo[cite: 656]. Selelezikhathi zakhe zokulala lokuvuka[cite: 656]. Angatshaywa yintwabe, kodwa akumelanga kukwethuse lokhu, kuzenzakala kakhulu nxa amaphaphu ekhula[cite: 658].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Ususizwa umntwana ehambahamba kakhulu[cite: 651]. Lokhu kungaba yintwabe kumbe ukuzelula[cite: 651]. Lokhu kuhambahamba kuyaduduza njalo kuqinisa isibopho phakathi kwakho lomntwana[cite: 652]. Abanye baba lama-Hemorroids, yimithambo yegazi evuvukayo[cite: 647, 648].
maternal_changes.tips: Nxa ulemota, kuqakathekile ukuthenga isitulo somntwana esemoteni[cite: 660]. Bona ukuthi siyakwana emoteni yakho njalo sifakwe kuhle[cite: 661].
maternal_changes.plan: Nxa ungakahlanganeli labafundisa ngokubeletha, sokuyisikhathi sokwenza lokho[cite: 662]. Kumele izifundo zibe seziphelile ngeviki yesi 37[cite: 662].

baby_development.summary: Ubuchopho bomntwana sobusiba lemifino[cite: 678]. Inwele zala zilokhu zikhula[cite: 678]. Intshiya lenkophe sokukhanya kuhle[cite: 678]. Umntwana sesiba lamafutha amanengi[cite: 679].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Isibeletho usungasizwa 9 cm phezulu kwenkaba[cite: 672]. Umzimba wakho sungabe usungezelele ngama-kg ayi 7-10[cite: 672]. Omama abanengi bengabanjwa yinkantsho, bezwe ukumanilwa, lokungalali[cite: 674]. Ukopha ngaphansi kungatshengisela umkhuhlane we-Placenta previa[cite: 669].
maternal_changes.tips: Qalisa ukwenza amacebo okuthi uzahamba njani esibhedlela[cite: 680]. Bona ukuthi ulenombolo zocingo zomkakho[cite: 681]. Dinga indlela emfitshane yokuya esibhedlela[cite: 682].
maternal_changes.plan: Uzabe usuvakatshela odokotela ngamaviki amabili[cite: 688]. Khangelela ukunikwa umuthi we-Rhogam nxa ule-Rh factor[cite: 685]. Nizakhuluma ngokuhambahamba komntwana lokuthi ungabala njani[cite: 685, 686].

baby_development.summary: Umntwana usekhula ngokuphangisa[cite: 698]. Ikhanda liyakhula ngenxa yokukhula kwengqondo[cite: 698]. Imisipha lamaphaphu kuyaqhubeka kukhula[cite: 699].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Isisindo somzimba sesengezeleleke ngama-kg ayi 8-11[cite: 693]. Isibeletho sesidlule inkaba ngama-cm afika ku-10[cite: 693]. Ukumanelwa kujwayelekile[cite: 694]. Ungananzelela uchago lwe-colostrum luphuma emabeleni[cite: 691].
maternal_changes.tips: Abako DAWA community healthcare worker bayancedisa ukuthi omama babelethe kuhle[cite: 704]. Bayenelisa ukubonwa kanengi-nengi njalo umsebenzi wabo bawufundele[cite: 706, 708].
maternal_changes.plan: Dlana ukudla okulesikuba okugoqela izithelo, umbhida, lesinkwa esilentanga[cite: 710]. Natha amanzi amanengi, amankomitsho ayi 10 kusiya ku 12 ngelanga[cite: 711]. Zivocavoce ngokuhambahamba lokubhukutsha[cite: 712].

baby_development.summary: Amehlo omntwana asekhulile, sekwazi ubunyama lokukhanya[cite: 730]. Amehlo akhe ayenelisa ukulandela ukukhanya[cite: 730]. Nxa sebezelwe, bahlala isikhathi bengavulanga amehlo[cite: 731]. Inengi labantwana lenelisa ukukhangela izinto eziseduze lamehlo abo[cite: 731].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Uzanzelela ukuthi uzabe ulokudinwa komzimba[cite: 722]. Umzimba wenza ama-chemicals axegisa lapho okuhlangana khona amathambo[cite: 725]. Inyawo zakho zingavuvuka uze ugqoke isicathulo esikhulu[cite: 725]. Imizila ye-stretch marks iyabe isikhanya kakhulu[cite: 719].
maternal_changes.tips: Inengi labomama babulawa liqolo kakhulu[cite: 734]. Ukuma kuhle kungenza kubengcono[cite: 735].
maternal_changes.plan: Sekusele amaviki angamatshumi ukuthi ubelethe[cite: 737]. Cangaba ngendlela ezokwehlisa ubuhlungu ekubeletheni[cite: 737]. Ungakhetha ukubeletha ngokwemvelo, ukuhlatshwa amajekiseni emhlane (epidural), loba ukusebenzisa izidakamizwa ezisemthethweni (narcotics)[cite: 742, 743, 745].

baby_development.summary: Umntwana uqhubeka ekhula amafutha ngaphansi kwejwabu, wona azamenza abukeke njengomuntu[cite: 766]. Ngamaviki azayo, uzakhula aze afike ku-3.4 kg[cite: 767].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Sungaqala ukubona uchago lokuqala (amahlaka) luphuma emabeleni[cite: 758]. Ukubopha kwesisu (Braxton Hicks contractions) kungaqala ukuyanda[cite: 761]. Lokhu kubopha kuyindlela yokuzelula isibeletho silungiselela umhelo[cite: 763].
maternal_changes.tips: Ama-hemorrhoids/piles avamile[cite: 769]. Abangelwa yimithambo yegazi evuvukileyo emtshazeni[cite: 769]. Ungawanciphisa ngokufaka i-baking soda, ukugeza ngamanzi akhudumalayo, loba ukusebenzisa i-witch hazel[cite: 772, 773].
maternal_changes.plan: Sucabangile na ukuthi uzamunyisa umntwana ngebele loba ngegula[cite: 778]? Esinye isinqumo ngesokugcina igazi lenkaba yomntwana (cord blood)[cite: 779].

baby_development.summary: Inzipho zeminwe lezandla sezikhona[cite: 794]. Amaphaphu asalokhu ekhula[cite: 794]. Amathambo lawo asekhona njalo aseqina[cite: 794].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Isibeletho sesikhule ngaphezu kwenkaba nge 5 inches[cite: 789]. Sungezwa ubunzima ma uphefumula ngoba isibeletho sincindezela amaphaphu[cite: 789]. Kathesi uyengeza isisindo sakho nge 0.5 kg ngeviki[cite: 790].
maternal_changes.tips: Nxa uwezwa ama-Braxton Hicks contractions, ungazama ukutshintsha indlela ohlezi ngayo, ugeze ngamanzi akhudumalayo, loba unathe amanzi[cite: 796, 798, 799, 800].
maternal_changes.plan: Kusukela manje, ungacelwa ukubonwa ngabezempilakahle ngamaviki amabili ngamabili[cite: 803]. Yenza isinqumo ngokugcina igazi lenkaba (cord blood) yomntwana[cite: 804].

baby_development.summary: Ijwabu lakhe liya likhula, selisuka ekubeni bovana[cite: 829]. Amathambo ayaqina, kodwa awekhanda ayalela ebuthakathaka ukuze umntwana abelethwe kuhle[cite: 830].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Isisindo osusiyengezile singafika ku 10 kg - 13 kg[cite: 818]. Ungabe uzibuza ukuthi uzabona na nxa ungaphuma incupha (water breaks)[cite: 819]. Kubanengi, amanzi aphuma mbijana[cite: 820]. Amanzi omntwana ayinuki; nxa ubona amanzi enganuki, xhumana labezempilakahle[cite: 821, 822].
maternal_changes.tips: Kuphephile ukwenza ezocansi ngalesi sikhathi, nxa kungela nkinga[cite: 832, 833].
maternal_changes.plan: Sungaxoxisana lodokotela nge-episiotomy (ukusikwa esithweni sangasese)[cite: 836]. Ayijayelanga ukwenziwa ngaphandle nxa kunesidingo[cite: 836]. Izinto ongazenza ukwehlisa amathuba okusikwa zigoqela ukudla kuhle, ama-Kegels, lokubotobotoza izitho ezizansi kwenkaba (massaging the perineum)[cite: 837, 839, 840, 843].

baby_development.summary: Umntwana uqala ukufaka amafutha ngaphansi kwejwabu, azamenza akwanise ukugcina ukukhudumala esezelwe[cite: 859]. Ingqondo lamaphaphu kuyaqhubeka kukhula[cite: 860]. Umntwana engazalwa ngalezi nsuku, amathuba okuphila manengi[cite: 861].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Isibeletho sesikhule sadlula inkaba nge 14 cm[cite: 851]. Amanzi ahanqazele umntwana (amniotic fluid) afika ubunengi bawo phakathi kweviki 34 le 36[cite: 853]. Kusukela ngeviki 37, ayancipha ukuze kwande indawo yokukhula umntwana[cite: 854].
maternal_changes.tips: Isigaba sokuqala somhelo singamahola ayi 10 kusiya ku 20, lapho umlomo wesibeletho uvuleka khona uze ufike ku 10 cm[cite: 864, 865]. Isigaba sesibili yikubelethwa komntwana, esingathatha ihora[cite: 867, 868]. Isigaba sesithathu yikuphuma kwembeleko[cite: 869].
maternal_changes.plan: Evikini leli, khangelela ukuthi abezempilakahle bexoxe lawe ngokuhlatshwa ukuze uvikelwe i-Group B streptococcus, indlela zokuthoba inhlungu, lokuzivikela ukuzithwala ngemva kokubeletha[cite: 872, 874, 875, 876].

baby_development.summary: Izitho ezimbalwa ezinengi sezikhulile; izinso, lesibindi sesiqalile ukukhipha ingcekeza[cite: 895]. Indlela akhaba ngayo (kick count) iyabe ilokhe ifanana, lanxa indawo isinciphile[cite: 896].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Isibeletho sesikhule okufika 15.2 cm phezu kwenkaba[cite: 889]. Isisindo osusiyengezile singaba yi 11 kg kusiya ku 13.2 kg[cite: 889]. Ukuphefumula kungaba nzima, kodwa kuzaba ngcono umntwana engayehla mbijana[cite: 891]. Lokhu kuzabangela ukuthi uhlale ugijima ukuyalahla amanzi[cite: 892].
maternal_changes.tips: Njengoba usuku lokubeletha lusondela, sungaqala ukudinga udokotela wabantwana (pediatrician)[cite: 898]. Khuluma lodokotela wakho, izihlobo, labangane bakulayele[cite: 899].
maternal_changes.plan: Kusukela ngeviki leyi, ungabonwa ngeviki ngeviki[cite: 901]. Udokotela sengakucela ukuthi uqale ukubala ukuthi umntwana ukhaba kangaki (kick count)[cite: 901]. Kufanele uzwe izigaba ezilitshumi zokudlala emaholeni amabili[cite: 904].

baby_development.summary: Inwele ezibutshelezi (lanugo) ebezivale umzimba seziqala ukunyamalala, kanye le-vernix caseosa[cite: 922]. Ikhanda lakhe selitshibilikile labangaphansi[cite: 924]. Uma lingakafiki lapho, udokotela angazama ukutshibilikisa umntwana ngangaphandle[cite: 925].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Loba umntwana eqhubeka esengeza isisindo, awusoze ubone utshintsho olunengi kuwe[cite: 916]. Ama-Braxton Hicks contractions aya eyanda[cite: 918]. Sekusele amaviki amabili kusiya enyangeni, umntwana uzaqala ukuyehla engena endleleni[cite: 913].
maternal_changes.tips: Uma amabele akho ekulalisi kahle ebusuku, sungalala ugqoke i-nursing bra[cite: 928]. Izonceda kakhulu, loba umntwana engakazalwa[cite: 928].
maternal_changes.plan: Yisikhathi sokupakitshela izikhwama zesibhedlela[cite: 912]. OkukaMama kumele kugoqele i-health insurance card, ama-breast pads, lempahla zokuya endlini[cite: 932, 933, 934]. Okomntwana kugoqele isihlalo semota, impahla zokuya endlini, lezitshubo (diapers)[cite: 936, 937,   939, 940].

baby_development.summary: Loba amalanga akhe asekwanile, kungcono umntwana ahlale ethunjini umhelo uze uzibuyele wodwa[cite: 956]. Uma ikhanda lomntwana lingakatshibilikeli phansi, xoxa labezempilakahle ngendlela ezingathathwa[cite: 957].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Isisindo sakho sonke singaba phakathi kwe 11.3 kg le 15.9 kg, kodwa awusayengezi kakhulu[cite: 949]. Amanzi omntwana (amniotic fluid) ayancipha kusukela kule viki[cite: 950]. Lokhu okuvale umlomo wesibeletho kungaphuma, okuyisibonelo sokuthi ukubeletha sekuseduze[cite: 951, 952].
maternal_changes.tips: Kathesi usuhlala ulindele, ngoba usuku solungafika noma nini[cite: 960]. Kungaba kuhle ukuthi uhlele izinto, indlu ilungiswe[cite: 961]. Ungapheka ukudla okuzawonyiswa ku-fridge kudliwe nxa usuphendukile lomntwana[cite: 963].
maternal_changes.plan: Kufanele ube usuqedisa ama-childbirth classes lamalungiselelo awomntwana[cite: 965]. Yiba lesiqiniseko ukuthi izikhwama zipakitshiwe[cite: 965]. Kungaba licebo elihle ubone ukuthi ungazitshayela na usiya esibhedlela[cite: 966].

baby_development.summary: Izitho zakhe ezinengi sezikhulile njalo sezisebenza[cite: 977]. Okuseleyo yingqondo lamaphaphu, loba lokhu kukwanisa ukusebenza uma umntwana engabelethwa, kuzaqhubeka kukhula[cite: 977].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Ungazwa ukuvuvuka kwenyawo, okujwayelekile[cite: 974]. Kodwa ungabona uvuvuka ngesiqubu izandla, ubuso, loba unyawo, xhumana labezempilakahle ngoba kungabe kuyi-pre-eclampsia[cite: 974].
maternal_changes.tips: Ma usola ukuthi umntwana uku-breech, ungenza eyinye i-sonogram[cite: 980]. Abanye omama benza i-non-stress test, lapho i-fetal monitor ifakwa esiswini ukukhangela ukutshaya kwenhliziyo yomntwana[cite: 982, 983].
maternal_changes.plan: Abempilakahle kufanele baxoxe lawe ngomuntu wokuxhuma nxa usuhelelwa, inkinga ongahlangana lazo, lokungahlali kuhle komntwana ethunjini (breech position)[cite: 986, 987, 988, 991].

baby_development.summary: Umntwana ulokhe ekhula amafutha ngaphansi kwejwabu lakhe, okuqakathekile ekukhudumaleni kwakhe esezelethiwe[cite: 1002]. Ijwabu lakhe selenelisa ukuzihluba[cite: 1002].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Kuleyi viki, kuyabe kungela tshintsho olunengi[cite: 998]. Umlomo wesibeletho usulungiselela ukuvuleka ngokuncipha (effacement)[cite: 998]. Zirathidzo zokuhelelwa zigoqela ukutshila kwesibeletho, ubuhlungu beqolo, lokungahlaliseki[cite: 994].
maternal_changes.tips: Loba suzabeletha, kuqakathekile ukunanzelela ukudlala komntwana[cite: 1004]. Mana ukukhipha izitampa eziphathini zomntwana, ungathola ukuthi azimlingani[cite: 1005].
maternal_changes.plan: Thatha izinto kancane kancane[cite: 1008]. Impilo yakho ayisoke ifane esefikile umntwana[cite: 1008]. Chitha isikhathi labasendlini lomkakho[cite: 1009].

baby_development.summary: Amathambo akhe aseqinile ngaphandle kwawekhanda[cite: 1041]. Awekhanda kumele ahlale ebuthakathaka ukuze adlule kuhle nxa ezalwa[cite: 1041]. Ngenxa yalokho, ikhanda lingabe licijile mbijana ngamalanga okuqala[cite: 1042]. Umntwana ulenkanda ezimbili (fontanelles) ezivumela ukuthi amathambo atshelele azalwe kuhle[cite: 1043].

maternal_changes.body_changes: Nxa ubeletha, ikhanda lomntwana lizabonakala[cite: 1034]. Nxa lingasabuyeli emuva, kubizwa kuthiwe yi-crowning[cite: 1034]. Lapho, uzezwa ukutshisa; mana ukukhanula ukuze ungadabuki[cite: 1035, 1036, 1037]. Ukopha kakhulu (postpartum hemorrhage) kungabangelwa yikudabuka komlomo wesibeletho kumbe inkinga zembeleko[cite: 1015, 1017, 1022].
maternal_changes.tips: Uqeda ukubeletha, umntwana uyahlolwa nge-APGAR[cite: 1046]. I-APGAR ikutshengisa impilakahle yakhe[cite: 1048]. Ukutshaya isikhombisa kusiya kutshumi kulungile[cite: 1050]. Ukuze kuphele kuhle, chelesisa izinyama zangaphansi, nanzelela ukuphefumula kwakho[cite: 1053, 1054].
maternal_changes.plan: Udokotela angakuhlola nge-Non stress test le-Amniotic fluid index[cite: 1057, 1058, 1059]. Angathanda ukuxoxisana lawe ngokudlula inyanga, ukuheleliswa (induction), kumbe ukulaliswa (caesarean)[cite: 1061, 1062, 1063].
